name: Cathy Kim
text: Creme brûlée cake was fantastic, moist and rich yet not heavy at all. One of my favorite birthday cakes to date. Held up even days later after initial cutting.

name: Can Inci
text: Fantastic bakery in Burlington. I had the egg biscuit, Jamaican hand pie, and little cinnamon twirls and everything was delicious. They naturally run out of items because of the high demand so you should be there early to get exactly what you want. At the end, it won’t matter because you will love anything you buy here. Highly recommended!

name: Kathleen James
text: First of all, there is absolutely wonderful service every time I'm lucky enough to come here! The staff is all friendly, knowledgeable and professional. The treats are crazy delicious and there is such a wide and ever changing selection. I look forward to every trip that I get to take here; it is truly a five star experience, every time.

resp.text: Thanks for taking the time to review us, Kathleen. We look forward to seeing you again.

name: Gary DuCharme
text:
The breakfast sandwiches are very good. It is not quantity but quality.
The croissant breakfast sandwich is very filling and delicious. The cinnamon rolls are the best I have ever had. A friend brought over the Keylime pie for dessert last nite and it was just the best with shavings of white chocolate on the generous portion of whipped cream topping. I guess you can tell I just love the place!

name: Joel Fichman
text: This was my first time in the new location. It is exactly like the old location was before they added the cafe seating. I know I will be back!

resp.text: Thanks, Joel. Great to know that some of our customers from the 1990s are finding us out here. We love our new space. Looking forward to putting more tables outside as warm weather returns.

name: Steve Hayes
text: Service was prompt and cordial. Food was first rate.

name: M. Kaseweter
text: A real bakery! Macarons, tarts, creme brulee, ganached cakes, croissants—all delicate and lovely. Everything is decadent and fatty... just how baked goods are meant to be. 😚 Some of the flavors are mild to my palette, but the textures are spot-on. High class joint they've got. V professional.

name: John Scott
text: Best baked goods we've had in some time and in our all time top 3. Great service too. Don't change a thing.

name: Sarah Lady
text: Great food, great service, great value!

name: Matt Lewis
text: I called in a pickup order for 3 reubens for my coworkers and I today and boy was I impressed.   Everyone looked happy and was friendly, the store was clean and had proper signage to keep masks on and stay distanced, the food was fantastic.   I don't think i've had a better reuben!   I hope this company is doing well as a whole and keeps their employees happy, you are definitely doing something right!    -Matt

resp.text: Thanks, Matt! See you next time.

name: Laura Borja
text: Never had a bad experience!! Everything is delicious!! It used to be my #1 stop when I went to Burlington but so happy that they are closer and more convenient to me so I can go there more often.

name: Brooke L-J
text: Amazing baked goods! I just wish their location was more convenient.

name: C RC
text: I was for a week in Burlington and just love it...went back almost every day for breakfast. Love everything!  The desserts are very good.

name: Tina Lemay
text:
I've been to Mirabelles before, and have enjoyed their cakes we have brought into work for parties. They have always been the BEST of any bakery in Burlington.
Today, I spotted the Paris Brest fine pastry. Last month in DC, these became my latest favorite.  Mirabelles did not disappoint! A hazelnut and chocolate filling combo on the fresh crust, just the right size...I'm in heaven!

name: Alma Greene
text: Amazing pastries, you cannot go wrong here. You can come every week and tried for more than half of the year something different without repeat and plus they have something different every day. They al have the best galette de roi in town and maybe in all Vermont!, perfect for the Epiphany celebration on January 5th.

resp.text: Thanks for your support, Alma. We'll keep baking!

name: Kenneth Fontaine
text: Excellent Service! Great bakery!

name: Lolita Abeneto
text: My favorite place! And I'm super happy now that they're closer. I live in Williston,just 5 min away from Williston road where they're located.

name: VARSHA RACHA
text: Ordered Hot chocolate, it was amazing. And the desserts selection is pure bliss... Love this place

name: Hasan Riaz
text: Really nice breakfast spot in Burlington. The place was fairly crowded, so I would recommend reservations if you're going at a popular time or have a large group. The food took a bit long, probably because of how busy the kitchen was, but everything tasted great! They also have a decent beer selection, considering their specialty is breakfast.

name: Leah Malka
text: Good coffee, great chocolate croissant. I'll be back for the apple pie.

name: Mike Costello
text: Delicious pastries and great breakfast sandwiches

name: sally jablonski
text: never had a bite of their baked goods that wasn't luscious

name: Samantha Palazzo
text: Great place plenty of selection. Crazy bummed that they are moving so no more table service. Hopefully you'll still be able to carry out their food because the French toast is amazing!

resp.text: We'll have grab-and-go breakfast sandwiches, but--sorry--no French toast. One of the reasons it's so good is that we make it with our brioche bread. If all goes well, we'll be selling loaves of that.

name: Ruth Scott
text: Delicious! Lovely bakery 😋  Mirabelles is what you expect from a bakery.

name: Alison Anker
text: We've enjoyed Mirabelles for years in their old location.  I picked up breakfast sandwiches several times since they moved to their new location and they never disappoint!  Recently, during the stay at home period when they've been operating with a contactless pick up, we ordered a custom cake to celebrate our anniversary.  We asked for cinnamon buttercream (since that's what we had on our wedding cake), they let me know they haven't done that before but were willing to accommodate our request.  The cake was absolutely wonderful!!  Thank you for helping us celebrate during this stay at home period!

resp.text: Just following up to say that breakfast sandwiches are back today! We are open 8-4, M-Sat. Thanks for your kind review. And here's to cinnamon buttercream!

name: Patrick DiRico
text:
This establishment is truly amazing, not just the delicious treats, but the staff too!

Always a pleasure ordering a few guilty snacks and a delicious hot beverage to wash it down.

I wish them the best of luck in their new location!

resp.text: Thanks for finding us, Patrick. We look forward to seeing you again.

name: Jane Woodruff
text: Great bakery.  Lovely, decadent choices.

name: lester suarez
text: Great pastries and coffee.  Need more GF products

name: Andrea Olson
text: Delicious food, friendly staff and great vibe. Will miss the downtown location when it closes on January 25th, yet, looking forward to the new spot on Williston Road!

resp.text: Thanks, Andrea. We are still on track to open in mid-February. Stay in touch with us via social media or sign up for our e-mail list and we'll keep you posted about our grand opening.

name: Anne Borchers
text: Easy to get to and parking is free. You dont have to contend with the craziness of downtown Burlington to sample their amazing pastries and cakes. The staff is always friendly.  It's just that good.

resp.text: Hey, Anne. Thanks for your kind words--and for finding us out here in the suburbs. Looking forward to seeing you again.

name: XO XO
text: Wonderful baked goods, wish they had more GF options & seating (I have only visited the downtown one)

name: Scott Warren
text: The creme brulee cake is absolutely amazing!

name: Jacqueline Bassett
text: Very tasty cookies, and sandwiches

name: Shraddha Atrawalkar
text: Creme Brulee cake <3

name: Smriti Priya
text: Oh these cute little Tiramisu cups! Probably the best ones I have had till date. They melt in your mouth and are perfect to quench sweet tooth cravings. Not too sweet, yet  delectable. Other recommendations would be Lemon Bar, Crème Brulé, Chocolate cake (I don't recall the exact name right now but it has flaky texture on top, will update the name soon). Another one which was recommended by their staff is 'Opera' which is good but not at par with the ones mentioned above.

name: Kelvin Chan
text: Have been there many times in the last 9 years. I guess I should share what I like. The breakfast is always good. The menu is not super special but just matches my appetite. I like their omelette. Many bakeries are very good too, particularly creme brulee cake, spectacular in my opinion.

name: Michael Biama
text: Delicious food! Nice atmosphere and excellent service.

name: Maddie O'Reilly
text: Friendly service, amazing pastries, and excellent breakfast. It does get crowded like every other breakfast place around, but come on the early side and you won't be disappointed. (The place is not large- you could get a pastry to go through). The chocolate croissant was divine. The frittata I had came with toast and potatoes; I chose baguette as my toast but there are other options (I might go with that next time, toasted baguette is delicious but kind of hard!) I love how low key this place is. One of our favorites.

name: Blair Wolston
text: The best cinnamon bun I've ever had came from this bakery. This place is always busy, for good reason. A food hot spot with incredible baked goods as well as more traditional breakfast fare. Go!

name: Meli S
text: Best macaroons in town! Actually best desserts PERIOD. Chocolate cake is amazing as well. Nice chilled environment for lunch or breakfast with a menu with simple yet well executed options.

name: Zoe Portlas
text: Part of why I'm kind of annoyed with this place is because of all the hype surrounding it. People insist it's the best breakfast place in town, but I won't go back. The service was just ok, nice and polite, but very slow. The food was really bland and generic and the coffee was honestly terrible. The French desserts are much better than the breakfast food, but they're still kind of overpriced and too rich for me anyway.

name: Eddie Sacks
text:
One of my favorite places to eat.  I didn't care for what I ordered today, first time i got a meal I didn't care for, but I will go back, they are
too good to let one bad meal stop me. Try them you won't be disappointed.

name: Randy H
text: They have a fine selection of pastries, cakes, and chocolate treats. They have good coffee and they also serve sandwiches. Including breakfast sandwiches. Wonderful place. Try their creme brulee cake... Amazing.

name: wendy thibault
text: It was okay.

name: kim C
text: Overpriced for what you get. Usually out of what you want. Food is pretty decent. Dont get the "hash browns" unless you want a potato cake.

name: J H
text: Soooo good! words what words?? Friendly staff, top notch baked goods. A worthy stop.

name: Margi Swett
text: Amazing food. The creme brulee cake is unbelievable. My staff parties no longer have anything else!

name: Promo Paul. Loud Event Photography.
text: Amazing fresh made goodies. Mousse cakes, cheese cakes, exotic foreign treats, to many to list.  The best chocolate chip cookies I have ever had.

name: Nicole Reynolds
text: Decent lunch food. A little cramped in the seating area. I would have enjoyed my stay a little more if there wasn't a child running recklessly around while her mom gossiped with her girlfriends. Otherwise the food was good. Portion sizes were large. Prices were good for a lunch menu.

name: Jess Peck
text: Great breakfast in downtown Burlington! Whether just from their bakery section, or a sit-down breakfast this is always wonderful. Lunches are good too, but I'm a sucker for a good breakfast out. Their Chocolate Raspberry Mousse Cake is amazing.

name: Andrew Swift
text: Great local French pastry shop right around the corner from Church Street. Nice seating area with street view. Pastry and dessert selection is excellent. Also, morning croissants are amazing. They do cakes -- ordering ahead is recommended. Friendly staff. Highly recommended!

name: Charles Fields
text: Awesome place to cure a sweet tooth.

name: Kohle Feeley
text: Best french toast I've ever had! The French style hot chocolate is another great winner.

name: Andy Newhall
text: One of the top bakeries in town. If you are looking for pastries to go, or a great dine in breakfast, there aren't any better options in Burlington. I have patronized this establishment on a semi-regular basis for the past 4 years and have always found the service and quality of products to be consistently to a high level.

name: Heidi Olson
text: Love Mirabelles!  Always serving wonderful breakfasts and lunches...and the cakes and pastries are elegant, decadently delicious and not to be missed!

name: Mikayla Dubuque
text: AMAZING Macaroons!! Delicious sweets!

name: Ryan D
text: Not a sit down and relax kind of place. Ordered a latte and was handed one in a to-go cup. Apparently you need to order food if you want to sit down in there. I was left holding a hot, bland chai to finish before I could find a more comfortable establishment. Not worth the $5.

name: Al Getler
text: This is one of Burlington's local icons. The food is always good (I loved my Brazilian bean soup) and the staff is about the friendliest in Burlington. Plus, it is a bakery! So you have to indulge, right? This is a place that I always see locals I know, but that I can recommend highly to visitors. Parking can be a challenge, so have quarters and use the blue meters on the end of Church Street.

name: Robyn Latta
text: great bakery on main street. I'd love to get lunch here sometime but I normally only get coffee while I'm getting cakes for birthdays or special occasions. The creme brulee cake is AMAZING

name: Dr. Chris
text:
Not sure if new owners, or new inexperienced staff but recently had a nightmare with a recent order. I've been ordering Birthday cakes for the past 5yrs, always for the same date.
This time I wanted a more custom cake, which I was assured would be very simple - even though it was.a little off the available menu.
My original order was too confusing, yet amateur bakers in elementary school understood what I was asking for. Then I placed another order, and two days before it was due - the store called and inquired about my original order. There appears to be no communication at this business anymore between workers, staff talk on the phone and pay no attention to the customer and orders are not acceptable. $60 for a cake and they can't even do the simplest of requests.. Unfortunately, Mirabelles has lost me as a customer. I will not recommend this company, nor seek out orders in the future... Buyers Beware!

name: IslandStormVT
text: Drinks were delicious, lunch was exactly what we were looking for - simple and filling. The service left a little to be desired and likely stopped us from ordering at least one additional round of drinks and, granting that, dessert. I would happily give them another chance, and likely will, as it was overall a very pleasant experience.

name: Johnny Azer
text: I remember when some old friends from S.California would come to town, we went there a couple of times. The food was beyond spectacular and the waitress I hope got a big fat raise. I think that is great how they feed homeless people over the holidays. Never went to that because I usually ate turkey alone since friends died etc. I appreciate how they told me in a super nice way they were not hiring any entertainment but I know I would have fun singing there. Great place.

text: The atmosphere is old style Vermont and relaxing but interesting. the staff super friendly and efficient, the food, fish, steak, burgers that we had excellent. The nachos outstanding

resp.text: Hey Andy, what could we have done better?  We’d love to WOW you!

name: cynthia stephenson
text:
Went to the annual Thanksgiving coat give away. Beautiful coats. Clean and smelled clean. Very good condition. Very helpful staff. Thank you
A lot of work and caring went into this coat giveaway.

resp.text: Thank you Cynthia, I’m so glad that you were able to find a coat!  This was our 30th year of supporting the community with a Thanksgiving meal and the coat drive.  We are humbled by the support we get from the entire community to make this event a success.

name: Jacob Edelman
text: Fun vibe. Good drinks and good nachos. I liked the safety measures with sign-in sheet. New server seemed like he'd been working there for years! Professional and polite.

resp.text: Great to hear, Jacob. Thank you for the review and we’ll pass on the kudos to your server.

name: Tyler Coleman
text: Great place for a nice meal.  Wait staff is very nice and they have several options for vegetarians and vegans.

resp.text: Thank you for the review, Tyler.  In addition to our regular vegetarian options, please know that if something is not vegetarian or vegan and we can prepare it as such, we are always happy to make those modifications.  Thank you for your business.

name: James Grady
text: Great food for family and there are french fries 🍟

name: S G
text: The service and food used to be much better before the Covid

resp.text: Stefan, I’d love to get some details from you since nothing has changed.  If you have the time to call the restaurant and ask for David it would be much appreciated. As you can tell from our other reviews, your experience is not the norm and we’d like to make it up to you.

name: Todd Tomasi
text: Meh...couldn't make a decent old fashioned at the bar.

name: Barre Flynn
text: This is one seriously great place to eat.   American Food with a lot of creativity.  Wait Staff was amazing.   They had a water bowl for your dog, since people bring their dogs to Church Street.   The bathrooms are clean.  We sat outside and it was really amazing,  inside is an old bank that is pretty cool as well.  I had salmon and it was cooked perfectly,  my daughter tuna and it was amazing as well.  My Great Grandson had a delicious pasta with cheeses and basil.  We shared Calamari and it was so tasty.  The prices were right in line with the quality of the meal.   I would definitely go back again.

resp.text: I love that!  "Seriously Great!"  What Barre said.

name: Robert St Don
text: I only went for the free turkey dinner they have every year .but i skipped it cause of long line but good without the virus going on

name: JG DeBiasio
text: Very nice opportunity to get out with the covid quarantine and still feel safe.  All staff was masked.  For contact tracing we had to provide name and number for all 3 of us.  And parking is free Sundays.

resp.text: Great to hear, JG.  We appreciate your support!

resp.text: Nicole, if that ever happens again please say something.  We are always more than happy to make things right.  We appreciate your business.

name: Kate
text: This place is always poppin! I haven't eaten at the restaurant but their take-out service is great.  They have really good pulled pork nachos and yummy yummy poutine.

resp.text: Thank you so much!

name: FD G
text: Darby was our server for the evening. She was efficient, had great customer service, and was Xtra quick! Thanks - will be back for sure.

resp.text: Great to hear!  Thank you for sharing your experience.

name: Matt Takas
text: The food was very good and flavorful (I had the Brick chicken, seen below), although it took quite a while to come out (25+ minutes). Not quite sure what happened, although it was moderately busy at the time. Lots of good local beers on tap as well. Like others have said, excellent place to people watch!

resp.text: Matt, I am not quite sure what happened either but we do appreciate your patience and that you took the time to write the review.  We hope to see you again soon.

name: Ashley Lafleche
text: Response to owner: had a reservation in late October, wasn't asked about my reservation and contact information wasn't taken down and I wasn't asked any identifying information. Would have gone to a different restaurant but I was under the impression reservations were mandatory and it was my mother's birthday.. I am local, but the lack of care regarding Covid turned me off to your business practices, because as a patron if covid originated in or was spread in your establishment no one would know. We were sat directly next to other patrons, after asking to change our seating so we weren't next to an open window on a chilly day. This experience was my only dining out experience since the pandemic started and has turned me off to other restaurants therefore preventing me from eating out locally. Poutine was good though, salmon tacos were not.

resp.text: Hi Ashley, thank you for the prompt reply.  I am shocked to hear that there was not a contract tracing sheet put on your table to fill out.  This is a protocol that we have had in place since last May and the extent of our record keeping has been commended by the board of health on more than one occasion. We have also blocked off every other table to assure 6’ distance between tables so again, your experience has left me baffled.  You are correct though, we have been leaving the many garage door windows open as much as possible to allow fresh air flow in the restaurant.  I do apologize for the many mishaps you experienced and I assure you that what you experienced is not our normal protocol. We taken great pride in the safe environment that we have been able to create for both our guests and our employees.  Thank you for bringing this to our attention. I would also ask if you don’t mind, we’d love to talk to you about what day and time you were in and where you were seated in the restaurant.  If it’s easier, please call the restaurant  and ask for David.  Thank you again.

name: Justin C
text: A good place. It was hot and we just wanted some drinks. The beer selection is very good. The appetizers we ordered came fast and tasted great. Nothing fancy, but that is not what we were going for. Service was excellent too.

name: Zachary Hubbell
text: Pulled Pork Mac & Cheese! ...!!! Try it, it was absolutely delicious and reasonably priced. This restaurant has a pleasant atmosphere and good service (though not unique for the area).

resp.text: The pulled pork mac and cheeses was an outstanding choice!  We smoke the pork, our chicken wings and brisket in-house - something that is unique for the area. Thank you for the review.

name: Casey Richards
text: Delicious Apple Crisp and good food overall. Friendly service.

resp.text: So glad to hear that you enjoyed our home made apple crisp!  Thank you for taking the time to review Sweetwaters. We look forward to serving you again.

name: Mike Gibbons
text: Great food, good social distancing

resp.text: Thank you for the review, Mike. Given our large space and 20’ ceilings, we feel that we are in a unique position to provide a safer dining experience.  Thank you for noticing.

name: Cher Pitaniello
text: Good food. Always good service.

resp.text: Thank you, Cher.  We appreciate the shout out.

name: Shayna Joyce
text: We came here for lunch yesterday, and the poutine was really good. We really weren't that hungry but we had to kill time and stopped here. A couple people recommended this restaurant to us, and we were not disappointed.

resp.text: Shayna, thank you for sharing your Sweetwaters experience.  We look forward to serving you again soon.

name: Jessica Pecor
text: Great service. Great food! Highly recommend.

resp.text: Jessica, thank you for the "highly recommend", it is appreciated.

name: Chrystal-linn Badeau
text: Had I very nice dinner with the family, even with all of the restrictions with the Covid-19 the food was enjoyable and very friendly staff.

resp.text: Great to hear, Chrystal-linn.  These are certainly strange times but we are working hard to make the dining experience as enjoyable as possible.  It’s nice to hear that we hit the mark.  Thank you for sharing.

name: Dawn Obrien
text: Great place on Church street to have a snack and people watch.

resp.text: We couldn’t agree more!  Thank you for the review.

name: Damon Brink
text: It's nice to be back so these 4 stars are emotional before I've done anything but sit and order a Shed Mountain Ale. Sweetwater's is a staple, possibly THE staple of downtown drinking and dining. Great, classic feel, pleasantly greeted and quickly served my beer. Not crowded on a Wednesday night but so what. I recommend this place for the history and ambiance alone. I'll review the food and service after I sit to eat.

resp.text: So glad to have you back. We feel confident we can earn 5 stars by the time the meal is over!  Keep us posted.

name: Austin Caldwell
text: Friendly staff and good food.  The Poutine with Pulled Pork starter is very large and more than a meal for the average diner.

resp.text: We are glad to hear that you enjoyed your visit. Most of our starters and designed for sharing. You picked a particularly good one!

name: rachel hoyt
text: The shirt sleeve sandwich is amazing!

resp.text: Thank you Rachel, it has been our menu for over 20 years.  It’s a perennial favorite!  Thank you for your support.

name: Shawnna DeMatos
text: My husband and I love Sweetwaters! We come down once a year for our anniversary. Always get sweet potato fries and pulled pork nachos! They are so super good and the leftovers are great for the kids 😉

resp.text: Two of our most popular menu items!  Thank you for your support.

name: Avi Ghelman
text: Enjoyed it very much. We had a great lunch. Very cozy, and tasty

resp.text: Thank you for taking the time to share your experience.  We are glad you enjoyed yourself and look forward to serving you again soon.

name: norman peters
text: The waitress was great. I really liked the inside look. The food was really good. I would definitely return.

resp.text: We would love to serve you again, Norman.  Thank you for the review.

name: Ang Benner
text: Jenna was EPIC. food was outstanding . quick friendly service .

resp.text: Ang, I love that you used the word EPIC!  Thank you.

name: Craig Knowles
text: Switchback fish and chips and sweetwater burger and fries were great

resp.text: Great choices!  Thank you for sharing your experience.

name: Mike Coombs
text: Nice atmosphere, creative menu,  clean.

resp.text: Thank you for taking the time to review Sweetwaters. Your support is appreciated.

name: Cat Mccat
text: I always enjoy my food here. Reliable spot on Church Street. Their hamburgers and calamari are my favorite favorites. The outdoor seating area is perfect for days with nice weather. They make good cocktails as well. Usually eat here on my visits to downtown Burlington. Definitely recommend!

resp.text: Thank you, Cat.  We appreciate your recommendation.  May I add the nachos to your "must-have" list?

name: Stan Payne
text: Sweetwaters is a nice restaurant at the intersection of Church Street and College Street along the Church Street Marketplace. The staff there are very nice and friendly and would strive to serve your food and beverages in a timely manner even if they're busy. The food and beverages are pretty decent and you wouldn't be disappointed.

resp.text: Thank you Stan, we appreciate the shout out.

name: Kathy Connolly
text: Even on a busy night, service is good, and most nights are busy.  Sweetwaters has been a staple of the Burlington downtown for decades and every time I have gone since first arriving in VT, I have never been disappointed.  The menu isn't stagnant, the quality is reliable and the atmosphere is great for a quiet meal for 2, people watching from outdoor tables in warmer months, or a great place to take a break while shopping on Church Street.  Highly recommended.

resp.text: Kathy, we appreciate your "highly recommend" and thorough review.  We look forward to serving you again soon.

name: Marie Couture
text: Best bar in Burlington. Great bartenders. Very good food!

resp.text: Thank you, Marie. We'll be sure to share your review with our team.

name: Jocelyn DeMaio
text: I have never seen a more efficient bartender.  I wish I remembered his name. In addition to being great at his job, he was extremely knowledgeable about the local breweries,  other restaurants and sites. He made a killer drink too!

resp.text: I think it might have been Eric?  In saying that, we think all of our bartenders are pretty darn efficient! Thank you for the review.

name: Robert Jones
text: Very good brisket!

resp.text: We couldn’t agree more. Our chef nailed it with that recipe. I’ll be sure to let him know. Thank you for your support.

name: Michael Jadczak
text: Great food good price. Classic fare with a creative touch.

resp.text: Thank you for the review, Michael.

name: greenmountaingirlvt
text: All of the food was very good, service was great. Nice location. Dog friendly. :)

resp.text: GreenMtnGirl, thank you for taking the time to share your experience. It is appreciated.

name: Cassandra Frink
text: I always love coming here whenever we are on church street!

resp.text: Thank you, Cassandra.  We appreciate your business.

name: Tim Stetson
text: Good food, great staff, clearly a destination eatery! Be sure to make a reservation!!

resp.text: Thank you for the review, Tim.  Because of our destination on the main pedestrian walk-way in Burlington, we take a limited number of reservations and try to keep a sizable portion of the restaurant for walk-ins.  So, if you can't get a reservation and it is during a busy time, I would suggest using call ahead seating. Get your name on the list and then visit the many shops and businesses on the marketplace.

name: Sean Leonardi
text: Decent beer selection, good bar service, lacking service outside. Bit costly for the quality bit a few solid appetizers if you are looking for a snack. Don't expect a quick in and out of you sit outside but the seating is a nice church street view if you're not in a hurry.

resp.text: Hi Sean, I am sorry to hear that the service outside was lacking.  I am not making excuses but we had a few nice days this week that took us by surprise, given the weather report.  So yes, staffing levels could have been better.  We appreciate your patience.

name: Scarlett Payne
text: Delicious food, excellent ambiance!!!

resp.text: Thank you so much, Scarlett.  Your review is appreciated.

name: Allen Branson
text: Great fish & chips. Nice location on Church St. in Burlington, VT. Try it, you will like it.

resp.text: Yes, what Allen says!  Thank you for the review.

name: William Bragg
text: Staff is nice, beautiful building and great food and drink selection.

name: Dave Schramm
text: Tomato soup is the best I've ever had.

resp.text: Thank you, Dave.  Our chef appreciates the kudos as does his team.

name: Cheryl Cloutier
text: Great atmosphere, great food, great friend, what's not to like?!

resp.text: There is nothing to not like! Thank you for the kind words and we look forward to serving you again.

name: Michael Allen
text: Horrible service and food is over priced but..... The steak is great

resp.text: Hi Michael, I am not sure what happened but would love to hear details and make amends.  Could you please call us 802-864-9800 and ask for David?  Thank you in advance.

name: Peter Banks
text: Good food and drink inside and outside. Friendly efficient staff.

resp.text: Great to hear, Peter. Thank you for the review.

name: Kevin Donley
text: top tier

resp.text: Thank you, Kevin.  We try.  Stay safe!

name: Ted Grzesik
text: Excellent food and service!

resp.text: Awesome, thank you Ted.

name: Nick Bilancieri
text: Has a pretty good menu at a pretty good price.  Its definitely one of the best if you are on Church street

resp.text: Yes, I'd like to reiterate that, "one of the best."  Thank you!

name: Gwendolyn Bunnewith
text: The food here is great. The french fries are some of the best I've ever had, the mac and cheese is wonderful, and the chicken tenders are to die for. The service is what can be hit or miss sometimes! I recommend visiting during their nonpeak hours. The two times I've gone during slow hours, the service was fantastic. I went, with a reservation, on a busy Saturday night, and our meal came out two minutes after our appetizer and it really just felt like they wanted us gone so they could flip the table.  It is on the pricier side; the food is totally worth it, though. Just go at slow hour so you have the chance to fully enjoy the meal without feeling rushed or like a nuisance! I recommend the food, but for a late afternoon snack rather than a romantic date night, especially not on a weekend.

resp.text: Gwendolyn, I appreciate your review and your advice. However, as noted by many of our other reviews, service is usually quite good all of the time.  I am not defending our service but want to add that hiccups can occur at any volume of business and at any time of the day.  In saying that, I do apologize that we were not on top of our game the Saturday night you dined with us and hope you'll give us another try on a busier evening.

name: Jon Marcinkiewicz
text: Prices are really good.  Dinner salads are excellent.  My son rates the burger with the local beef high.

resp.text: Your son is  smart person,  Jon. We just switched over to the Boyden Farms burgers and have been very pleased with how well recieved it has been.

name: Richard Kenney
text: Great food, but a bit overpriced. One has the impression of paying for atmosphere rather than menu. But it's a great atmosphere. A good place to go when you need to impress someone without breaking the bank.

resp.text: Hi Richard, I'm sorry to hear that you felt that we were priced based on atmosphere but I do appreciate that you note that you had great food. Thank you for the review.

name: Bonnie Walker
text: We were seated for dinner by hostess and sat for approximately 15 minutes. A waitress served two other tables nearby during this time but she never greeted us, meaning she totally ignored us. We didn't know who was taking care of the area we were in. We told the hostess that no one from restaurant stopped by our table and she immediately addressed this. Shortly thereafter, the waitress mentioned above finally stopped by our table and took our drink order. Waitress didn't mention anything to us about our wait before she took our drink order. Even after we placed our order, service from waitress was extremely slow. My rating is only for the cheeseburger I ordered for dinner.

resp.text:
Bonnie, I am sorry to hear that you received less than stellar service.  Please accept our apologies and know that your experience is not the norm. If you'd be so kind as to try us again, I guarantee an exemplary experience.  Please ask for me on your next visit.

Best,

David

name: david bell
text: I attend the Thanksgiving dinner every year,the food and service from the volunteers is outstanding. Thanks again looking forward to seeing you again soon.

resp.text: Hi David, so glad to hear that you had a great experience.  Thank you for sharing.

name: Dean Holden
text: I got the chicken Caesar salad, and it was good, but not great.  It just lacked any kind of pizazz.  Very basic.  The chicken breast wasn't even sliced.  If it hadn't been right on Church Street, I would have given it three stars.

resp.text: Sorry to hear that, Dean. Every once in a while we miss. Just let your server know and we'd be more than happy to make your food item or replace it with something you'd enjoy more.

name: Kathleen Blasquez
text: Love the view from this place! A great place for a drink and appetizer with a special friend.

resp.text: Thank you for the shout out, Kathleen.  We think we have one of the best locations in town.

name: dolores Reinecke
text: Had a family dinner here with three generations. Everyone enjoyed their meals

resp.text: That's awesome!  Thank you for choosing Sweetwaters.

name: Juni Tyner
text: not sure why this place is always so busy! the service is subpar and the food is not great.

resp.text: Juni, not to be defensive but perhaps you hit us on an off time?  I'd love to hear more about what you ordered, who you server was etc.  We take our guest reviews as an opportunity to coach and support your staff.  Any details you would care to share would be great.  Please feel free to call the restaurant or ask for a manager if you choose to try us again.  I guarantee we can make a better impression.

name: Laurie __
text: Great place for food and drinks downtown.

resp.text: We couldn’t agree more!  Thank you for noticing.

name: D Smith
text: Food is awesome. Better food for your money then most of the places around. Never found anything bad to say.

name: Nicholas Diehl
text: Great food and atmosphere

resp.text: Thank you for the review, Nicholas. So glad to hear you had a great visit.

name: Roger Phelps
text: Had a good meal. Soup and fish and chips. Good beer selection.

resp.text: A great pairing. Our fish and chips batter is make with Switchback beer as well.  Thank you for the review.

name: Nicholas Ceffalo
text: Good food at a decent price

resp.text: Nicholas, thank you for taking the time to share a review.

name: Gary Pasquale
text: Great spot on church st food is good staff go out of there way to much sure you have a great time

resp.text: Gary, we appreciate that you took the time to share your experience with others.  Thank you.

name: Robyn Latta
text: Mediocre food. The calamari isn't bad and the drinks are decent. There's pretty much always availability though so it's not a bad place to go in a pinch. I think the older crowd really enjoys it

name: Debbe painting
text: I am adjusting my comment because I did not express the entire picture. We came in for dinner and were seated in the front atrium. We ordered drinks, they came half hour later. Our food arrived, no silverware, had to go inside to the hostess to get silverware. They handed it to me instead of bringing it over. My son wanted another drink, our waitress never came to check on us. Second time I had to go to hostess to ask for help. The hostess should have sent a manager over to check on us. WORST SERVICE EVER.

resp.text: I'm sorry to hear that, Debbie. This is obviously the first time I am hearing about the situation. I wish you had said something to a manager, we would have been more than happy to handle the situation at the moment. Please rest assured that we pride ourselves in providing exceptional service and hope you'll give us another chance.

name: Kate O'Brien
text: Never had a bad meal here and service is usually good. A very touristy spot

resp.text: The Church Marketplace area is a big draw for visiting guests and worth the stop, and there is no better spot to be in the midst of the action than Sweetwaters.  We are glad you enjoyed your meal and service and look forward to serving you again.

name: Donna Dione
text: Nice staff. Very accommodating to special diets.  I'm celiac and they have a pretty substantial gluten free menu.

resp.text: Thank you for noting our gluten-free menu.  We try to be as inclusive with all diet and allergy restrictions as possible.

name: Kelley Koehler
text: Delicious!

resp.text: Thank you, Kelly. Glad to hear that you had a great experience.

name: Yoni Loeub
text: Surprised by how good the bison burger was. Service was very meh, however

resp.text: Yoni, I am sorry to hear that the service was not up to our usual standards.  We'd love to get some details from you as to when you were in and who waited on you.  We view comments such as yours as learning opportunities. Thank you for sharing.

name: Kenn O'Connell
text: Great atmosphere with good service..good food, we started with the grilled scallops and bacon..4 stars because of the high prices for the portion size..only 3 small scallops for $11. Fish and chips were good and came with an amazing coleslaw. Also had the seared tuna with cucumber slaw and was cooked to perfection and very tasty..ended the meal with chocolate lava cake and mint chocolate chip ice cream, it was good but in my opinion the ice cream was a little to minty for me. Overall good restaurant and would recommend

name: Tom Horton
text: Excellent food, service and ambiance

resp.text: Perfect!  That's exactly what we are striving for.  Thank you for taking the time to share your experience.

name: Will Gesler
text: Always a pleasure coming here.

resp.text: wllpwr, that you for sharing your experience via a 5 star rating. It is appreciated.

name: edgar algiere
text: need to support the church st restaurants

resp.text: ALL of the Church St businesses could use a little love right now.  Thank you for your posting.

name: Denise Martin
text: Great food, service

resp.text: Thank you, Denise, we appreciate your support.

name: Karen Rathbun
text: Fun atmosphere,  great service,  reasonable prices and fantastic food!

resp.text: It sounds like you covered it all!  Thank you for the review, it is appreciated.

name: susan moore
text:
Great spot
.right on church st. The French onion soup is wo. see wonderful

resp.text: Thank you Susan, we appreciate the 4 star review and look forward to serving you again soon.

name: Pamela Jacobs
text: Went for dinner with a group of 16 on a Saturday between a Lyric show between the matinee and evening performance.  Was part of the Lyric crew and Sweetwater's accommodated us beautifully.  We were able to all sit together in a side room.  Had Shrimp with Pesto & Pasta.  Delicious!  Side garden salad with raspberry vinagrette to start.  One of my friends got sweet potato fries for the table.  Everything was wonderful.  Our server, Emma Rose was knowledgeable and friendly.    She got us our meal, then our individual checks very quickly.  Thanks for the Lyric discount during Show Week!

name: Gerald Beggs
text: We had a excellent meal and drinks !!

resp.text: Thank you so much for letting us know.  We hope to serve you again soon.

name: Ryan Le Blanc
text: Tourist food and tourist prices. The food is fine, there's nothing wrong with it per se, but you're going to be paying a 25%-35% premium on the same food that could be had off the promenade.

resp.text: Ryan, I am going to respectfully disagree. We work hard to maintain our Trip Advisor Award of Excellence as well as our Yelp 4 star rating. We buy quality ingredients, we price fairly and we strive to provide a great guest service.

name: Pope Phil
text: Shirtsleeve is lit. Fries are lit. Coleslaw was lit. Great place to go for good food. Will always go back!

resp.text: And lit is good, right?  Thank you!

name: Cory Arcovitch
text: Great place to pop in and get a bite. The nachos are amazing. Great burgers too. Service is very friendly.

name: Michele Denault
text: Under whelmed, thier food used to be good, and the waitress skirts were embarssingly short , we were given a free show a couple of times.

resp.text: Hi Michelle, thank you for sharing your experience.  I assure you that we will be reminding our staff of the uniform standards.  I also assure you that the food is still good.  I don't know what your ordered but if you had let us known it was not to your liking, we would have been more than happy to prepare the food again or bring you another item.

name: Carl Sedon
text: Good beer and food. Nice vibe on church st.

resp.text: Thank you, Carl. We appreciate the review and look forward to serving you again soon. (Just for the record, we now have 28 taps of local Vt beer)

name: Christine Fazzio
text: Great food & drinks

resp.text: Thank you Christine, being "great" is our goal!

name: John Depaula
text:
Extremely disappointing. Very little on the menu for vegetarians. I ended up settling for a Caesar Salad - yes, I know it’s not really vegetarian - and the leaves looked as though they were cut up sometime in the previous week, already starting to turn purple at the cut ends and a bit wilted. Not much flavor.
Would not return.

name: Bart Simpson
text: Double bacon burger special was awesome.

resp.text: Hi Barton, thank you for the shout out. We have been running that special daily on our lunch menu and will probably continue to do so until our next menu change, given the rave reviews.

name: Brett Danis
text: Great food local feel and right on Church Street

resp.text: Thank you Brett, we appreciate the acknowledgment and look forward to serving you again soon.

name: Ruth Febo
text: Good veggie burger and sweet potato fries. Great server.

resp.text: Thank you for the review. Having our hard work acknowledged is much appreciated.

name: Patty Coulombe
text: Terrible Food, fish & chips were burned, salad wilted, burger overcooked.

resp.text: Patty, I am not sure of the details of your experience but clearly it was unacceptable.  If you would be so kind as to contact us directly we would love to make amends.  As is evident by our other reviews,  your experience was not the norm.  We are always willing to make things right.  Thank you for understanding and for your patience. Please ask for David.

name: Dean M
text: Steak was on special the night we ate there. Ordered it and it came on a bed of rice. The steak cost $34 and tasted like a $5 flat cube steak. It was so fatty and even more chewy. Rice was undercooked and hard. Waiter didn't really care too much. I'm a local and have eaten here a few times and I think this place is a rip off and a tourist trap. If you want good food for top dollar go to the farmhouse.

resp.text: Hi Dean, I feel comfortable saying that your experience is an anomaly. As is evident by many of our other reviews, Sweetwaters is a favorite of both tourists and locals alike. As I am sure you are aware, a business in our small state can't survive for over 30 years on tourist business alone. In saying that, mistakes do happen and we would be more than happy to make amends. If you could contact the restaurant directly and ask for David that would be great.

name: Dawn Botting
text: Food great eat inside

resp.text: The food is great but the people watching outside is worth it. Our patio seating is aslo pooch friendly. Thank you for the review.

name: Killian Hermann
text: They have Shed on tap, so I like this place. Agree this is generally a tourist trap, but you could do much worse, right across church st, for example. Otherwise pedestrian american fare. Overall acceptable and relatively predictable.  Better menu than they had a few years ago. Lots of seats so a relatively safe bet if you need a place on short notice. Service is adequate but realize this is a college town, so unless you are at a proper restaurant you are dealing with that element.

name: Nick Gruschow
text: Good burger and beer, and generally good  service although a long wait initially.

resp.text: I'm sorry to hear that we initially left you hanging. It sounds as if we were able to make amends? Thank you for your patience.

name: Sylvain Leblanc
text: Not usually our first choice, but since they have more tables than many other restaurants around, it's usually easier to get in on a busy night. That being said, they gave a decent menu and often some good specials.

resp.text: Thank you for the review, Sylvain. Does that mean we are moving up on your choice list?  We are trying!

name: Patrick Woods
text: I tried a salad with pears on it. Muy delicioso.

resp.text: Excellent.   So glad to hear that you enjoyed your experience.

name: Lucky Th13teen
text: Busy night food took a little while but arrived well cooked and delicious

resp.text: Thank you for your patience and the review. We hope to see you again soon.

name: Max Ernst
text:
Ate dinner there last night. The special was short rib, but the only thing special about it was how tough it was. Really disappointed in the food quality.

I'm not the type to send food back, so I didn't say anything but it was really below the standards I've come to expect from Sweetwaters.

I'm pulling for you guys to turn it around.

resp.text: Maximus, we stand behind our food 100%. Any time a menu item is not up to a guest's liking we will replace the item or remove it from the check.

name: Jasmine DeLude
text: The staff is so friendly, and the food is delicious. Also a beautiful atmosphere.

name: Adam Walker
text: Ugh. Underseasoned food blah

resp.text: Hey Adam, certainly hope you said something.  We are always willing to remake or replace anything not prepared to your liking

name: Earl M. Bruder Jr.
text: Good meal

resp.text: Earl, we appreciate the 5 star review.

name: Mar Montero
text: Great food! New York steak is amazing. Try their maple creme brûlée, it's to die for!

name: Lis Oliveira
text: All American Burger was delicious.

resp.text: Lis, we are glad to hear that you enjoyed your burger and thrilled that you shared your 5-star-review experience! We look forward to serving you again soon.

name: Chris Bigg
text: The waitresses were very friendly and the outdoor seating was very nice.  The pulled pork was delicious and the fries were great.

name: Benjamin Saenger
text: Great food and ambiance. Lots of cool architectural details.

name: Diane Stevens
text: Food is very good and desserts are fabulous!!

resp.text: And I would note that the desserts are great for sharing while enjoying an after-dinner cocktail or coffee while people watching. Thank you for the shout out.

name: John Appleseed
text:
I'd be happy with this place if it were in an airport.  In such a food-centric city, this place needs to step it up.

Edit a month or so after initial review: 2 stars to 1 star.  Brought a bunch of friends to town and this was the only place that could accommodate 12 of us on short notice.  Friendly server, but food came out lukewarm, cold, soggy, not cooked to spec or some combination thereof.  Several glasses were not properly clean.  Excessive wait time for food.  Server was quick to replace dirty glasses or offer to re-fire food, but what's the point when half of your group just wants to eat and get on with the day?

Will not be giving this place another chance.

name: Joseph Fusco
text: Great outdoor eatery right on Church Street. Good food and people-watching spot!

resp.text: You can't get a better view of Church St, any time of year. Thanks for dining with us.

name: Corey Gilmore
text: All around good place. Very busy which can sometimes make service slow and iffy. Sit outside if you can.

name: Jarett Chizick
text: The servers are friendly the food is average American fare. Open later than some of the other restaurants on church street & good for a quick meal.

name: Kyle
text: Fun place friendly staff.  Solid Bloody Mary.

name: Penny crosby
text: Awsome service and food

resp.text: We try. Thank you for noticing!

name: Ana Diaz-Caneja
text: The quality of the food and the service is equal, if not better than other "fancier" places in the area for more reasonable prices. Will come back again and again!

name: Lyn
text: Good date night spot, open later which I like. Great drinks!

resp.text:
Yes, the only restaurant on Church St serving until 11:30 PM! Thanks for visiting us.

David

name: Rose Stone
text: Took a second for food to get delivered, but hey, I was in a party of 7. Totally worth the wait, the food was Devine

resp.text: We love when people describe our food as devine.  Thank you, Rose.

name: TJ Jamyang
text: Good food. Right on Church St .

resp.text: Hi TJ, we appreciate the 5 star review and certainly agree that breakfast in front of a river is delightful. Unfortunately, we neither serve breakfast nor are located along a river.

name: Dan Peipert
text: Service was nice but not great. I overheard the manager talking very rudely to his new bar tenders without reason.

name: Yogi Singh
text: Nice food ... I love it

resp.text: Thank you, we love having you as a guest as well!

name: Angelo Saorin
text: Great food, but a little more expensive than the usual.

name: Cindy Phenix
text: Great!  GF options!

resp.text: Thank you Cindy. We get a lot of great guest feedback on our gluten free menu.

name: Blade Sharp
text: The second time here when the wait was ridiculously long and only a few customers in the restaurant.  An old favorite dissapoints!

resp.text: Hi Sharp, I'd love to get some additional information from you such as time, date, etc. And, we'd like to make amends. Please call the restaurant and ask for David. Much appreciated.

name: Drew Gilmore

name: Rick Venne
text: I've been to the Middlebury Hearth before for the bar, which is great, but never to eat. I usually go to the Hearth in Burlington for that. We gathered at the Middlebury location to celebrate a co-worker's 21st birthday. We were not a small group (their was about 18-20 of us) and they had no problem accommodating us, we did call a day ahead though. The ambiance was great, the food was awesome but there were a few glitches with the drink orders, do yourself a favor and order directly from the bartender. Other than that the service was fast and friendly. A fun evening was had by all thanks to American Flatbread.

resp.text: So glad to hear you had a great time!  Your advice was noted and we will be investing more time in our server bar training, as it is helpful to the flow of business if things can go smoothly for you when ordering at your table.  I'm sorry about the glitches and thank you for your patience!

name: Tim Parsons
text: Good pizza, good atmosphere. Cocktails can vary by night, apparently, out maybe the second time was an of night. Would still recommend though.

resp.text: Hi Tim!  Thanks for letting us know what you think of American Flatbread Middlebury Hearth.  May I ask which cocktail you hoped to get but couldn't?  We've hired a new head bartender who is exceptional at creating cocktails (among many other positive traits!) and I'd love to pass your feedback on to her.  As an owner, my feeling is that if we have the ingredients, we can make it!  I look forward to your response, and if you're back in the restaurant when I'm working, I hope you'll say hello! ~Danielle

Great atmosphere and great flatbreads. Amazing weekly specials with surprisingly good combinations of local meats, cheeses and vegetables. Great mixed drinks too.

Cozy in the winter and great outdoor seating for the summer.

name: Chris Mazur
text: Came here for a private party (restaurant was open to public on the other side). Staff was attentive and kept the food and drinks flowing. Atmosphere is friendly, convivial and busy. Would go here for a fun night out.

text: The pizza was amazing,...fennel sausage and fennel topping. Never had such a delicious pizza. Not a place for quick food, worth the wait.

name: D R
text: Fun place. Everything was great except the pizza. Pizza was very bland, the crust and the toppings. Very few toppings on the overpriced pizzas. Good flatbread should have every inch covered in toppings and fresh garlic and other seasonings in the crust. They make theirs like regular round pizza with very little toppings, so it ends up more crust than pizza. Like a burnt cracker with a little bit of ketchup and cheese on it. They also overcook their pizzas, I get it’s wood fired but that does not mean to a crisp. If I went back I would do drinks, boards, and salads, but with the prices I won’t be back I’m not paying that much for mediocre food.

resp.text: Hi Dana-- thanks so much for leaving your review.  It's always good to hear how we're doing.  May I ask which flatbread/s you had while you were here?  Bland is not an adjective we hear about our food very often, so I'd love to have to opportunity to look into where we can improve.  Thanks again for your honest feedback-- I look forward to impressing you with our flatbread some day!  -Danielle

text: I have been here a few times now and each time the food was great! This is an inexpensive place for a quick bite to eat.  They have mostly sandwiches but a few soup and salad options as well.  It can get pretty busy around lunch time on a week day.  They have a cute seating area upstairs that stays nice and toasty even when it is cold outside.  On nicer days, there are a few picnic tables outside and you can sit near the water and watch the falls. Easily within walking distance of the Middlebury farmer's market and "downtown" Middlebury.

text: Several years ago I ate here at least once a week because my office was next door. Their sandwiches are huge and filling and very good. In the last few years though I haven't gone much because of inconvenience but also partly because they moved to a new electronic menu that's difficult to read and they seem to have trouble retaining employees who are good at customer service. Perhaps that'sa hint that they need to do a better job at training said employees. The quality of the food isn't worth the hassle anymore to deal with these issues, especially when I'm trying to eat healthier.

name: Chris Mazur
text: First time here. Staff was quick, efficient, friendly, and helpful. Got the Noonie's BLT and it was great. Asked for some substitute and it was no problem. Sandwich was huge enough that it, a bag of chips and a pickle made a meal for two.

name: Cameron Hay
text:
Wow. That was one of the best sandwiches I have ever eaten. I tried the Bernie 'Sanders-wich' and it was amazing. For the size, it was well worth the price too (which was competitive with chains like Subway and 100 times better tasting). The place was mobbed for a Sunday at lunch-time, but I completely understand why. They have plenty of seating between upstairs and outside, with a few seats on the main level. It is in a very quaint area of Middlebury (the MarbleWorks) and it very accessible. I can't wait to go back here again.

Another note, I went with 3 other people and all of the sandwiches (including the one on gluten-free bread) looked amazing and (so I am told) tasted delicious.

name: Parker Hoblin
text: I got the Bernie, it was life affirming. Go get a sandwich that will fill you up at Noonie's!

name: Jessica Herriman
text: Noonie's has some really great sandwiches.  They have fresh ingredients and freshly baked bread that is absolutely delicious.  They have lots of choices including vegetarian options, soups, desserts and (non-alcoholic) beverages.  The food is good and the staff are very efficient.  That being said this place is not very accessible for wheelchairs.  They have one small table downstairs and the rest of the tables and the restroom are on the second floor.  The second floor is more of a loft that is in need of some new carpeting and updates.  Noonie's also offers delivery services but they are hit or miss with the deliveries.  I absolutely reccomend Noonies but I pick it up and eat elsewhere.

AVOID AT ALL COSTS

---

name: Kris Jarrett
text:
Second visit, October, 2019: The menu was smaller and far less interesting; dishes all very similar and clearly catering to the gluten free and vegan crowd with all but one item being gf. Those limitations, imposed either by the market or ownership, shows in the mostly boring and simplistic menu and flavors now offered. At least there was no live music this time. If you wish to indulge your psychosomatic gluten allergy at $30 a plate, enjoy.

First visit: Four out of five of our party had the burger and it was excellent, but it should be for a $20 burger. The fries were very good; a small thing, but a nice detail. Starters were decent, the mussels tasty, as were the clams. Pear and cheese flatbread was nice. The cheese plate was good, but rather sparse. In general everything was a bit overpriced for the quality. I would not recommend they reduce prices; the space is small and tabs need to be on the high side to make a go of it, just improve the quality to match the prices.

The real downside of the dinner was the music. Very out of place blues music of questionable quality and at a conversation spoiling high volume.

text: Wife and I stopped in on a lark and had an enjoyable experience on a Sunday night.  Many eateries can have an off night on Sunday evenings - these guys were on.  Service was great.  Our crab cakes (shared app) was good - just a couple flakes of shell which wasn't too much of an issue.  I had their Pad Thai which was excellent.  My wife had a shrimp/rice dish which she thoroughly enjoyed.  She asked for spicy...and got it.  I'm a fan of thoughtful, compact wine lists and they have one here.  They pretty much touch all the bases from regions, varietals and blends and a good breadth of textures.  They are expensive...but our QPR at the end of a lovely day in Midd made it a worthwhile indulgence.

Breakfast sandwich and a wrap, plus some drinks, snacks and ice cream.   The food was great.  The gals making our food were fun and friendly.  Asked all our crazy questions too.

Would have been a five star, but one of the cartons of Wilcox ice cream is inedible.  Not sure if it was in the freezer too long or in Wilcox's freezer too long, but it was freezer burned and gross.

We will definitely go back.  Super charming place and lots of fun candies that took us back many, many years.  Poprocks for one.  Haven't seen those since the 80's.

(Translated by Google) A motorcycle break in rustic Vermont but no toilets for guests!

Motorbike break in the middle of the afternoon on July 23, 2019. We bought only enough to drink. We deplore the fact that there was no toilet for the guests which we consider very disrespectful and unacceptable on the part of this monopoly trade in this small mountain village at the intersection of the picturesque road 100 and of the 125. Me and a friend found a small corner in the parking opposite to relieve us but what to think of the people of the feminine when they have an emergency? It would be nice if the owners see it. The gallon of regular gas was $ 3.49. We have two photos to share with you.

Reviewed July 28, 2019 at Salaberry de Valleyfield, Quebec, Canada.

(Original)
Une pause moto dans le Vermont rustique mais sans toilettes pour les clients !

Pause moto au milieu de l’après-midi su 23 juillet 2019.  Nous y avons acheté que de quoi se désaltérer. Nous déplorons le fait qu’il n’y avait pas de toilettes pour les clients ce que nous considérons très irrespectueux et inacceptable de la part de ce commerce  ayant le monopole dans ce petit village de montagne à l’intersection de la pittoresque route 100 et de la 125. Moi et un copain avons trouvé un petit coin dans le stationnement en face pour nous soulager mais que penser des personnes de la gente féminine quand elles ont une urgence ? Ce serait bien que les propriétaires y voient.  Le gallon d’essence ordinaire était à $3.49.  Nous avons deux photos à vous partager.

text: Was really hoping when I heard this was opening that we were getting a nice butcher shop or a grocery store with later hours. No on both fronts, doesn’t have anything you can’t get for cheaper at the other 3 grocery stores in town. Worse selection. A lot of workers too for some reason most of which seemed to just be standing around doing nothing.

name: Henry Romp
text: So, I was really happy to see this place open again, and it's right near my house, so I was walking over every morning to get breakfast. Their breakfast sandwiches are delicious; I had a bacon egg & cheese on a round roll every morning for three days in a row -- always around the same time of day, just after 11am. The only reason for the four-star review (instead of five) is that this morning, at the usual time, I walked over to get breakfast, made my order in the same way as I had for the last three days in a row, and when they brought it to me, instead of it being wrapped in tinfoil and saying $2.89 on it, it was wrapped in white deli paper and said $5.89 on it. I figured it was just a mistake, so I pointed it out and commented, "I got the same sandwich yesterday for $2.89, I'm just confused about why the price is different today." The lady behind the counter told me "well, it's lunch time, and it was a special order, and it has two proteins, so, *shrug*"... So, I said "Ok, thanks, have a nice day!" and paid for my sandwich. But really, it wasn't fair; same sandwich, same time of day, everything was the same except for the price. I'm kinda sad, because I had planned to go buy breakfast there every morning, but if it's going to be at whatever price they feel like, and depend on who is behind the counter, it's not going to work out. I will still do my grocery shopping there, they have my favorite kind of beer (Harpoon Rec League, which is not available at the Beverage Center or at Shaws) and they're very convenient. But I'm kinda bummed out about the breakfast sandwich situation.

name: Cameron Hay
text:
Went the morning of the 4th of July to get a mattress. My wife and I just moved to the area and were upgrading to a king-sized bed. Not knowing what selection would be available, we had planned a budget of at most $1800 dollars (based on the many mattresses online that Mattress Firm advertised that were below that price.

We definitely went over that. Now, you might wonder why the 5 star rating still?

That would be John. John is awesome. He treats you with respect and does his best to get you a great price on the best mattress. There were only 2 king mattresses in stock the day we went, and we wanted to try out the mattress before purchasing it (as it is a hefty investment). Determined to get a mattress, and both of them being well above our budget, we almost left to go elsewhere. That's when John comes in. He worked his magic, utilized some deals going on at the time, and got us some huge savings. While we did end up spending nearly $800 more than our desired price (with delivery), we absolutely love our mattress 2+ months in.

name: Carolyn Pereira
text: Found an awesome mattress from a kind and knowledgeable salesman... welcoming and comfortable environment. However, all the upsells and extra costs that were added on once we decided to buy really made the experience less enjoyable for me. I was super excited going in, and although I do think we got the best mattress, I left with a bit of a bad taste in my mouth as far as expectations being ruined by fine print, sale exclusions, never ending upsells, and "oops, did I forget to mention delivery cost an extra $150 after I told you on the phone that delivery was free".... i'm not sure if I would reccomend them or not. It was great to be able to lay on beds, and get all our questions answered,  but if you are wondering if maybe you should just buy online instead, as long as you know the type of mattress and the firmness you like, online might not be a bad option. You don't save much, if anything, by going in store.... even during the "biggest sales".

Finally went here for lunch this past weekend. I was very pleased with my meal and the atmosphere. They have a very large menu, with plenty of options for picky and outgoing eaters alike. A pleasant surprise was the salad bar, which was delicious and reasonably priced. For $3.95 on top of a meal purchase, it was well worth it (the maple vinaigrette dressing was awesome!). Our food selections were a bison burger, a steak and cheese sandwich, and a cuban sandwich. All were very good.

We had no issues getting a table for 3 as the restaurant is a good size. That said, I imagine a Friday night might get very busy and there could be a wait.

text: An excellent restaurant right on the water in Middlebury. Whether it's for a family meal or for a pleasant night drinking, this is the pub to go to for a relaxed but welcoming atmosphere. As to food, the burgers are great, the appetizers appetizing, the French fries wonderfully crispy, and the rest of the menu quite well varied. Indeed, there is something for everyone at this restaurant. The salad bar is also a must for a quick visit. My only real complaint is that the chedsar at the bar isn't as sharp as my Northern Vermont taste buds would prefer, but I understand that they need to appeal to a broad base. There's a reason why I bring my wife here every year for her birthday, and will continue doing so.

text:
I love this marketplace. The atmosphere is wonderful. The shops are fun. I miss the farmers market in the park, but maybe they'll finish the park and let it return. Lake Champlain Chocolates is a local treasure. Earthbound Trading is a great store, helpful and friendly staff. Plenty of coffee options. Tea shops. Gift stores. Candy store. Maple places.

Need a little adult time, the distillery tasting up a few stores from Ben and Jerry's has samples. $4 for 4 or 5 different types of the best liquors/liqueurs ever. Great addition to a grown-up tour. There are Ramen shops, soup places tight off Church St. The New Moon Cafe has great salads and sandwiches. Also their Maple mocha is delectable. Easy to work with dietary restrictions.

Warm weather, it's a great place to walk. Cooler weather, there's usually pretty lights up above. Dress warmly.

Ah, what else. Quarterstaff game store. Ye nerds. Get ye there hence. And the comic book store is right below, so what are you waiting for.

Outdoor musicians up and down the street. Say hi to John.  Folk singing at its best.  Great time.

Have in mentioned this is one of my favorite places???

There is a parking garage that you can access from Bank St, or Cherry St. They have free 2 hour parking, and otherwise reasonable parking fees. Also they have free park on Sundays.

Otherwise parking is limited to metered street side parking.

Short walk to the waterfront.

Church Street is one of the quintessential Burlington experiences. A wide variety of stores and restaurants line the pedestrian walkway, including a local favorite Outdoor Gear Exchange, the place to go for outfitting.
Business level depends on time. Summertime Saturday afternoons are generally quite busy, whereas a winter evening much less so.
If you're in town, pop by for a walk through.

name: Nate Merrill
text:
Church Street (and Burlington in general) is wrapped up in all sorts of emotions for me, both positive and negative.
Having spent my high school, college and some adult time here, I have lots of memories- honestly, too many memories.
It is hard to see anything or go anywhere and not have some kind of personal history. And the many changes to the city over the last 30+ years adds another layer of emotions.

Burlington has all of its hip (-ster) charm and college friendly vibe made more appealing to the tourist masses with the addition of many chic (chain) stores and trendy restaurants.
Almost daily there are special events on and around the Street: festivals of all sorts. The weekly farmer's market is filled with all natural fancy stuff, hand made fancy stuff and fancy people talking about, tasting and buying fancy stuff.
So, if you love to shop and eat and spend money and engage in mindless banter with other elite consumers of the liberal dream... come to Church Street- Burlington, Vermont.
Enjoy.

name: Ryan Calvi
text: When i think of Burlington, one place that comes to my mind is Church Street.   It is an outdoor public walking mall with multiple small shops and restaurants.  It is a four block outdoor pedestrian mall.  That is very similar to Pearl Street in Boulder, Colorado, they were both designed by the same firm.  The southern aspect of the mall contains mostly restaurants, and the middle two have many different retailers, from Lake Champlain Chocolate, Outdoor Gear Exchange, Homeport.  It is always worth a visit when in Burlington, on top of that there is usually plenty of free (2 hour) parking in the attached Marketplace Garage.

The Burlington Police keep this local treasure in good check with friendly, helpful officers. The new Burlington Towne Center project is going to add such excitement to this area of the city. The picture below was taken by Adam Silverman and is not Christmas, but the Winterfest.

name: Veronica Bills
text: Church Street Marketplace is the hear of Burlington, the Queen City. If you're new to Vermont or just 'driving through,' it is a must see! I've visited at ALL hours, night and day. There are many restaurants, bars, local shops, art boutiques, and more. There are live performances from local artists/musician/performers. It's great to walk up and down the street, or sit on a bench, people watch, whatever floats your boat. It's very serene in the wee hours of the morning, and begins to become more and more populated aroun 7am-8am. A really wonderful event is when they light the 'Holiday' lights, and particularly beautiful when a cover of snow is present. What can I say? "ILOVERMONT" 😁 I was born and raised in the beautiful state, and for me leaving there is no debate. IT'S GREAT! I will stay. Forever and a day. 😉

Late evening bars start opening up for that scene mostly on the south end with a few mid way and on the north side. Oh,  Church Street Marketplace,  with your cool stores,  fantastic street performers,  food vendors,  bustling crowds and twinkling tree lights. I've strolled through groovy pedestrian malls on six continents and you,  Church Street Marketplace,  you're my fave.
Are you from out of town? The one issue you may face is finding a bathroom. During daytime hours,  go to the ground floor of City Hall.  And City Market,  a block over on Winooski and open late,  has clean,  easily accessible bathrooms too. You can also go into the mall,  but I make no promises as to cleanliness.

text:
Tourist destination with plenty of people asking for spare change.

Church Street, while it has some great eateries, is primarily a destination for tourists. Finding parking is hit or miss (mostly miss) and the eclectic nature of the area makes for some interesting people watching.

Certainly check it out if you have never been, but overall it is an experience I try to avoid these days.

name: B-Trone Skapown
text:
A lot of shops to browse in, great Christmas lights brighten the road at night, and the biggest selection of bars in VT.
PIZZA= Kens or Big Daddy's.
BREAKFAST = Handys Diner or drive to the Parkway Diner in South Burlington. HAMBURGER = Farmhouse (most expensive but worth it), Beansies bus (best view to walk around) or the shopping bag's "Sizzler" (the biggest and messiest).
SANDWICH = Henry St Deli gives you huge portions for 6 or 7 bucks. Get a small, or share a large.
BEER = The Farmhouse, or any of the breweries within walking distance. Switchback is really nice and near Oakledge Park.
COFFEE = uncommon grounds or muddy waters.
THRIFTING = old gold.
ICE CREAM= Ben and Jerry's or Blue Bird café. Or walk down college St. to the waterfront and stop at Burlington Bay on your way.
MUSIC = Nectars/Club Metronome has some elbow room with a variety of music and different styles depending on the day of the week (reggae night, metal Mondays, bluegrass night etc.), Radio Bean is intimate but fun. Arts riot, the Flynn space (large), Red Square has an alley off church st with a stage in the early evening.
POOL = Three Needs has the best tables and atmosphere like a ski lodge. RJ's has free pool on a beat up table but don't go on the weekends when it's packed. Mr. Mike's has a table and good pizza.
BARCADE = The Archives or Tilt in South Burlington on Shelburne Rd.
SUNSET = Battery Park and Oakledge Park are my favorite. Oakledge is farther but worth it. Go behind the gazibo to the rocky peninsula or into the wooded area on the dirt paths to the small cliffs (park for free in the neighborhood with the white apartments to the left of the enterence to the park or take the bikepath from downtown).

In many ways this short strip of green is a more true representation of Burlington heart than any pedestrian street cum glorified shopping mall.

After grabbing a creemee at Burlington bay (raspberry maple) or drinking an excellent beer at foam you can walk around this well tended park to watch the dogs or the slack liners or the picknickers or those with nothing better to do than play either gangster rap or country music from tinny speakers (there are no alternatives I've ever heard).
For better or for worse it's the truth of Burlington, and more often than not, it's for the better.

name: Linda Anderson
text: I had not been to Waterfront Park in quite a while, and recently got the chance due to my daughters college graduation cruise. I dropped her off at the "Spirit of Ethan Allen" dock, and chose to stay in Burlington to sightsee. The weather was magnificent, but to me, any weather is beautiful by the water. May in Burlington, Vt is stunning- everything is that wonderful luscious green that heralds rebirth after a long winter. Leaves are bursting from branches, the electric purple of the rhododendron provide explosions of colour. The water was a mirror glass, reflecting clouds, sunlight, pylons, the pier....The rich blues of the Adirondacks framed all. I am a photographer and painter, so I took advantage of this natural beauty- and to reflect on the immensity of this amazing lake- Lake Champlain. If you like people watching, this is the place for you- I was a bit overwhelmed at first, but it also was the University of Vermont graduation, so an even bigger crowd was at hand. I walked up College St to Church St for some goodies and shopping- although many stores were closed by this time (6:30pm). I walked back down to the waterfront to watch and photograph the sunset! Just incredible- the light and shadows,  the buoy lights coming on, the boathouse and dock lights coming on- There are concession stands that sell drinks and portable  goods, parking is not too bad, and the Echo Center is also located there. If you choose the daytime for a visit, go the the Echo Center, a lake science museum that is definitely  worth a looksee. Waterfront park is a must when visiting Burlington!

text:
Expensive and touristy but who cares: it's clean, well-stocked with local goodies, and everyone is friendly and helpful.

The price here goes to the donuts, which I only recently discovered and will now have to talk myself out of on a weekly basis. Wow. Like WOW. do yourself a favor and get the maple bacon one. Holy good God.

They have all kinds of delicious VT goodies like wine and maple everything. Their cider is awesome and the cider donuts are worth the trip. During the fall they have pumpkins and all kinds of seasonal items and activities.

text:
The Apple barn used to be a place for families to get some yummy treats buy some apples & cider and have FUN!

text:
When I travel north to the great state of Vermont, I always make it a point to stop here to use the rest rooms, stretch my legs, and grab some snacks from the vending machines for the rest of the journey.
The facilities here have always been immaculate, every time I have been here.
The people here are friendly and knowledgeable.  There is plenty of room to park and I don't feel like my car and it's contents are in any danger  of being stolen while I'm inside.
Overall, it is a nice place inside as well as outside.

text: Great welcome center. We have driven all over the country and this has to be in the top 5. Interesting displays, warmer months feature local organizations selling home made beverages and snacks.  Ground for a picnic and rockers for a relaxing break from the road.

text: This is a beautiful Welcome Center in an attractive building. name: Daryl Lucas
text: Authorities have done a good job of organizing the center for the pandemic -- well-marked lanes and spacing. I give this high marks under the circumstances.
