name: Kevin Clancy
text: This a beautiful  welcoming  center.

name: Tony Boncore
text: As we entered southern Vermont we were happy to see the Guilford Welcome Center.  Perfectly located in a wooded area off the highway.  A very clean environment and well attended by Vermont's best folks.  After stretching our legs and a splash of cool water on my face, we continued our journey north to the Killington area for a long weekend with friends. If you need a break from driving, be sure and take advantage of the Guilford Welcome Center.

name: April Smith
text: Stopped to visit the Living Machine, which is no longer there. Clean and beautiful welcome center with lovely little walking areas, though disappointed it's not as sustainable. Delighted that the Living Machine is now at the Sharon, Vermont rest area!

name: William Mis
text: Very clean and always a good place to take a quick break and stretch before completing your journey.

name: Justin Lawliss
text:
This rest stop was actually really nice. I wish all rest stops were like this one.
Plenty of parking for both cars, vehicles towing trailers and full sized trucks. I had my dog in the car and there was plenty of grass for him to get out and get a few minutes of exercise.  Many pick-nick tables to sit at as well.

name: Chris Morgan
text: Great stop for everybody entering Vermont, the Beautiful post and beam building is gorgeous, all the local artists and Craftsman they have work displayed for all to see, employees sitting at the front desk to help guide you to where you are headed. Huge parking lot, and lots of vending machines for Beverages and snacks. The brick walkways and all the trees and plants just add to the look and feel of this Vermont building. Restrooms are spotless and not a speck of dirt on the floors, I give this place 10 Stars just for the cleanliness. I highly recommend just swinging on in.

resp.text: Thanks very much for the nice review. Thank you for taking the time to describe our center. Have a great weekend.

text: A necessary stop on the road, restrooms are clean. Wish Vermont would get proactive and add some hot food vendors to rest stops. A bag of crisps and energy drinks aren't the most appealing choices at 9 PM for food...

name: April Smith
text: Clean and attractive rest area. Sad that they no longer have the Living Machine. (Though you can now find that amazing green system at the Sharon Vermont rest area, which is well worth the visit!)

name: Shane White
text: We always love stopping here when we have the chance. Everything about it is awesome, because... Vermont

name: D Smith
text: Very clean rest area, even the bathrooms. Lots of good photo options. They also have a selection of local crafts that are very well made.

name: Eric Horgan
text: Great place to stop especially if you haven't been to Vermont before. There is a lot of information available in the form of pamphlets, leaflets etc on what to do and where to stay. There is also a manned information desk in the foyer which will probably be your first port of call, where the staff seem very knowledgeable and helpful. In the summer months, there are lots of different places to sit outside in the shade (or not) and enjoy the view. There are a number of machines that offer you the usual small snack bars and drinks. There are also some displays of local crafts and in addition a display given over to the building of I-91 through Vermont which one gathers was a highly controversial subject at the time of it's construction. Don't miss reading this - I'm sure there were similar agonising stories throughout the country during the era of the construction of the interstate freeway system where farms were split and houses demolished to make way for what we so take for granted today.

text: This is a large and fantastic multi-dealer shop, certainly one of the best in Vermont.  Convenient location about 10 minutes off I-89 or I-91.  Plenty of parking. LOVE this place! Always find something different and unique every time I go. Soooooo many different items to peruse, some fairly or cheaply priced, others overpriced. Many sellers discount prices on items that have been there a while. Staff are attentive and offer to take things to the front for you. When checking out, everyone has always been friendly and respectful of the items you're buying.

I definitely recommend this place. There's a lot to look at, with some items in the basement as well. I've gotten a beaver pelt top hat and some lovely antlers with the skull cap, a repurposed lamp from an old heater, and lots of old books and Victorian prints.

Plus it's right next to the Cabot tasting station, some other small shops, a diner,  and llamas! Just down from queechee gorge. What more could you ask for???

One of the common answers we have for customers is that we apply the third wave roasting regime, which is on a lighter scale, more balanced taste, compares to overly roasted beans as from some of the other mega-large coffee shops. The live music they had was at a good volume, not overwhelming, and the performance was really well done.

name: Marty Gleason
text: First of all, kudos to Zenbarn for doing online reservations.  This was a huge help in getting a table for a large party on short notice.  I also picked Zenbarn on the strength of some good word of mouth recommendations.  It was a bit hectic when we got there because of the Vermont Jazz Ensemble performance, but we enjoy jazz so that worked out fine.  The service, food and drinks all lived up to the recommendations.

resp.text: So glad you had a good time!  Yes, our monthly 16-piece jazz band show is pretty unique... we try to inform everyone what's going on, but most are pleasantly surprised when they come in and see this happening... they've been at this for over 40 years and features some of Vermont's top players!  Our website is up-to-date with all the happenings so next time feel free to check out our calendar to decide if you want a quiet dinner or live music night.  Hope to you again soon!

resp.text: Hi Greyson  - we're sorry you were disappointed with the seitan being cut... we're actually working on some more vegan/veg friendly ideas that we think will be even better... in terms of service, we'd love know some details so we can improve as we're always working on that. We were all very disappointed with the appetizers and promptly left to enjoy dinner elsewhere.

resp.text: Hi Stephen - really sorry that you had such an awful experience at our establishment.  We aim to have every guest leave with a great feeling and we clearly failed you.  Just so you know this was a pop up mexican night with some local friends guest cheffing - and doesn't reflect our normal menu. However we still stand by the food and would be happy to refund you for any parts you were not satisfied with.  I assure you that every thing was made from scratch and a lot of love and effort went into every dish.   I wish you and your family the best on the rest of your visit to our small town and please let me know if I can do anything to leave you with a better feeling about your night.

name: Christopher Lei
text:
This place is definitely an asian fusion place. You have items such as ramen, banh mi, yakitori to name a few. I ordered a ramen and my wife ordered a banh mi. The noodles didn't taste homemade, but weren't bad. There was also only one piece of pork belly. The broth itself wasn't anything special. My biggest complaint about the ramen is that like most places in VT who offer ramen, they also need to have  kaedama as an option. My wife enjoyed her banh mi. It looked more like a Vermont-ified version than a traditional banh mi.

Overall, happy a place like this exists in Waterbury, exposes people to asian cuisine, but def. not authentic at all.

resp.text: Hi Christopher, thanks so much for your feedback!  Our concept is in fact a "Vermontified" global/Asian inspired cuisine.  Our chef has a passion for Asian cooking, and also brings in local ingredients and flavors from Vermont.  The noodles are from Sun Noodle Co., which we felt was the best product we could find.  We strive to honor the traditions these foods come from, while also acknowledging we are not a traditional Japanese/Asian restaurant.  We hope that indeed people are exposed to some fun, new flavors and get excited to learn more about other cuisines and cultures beyond our borders.  We're glad your wife enjoyed the Banh Mi and hope you come back in sometime to try us again.  Thanks again for the feedback... we are always striving to get better and hope we can get you to 5-stars next time!

text: I so wanted to love this restaurant. Got there for lunch, we were seated after standing in the hallway for 15 minutes. Restaurant was at about 60% seating capacity with only one waiter trying to serve every single table! So we waited a about 15 minutes for the waiter to take our order for appetizer, main course, and dessert. Then about 30 minutes for our food and appetizers to arrive piece meal. I ordered my chicken tikka masala spiced hot. It arrived bland and not spicy at all. I must admit after I dumped a bunch of salt into it the flavor was acceptable. We never got our bread and had to chase the waiter around the restaurant twice, like Sherlock Holmes, to help us solve the mystery of the missing bread. He said he had no clue why it wouldn't come out and that he was getting so overwhelmed because he couldn't handle how many tables we occupied. Customers were wanting water refills, looking to be seated, etc...was a complete mess and to top it off people were leaving and dirty tables started spreading through the restaurant. This one lady emerged from the back in a cook outfit, she looked around and walked straight out of the restaurant to go have a cigarette. Once we were about done with our mains, he brought our bread over and said "sorry it arrived so late I'll take it off your bill". We then waited about 20 more minutes for our check. He comes over and drops the check on our table and says..."do you still want your dessert?". I just handed him my credit card and said please ring out what we got so we can get out of here. All set with with Nepali Kitchen.

name: Tim White
text: All-around decent place for some pub food. One weird thing though is the booth seating. The seats are so low that you can rest your chin on the table top. It's a bit off-putting, so ask for a high top  or table unless you're 7' tall or more. The food is good, the beer is cold, the service is good, the prices are reasonable.

name: Joseph Normand
text:
Previous review. Liked the bar and patio area. Beer selection is very good, the reason I go 90% of the time. The food I have had there is your typical bar food, not bad at all. The employees were friendly and efficient. I will go back again, probably to drink a pint.
Went back: service was okay, bartender or waiter messed up beer orders, but fixed them. Food was very meh. Meh^2. Onion rings were way overcooked. Wrap was nothing to brag about. Boneless wings were chicken-flavored-cardboard. Remotes for booth TVs don’t work correctly. Could be a great place with good management/leadership.

name: Adam Huff
text: The atmosphere is casual (I saw families), and there are some nooks for people to stay out of crowds. Some TVs are on the walls. Parking is tough to find. Food is standard pub fare, with about 20 beers on tap (as I recall). For my visit the service was so-so: the waitstaff was friendly, and they graciously split the check for a large party, but they weren't great about clearing old dishes. We started seeing how high we could stack our empty pint glasses before someone noticed. My fish and chips was raw in the middle, and they replaced it but didn't offer to comp any part of the bill. I had to ask before they finally did.

name: Robert Rockhtar
text: I've only and Vermont for just over year. This was the best dining out experience I've had since I've been here! The atmosphere, service and food were all outstanding.

name: Tracy F.
text: McG Essex can be hit or miss. Past visits have been fine. This weekend was a miss. They were clearly overwhelmed with meals taking an hour to arrive. No one, including the parents, were taking steps to stop kids in the booth on the other side of the divider wall from scaling it and the sitting on it and staring at people on the other side. Beers were starting to warm by the time they finally arrived. It ended up being an unpleasant visit this time. Hopefully, more staff get added to eliminate the staffing issues.

name: Craig Colburn
text: We had a reunion of sorts. The place was busy, but they mostly got our vibe and paced our food and drink accordingly.  Everything was not perfect,  but i think we mightve been a "difficult " group. Not (too) obnoxious,  just staggered orders.  Final 4 games. Good sports, good food, great drinks.  Very good night for a reunion!

name: Michael Jadczak
text: Huge draft selection! Superior wings.  Nice wait staff.

name: Jim W
text: Very good.  I had the meatloaf and thought is was pretty good.  Service was perfectly paced and friendly.

name: Thomas Isabelle
text: Great food. Nice atmosphere. Good service and fair prices. Went here with my wife and a couple who are friends of ours, to meet and talk. Felt there was enough privacy for good conversation. A great meeting place!

name: Kevin Donley
text: top tier

name: Joseph Stevenson
text: It's a very good atmosphere. The food was good. I think it's definitely worth checking out.

name: phatstax2011
text: I don't know how this place is in the winter,  but it definitely is great for outside dining in nice weather.  The food, while mainly limited to pub fare, is rather delicious with ample portions.  The waitstaff is quite friendly, too. The only thing that might be off-putting to out-of-towners is their very strange entryways.  You have to go through a strange,  dark and desolate corridor from the parking lot to find your way to the bar and dining room.  If it weren't for the signage, you might think that you entered the wrong place.  One thing though that I truly despise about this place and any of our local pubs in general, however,  is the massive televisions that litter virtually every flat surface in the whole place.  I've always felt that television watching is best done at home and fail to understand how anyone could even remotely enjoy watching it with the sound off.  I just find them archaic and distracting because if you need to know that big game's score, you probably already have a device in your pocket that can find out for you. But whatever, go ahead and subject the rest of us to your sports addiction.

name: Bill Patton
text: Good meatloaf lunch. Could have been warmer when served and the mashed potatoes were a bit dry.

name: Dean M
text: I visited the new location in Essex Junction and it was pretty good. Food was tasty and affordable, waitstaff was friendly and attentive. The lighting is very dim, but it's a pub so that's to be expected. LOTS of TVs to watch sports. Maybe more than buffalo wild wings. Nice joint to come watch a football game and have a cold one with the boys, or treat the family to dinner on Saturday night as well.

name: Blake Stophenberg
text: One of the best priced, best tasting and best service local food chains in the area. I highly suggest any burgers on the menu. Also - their game day wings are absolutely amazing. They make homemade ranch too which is fantastic and fresh. Sometimes their Fry's are a little soggy, and the waiters dont check on you. But the price and taste weighs out and negatives by far.

name: John Sonnick
text: Good food, great beer list, fast service.  It's a nice, big space, so you can usually find a seat.  I've been back a number of times and have always gotten something different and been very satisfied.

name: Stan Payne
text: About a week ago, my girlfriend and I were going to watch the Boston Bruins game at this location.  When we came in, we waited 5 minutes for the host to show up at the podium. When she finally showed up, she got us a booth and gave us a menu. We were sitting in the booth going through the menu as we were only going to get drinks and appetizers. We waited more than 15 minutes at the booth expecting to be served and about three waitresses completely ignored us and walked past our booth as we didn't exist. We left after 15 minutes of waiting and was appalled at how horrible the customer service was that night at this location. I would NEVER set foot in this location again.

name: T L
text: Good local sports bar with great burgers, and a ton of beers on tap. Great place to catch the game, especially if your looking for out of region games.

name: Christopher Lei
text:
Went here recently to watch a game on the TV. Ordered the fish and chips. My expectations weren't too high as this being a sports bar. However, the fish was cooked perfectly and was smooth and silky. Also different than most places that offer fish and chips was the batter. Instead of huge chunks of fried batter, this was more of a thin crust around the fish.

Nice sports bar for the junction area, also offering a lot of Vermont craft beers.

name: Peggy Pearson
text: Their burgers are thick and tasty. It's nice to be able to get a side salad instead of fries. Service is great.

name: Mark Madison
text: Our choral group, Solaris, recently invaded McGillicuddy's on a Saturday night and we were not disappointed. It's pretty tough to put about 40 people in a room, assign one waitress to that party and have everything go smoothly. But go smoothly it did, and that waitress was amazing. She didn't know how to say "no, we don't have that or no we can't do that". Now that's what I'm talking about. We'll be back.

name: Faron Boreham
text: Great wings and brew selection!

name: Ted Horton
text: Good food. Liked the Sunday evening deal.

name: DAVID COMSTOCK
text: The food was good, location was a bit challenging from traffic noise at five corners. Very pleasant inside. Staff was very courteuous and the order was completed correctly and promptly at expected temperatures. Would recommend for a casual Meetup with friends or a family dinner.

name: Al Getler
text: Nice, new place in Essex Junction. Parking was not easy. The atmosphere was upbeat and the TV screens for sports were 5 star including a TV in our booth. The food was good, but not "special". When you advertise an Irish pub atmosphere, I like to go away feeling like the place went the extra mile to create a unique food and customer experience. That said, I would recommend this place for a family meal, meeting old friends, watching a game, or just catching a Guinness at the bar.

name: joseph poulin
text: Food ok, ok beer selection. Good TV selection for sports.

name: Magali DG
text: Good burger. Good local beer selection. Great sports bar.

name: Mark Gregoire
text: Service is alright. Waitress was great. Food was alright.

name: Joshua Cozzens
text: They were out of Reubens and the lobster roll had no flavor, the Reuben is usually really good, probably why they were out.

name: Lisa Kapoor
text: Food was good, service was slow

name: SPACEMAN
text: Service was pretty slow even though it was quiet on a Saturday afternoon. And the outside patio is not all that you would think/want being right by the 5 corners intersection

name: Brenda Astillero
text: Good food good staff always a good meal.

name: Francis Marks
text: My favorite place on Sunday after church. Can't beat 1/2 price wings

name: D Max
text: I've been there a couple times for meetings. The waitstaff is very polite, and the food is great. They also have a great selection of local beers.

name: John Strout
text: Good sports pub fare. There is a TV everywhere you look which can be a bit distracting. My wings were small and overdone. The rest of the food was very good.

name: Mike Reno
text: Great food

name: TJ Jamyang
text: Recently moved near by. Stopped in for the first time with my gf and sister.  We asked for outside seating. And host seated us outside.  Waited about 20mins. No one came to table.. 3 or 4 young waitress walked by. Not a single word.  Its Sunday night around 8.pm. Not very busy.  Family of 8 to 10 on 2table and another table with couple.. Rest all the tables are empty.  We  got up and left.  Will never go back again.

name: Sean Leonardi
text: Wide beer selection, great wings and app options.

name: Sean
text: Mcgillicuddys has great food and great service. Food is always consistent and tastes great. They have local grass fed burgers and a great variety of menu items. They also have one of the largest selections of local brews anywhere around. As a google guide I would highly recommend them to try.

name: Mike Vining
text: The one at Five Corners in Essex has the worst food.  Everything tastes and looks like it came direct out of the microwave and from a can.  Wings were good,  beer selection was pretty good too. I'd recommend going to the one in Williston or Colchester,  avoid the one in Essex like the plague.

name: Jefre Palmer
text: Sunday afternoon  Stopped in for my first visit  Sad. Very sad. Wait staff was apathetic and disinterested in the customers.  Food was not stellar and the few beers I chose were all 'sorry we're out of that'.  Not sure if I will come back.  Atmosphere was a bit depressing. Clientele was predominantly overweight men who had nothing more to do than drink and offer opinion on football. Business was not particularly busy, so uncertain as to why service was so disconnected from the occupancy.

name: Keith Pillsbury
text: If you love Irish food and drinks, this is the place for you. The staff is very friendly and responsive. We were there St Patrick's Day for a wonderful  lunch with free teeshirts (not expected).

name: Kathy Connolly
text: Good food and service. Comfortable seating.

name: James Guiel
text: Simply would not recommend.

name: rj r
text: Great service. Good food. Lots of televisions on all the walls and even in each booth. Keep the kids in a trance and enjoy their wide selection of beers in peace.

name: Rick F
text: Disappointing. My wife and I ordered two beers. After sometime waiting, longer than you should have to wait (12 minutes+), we received the wrong beers. I ordered the fish and chips with Switchback batter...."waitress said they didn't have it"...."it was still frozen". Keep in mind this is Saturday night at dinner time (6pm). So I ordered a Guinness marinated burger with "signature blend of spices".....I got a regular, plain old burger. If there is anything good to say it was the wait time was quick and the clam chowder was actually pretty good. We will not be returning.

name: EP Vt
text: Great food. Great service. We will be back.

name: Michael Michaelson
text: Service was great!, food not so much this time. I ordered soup of the day(bacon cheeseburger) it literally tasted like someone took a fully cooked cheeseburger with a pickle and tossed it in a blender and added cream then over cooked the soup mix until all you tasted was pickle.

name: Marty Gleason
text: This was my first visit to McGillicuddy's.  The TV-everywhere atmosphere was certainly not to my taste, but I suppose some people like it.  I was pleasantly surprised with the craft beer selection, which covered the local scene but also had some interesting selections from elsewhere.  We were in a bit of a rush so I didn't have a chance to look over the menu in detail but it seemed to concentrate on typical American/Irish pub fare.  The service was friendly and we were waited on promptly, but some of our food was delayed in preparation.  Fried pickles were good if a bit bready, but the portion was very generous.  The highlight for me was the Reuben, particularly the corned beef which was lean and tender.  If I could I would give 3 1/2 stars, but on the strength of the Reuben I am rounding up to 4.

name: Patricia Henderson
text: Good service, great beer selection, pretty  good menu, average food.

name: Kristopher O'Neill
text: Slow nights equal not the best quality, when they have the "Tough" management they rock it. Hint: if they music is 90's comeback dinner other time.

name: kristian dahl
text: Beer selection is good, food is better at Williston location.  Service is good enough.

name: Aurora Nowak
text:
Good for drinks.  The fries were great but the main course food was WAY over cooked-burnt almost to a crisp.  Not exaggerating.
Also the waitress seemed constantly confused.  But for all I know it was her first day.

name: Chrysta Daniels
text: Great food gladly accepted a large party and the waitress was great about it

name: Joel Fleming
text: Great sports bar. Food is good, great beer selection, one of my favorite sport bars in the area.

name: Jonathan Mabee Sr
text: Good food, Decent prices, Attentive waitstaff.

name: Cris Cote
text: Good burgers and service.

name: Dawn Vining

name: Steve StHilaire
text: I like going here to hang out but the burgers are always way overcooked and dry. It's almost as if they are using frozen patties.

name: John Sirois
text: Great tap list and delicious pub fair. Kid friendly as well. Lots of Tv's to watch sports

name: Peter Chapin
text: Typical pub food, but with good quality. I like how the burgers have the option, for $2.00 extra, of being made with local, grass-fed beef. Service was friendly.

name: SEBASTIAN DARENA
text: Avg pub fare-- Great place to watch a game! Possible to get a booth w/own TV or watch on big screen.

name: John Willard
text: Loved everything about the restaurant. And the waitresses are great and helpful.

name: Richard Reed
text: Burgers, lamb stew, meatballs sub all very good. Shepherds Pie was WAY too salty & was sent back. Very good selection of beers &  ales.

name: Dottievalrie Colbert
text: This McGillicuddys Five Corners is a nice place. Great food.

name: Molly Q
text: This place is so good!! Earl and his team have continues the cuddys environment and it is always such a treat to go here!! My girlfriend and I meet here once a month - pub chips, cobb salad SO GOOD. Definitely recommend this place.

name: Lisa Purinton
text: Fair at best! We had fried pickles the day before at another establishment and were so disappointed with the ones here. Soggy and tasteless! My fish-and-chips weren't much better and the prices were high..

name: Kristy Paradis
text: Never a bad meal.

name: Glenn
text: This is easily one of my favorite restaurant chains

name: Tiana Valyou
text: Salads are good, but the only gluten free option

name: Sheb Jewell
text: Been a few times each visit worse than the last. Food is not good. Apps are worse than the ones from the grocery store. Government chicken nuggets from my elementary school were better than the tenders here (cause they aren't really tenders). Fries? Yeah - no. Awful pre cut frozen soggy mess. I could go on but i think you get the idea. If you really need to come here eat a tv dinner first and then stick to the beer. Cheaper and  likely better.

name: Brett Danis
text: Always a good place for a burger and a beer

name: Patty Jacob
text: Friendly atmosphere. Food was nothing special.

name: MJ Santor
text: Good food and good atmosphere.

name: Anthony Marthaler
text: Food as expected from one of these tires of places. Kids love the TV screens at each both. Ok beer menu.

name: Mikebx Knox
text: I love Wednesday . Gaige  is the bartender and is very pleasant.  Maddy and Anna are great too.

name: Marcus Tracy
text: I am a big fan of the chain but the lack of parking makes me worried for its future. Expect the same good food and service as any of its sister locations.

name: Ricardo Dodge
text: Love the wings, and the nice roomy booths as well. Parking at the Essex location can be a bit iffy sometimes, but that's pretty much what I expected when they put a building that size on that corner.

name: Bruce Garrapy
text: Good food good prices

name: Mary Provost
text: Great food,friendly and prompt service..will go again,for sure.  Went to today's Sunday brunch..great food and service!

name: N. Hubbell
text: We go often but we are always served good food here.

name: Connor Dustin
text: Good food and good service. Decent price. Highly recommended.

name: Michelle Thibault
text: Great food, great service, and amazing drinks. Thanks team, as always we were happy.

name: David Booth
text: A fun sports bar with tv's on every wall.The service is great and the food is good.

name: Judy Pillsbury

name: George Donovan

name: Steve Koenemann

name: Zach Whitcomb

name: Andrew Goodrich

name: Ryan Mitofsky

name: Mike Costello
text: Good, consistent, irish food, and the service has ways been friendly and attentive. Food is reasonably priced; beers are a little pricey, but there are a lot to choose from.

name: An Iz

name: Krista Rochefort

name: Trevor Hindson

text: Friendly staff. We got a burger, which was not sufficiently seasoned. The food was also very greasy.

name: James Sullivan
text: Burger night nuff said

name: Christopher Clark
text: Gpod modern irish style pub

name: Mandi Chukin
text: I'd been meaning to get carry out from this place for ages and finally did. It did not disappoint. I got the firecracker tuna poke bowl with rice. Delicious, fresh ingredients, great flavors, friendly service. I'm so glad I live close!

name: Heather Sedgeman
text: Tried the classic and the rainbow bowl. Both were fresh, tasty, and filling without being heavy. Shared an acai bowl for dessert. Looking forward to trying other options and creating our own.

name: Wesley G. Kenney
text: My wife has been closely watching and waiting for this place to open. We were able to make it a few days after their grand opening, and it did not disappoint. My wife had the firecracker bowl, and really enjoyed it. The tuna tasted fresh, and all the toppings complemented well. I had the Land Lover with beef, and thought it was good as well. I definitely see us coming back soon!

name: VegaTron2020 Yeeesssa!
text: The firecracker is the best poke or meal I think I've ever eaten out. So fresh and delicious.

name: George Elliott
text: Delicious Poké bowls, fantastic flavor

name: Erin Covey
text: Consistently fresh food with delicious ingredients. Easy to order online and pick up. Makes it easy to support local when you have places like this just around the corner. I even have my parents hooked now. Keep up the awesome work! 🐟🌱

name: Marty Gleason
text: Great tasting food. Interesting house combinations and a wide variety of bases, proteins, sauces and toppings to create your own bowl.

resp.text: Thank you Marty! We look forward to seeing you again soon!

name: Stephen McElroy
text: Fresh ingredients, great portion size. Try the house special. Yum!

name: Corinna Giles
text: Very user friendly, great place to bring poke first timers. Signs are clear and easy to read. There's tons of specials but if you're unsure, their predesigned bowls are pretty great. They have vegan and vegetarian options, I think you could design a gluten free bowl as well? They have a neat loyalty system and really friendly staff who are willing to help explain and offer advice. I'll definitely be back.

resp.text: Thank you! We're so glad you enjoyed everything :)

name: Emily Pogozelski
text: Tasty poke bowls! I’ll definitely be back. So glad to have this place in Williston. (A bit hard to see from the road— it’s in the building that says “Kismet” on the side.)

name: foxx xanatos
text: Delicious and fresh, my favorite place to get lunch

name: Narcis Gosselin
text: Clean and great food.

name: Jon Mendel
text: Love the scale. Super big portions, filling a healthy lunch need in Williston.

name: Christopher Lei
text: Only place in Burlington area to offer legit pokebowls. The Spot on Shelburne Road offers poke as an app, but it around $10 and you don't get much at all.

resp.text: Thank you Chris! We're looking forward to seeing you again :)

name: Peg Purdue
text: Yummy. Fresh and healthy with online app for ordering.

name: Zack Lucas
text: So good

name: Kate Castonguay
text: Both times I've been there I've been pleased. The fish is tasty and the bowls are very filling. There's many combinations you can get and they have non-fish options so there's something for everyone. I highly recommend for a quick bite at any meal. Their fruit bowls also look amazing.

name: Zeb Carlson
text: Had a crave bowl. Delicious and refreshing. It hit the spot. I want to go back to try more of a food option as mine was more of a Sundae.  Great pick me up take out.

resp.text: Thanks Zeb!

name: Randy Abair
text: One of my new favorite places, I just wish the location was closer to Mallett’s Bay so I could go more often! Delicious, fresh, made to order, virtually infinite combinations - you won’t be disappointed.

name: B D
text: This place is great for quick healthy and delicious food 👌 They have meats and veggies or sherbert and fruits with plenty of interestinf creative toppings. Love this place! The only downside is seating. Not many places to sit and there are only high tables..

resp.text: Thank you! We're working on more seating options for the winter. We hope you stop by again!

name: Arleigh Young
text: One of my favorites for lunch. Quick, healthy, and delicious. Friendly owners and staff. Sadly prices were raised so the price point is high in comparison to other lunch spots. This only means I go once a month instead of once a week.

name: Chan Tran
text: Love it. I love sushi and the poke here is great. I'm a big fan of the spicy poke bowl

name: Maranda Nielson
text: Food is pretty good, but it is quite expensive. I also wasn't very impressed with the service. You can order online, which I would recommend.

resp.text: Thank you for your feedback Maranda. We're glad you find our online ordering system helpful :)

name: Sean Leonardi
text: Really great stop for lunch. The regular is a big dish and you definitely get your money's worth. So many great sauces and toppings to try.

name: Todd Tomasi
text: Decent poke bowel that comes with a heavy price financially..Any little addition is like $1.50 . Expect to drop a 20 spot on a meal.

name: Staci Thurston
text: This place is amazing! Exactly what I wanted. The food is fresh and delicious! The staff was very friendly and accommodating. Highly recommend it!!

name: Andrew Wright
text:
Excellent food, the ingredients seem very high quality. I’ve only ever had poke in Hawaii and this is just as good.

Prices seem fair as the portions are huge and the fish is fresh. I’d rather spend more and get better quality than save a few bucks and risk getting ill. Raw fish isn’t something to cheap out on.

name: Jake McGinnis
text: Really great food. The firecracker sauce is spicy and delicious. All the toppings and meat look super fresh and the workers are very friendly. Great spot for lunch

name: Michael Michaelson
text: The food was good, not great i had surf and turf bowl the beef was tender enough but ice cold and cooked well done I would have preferred medium rare and warm not almost frozen

resp.text: We're sorry you didn't enjoy your Surf & Turf bowl but we appreciate your feedback. We hope you stop in again and try another one of our Signature Bowls that might be more to your liking.

name: Bri Skoldberg
text: vegan firecracker bowl 🔥😋

name: Chad Ray
text: Got really sick from this place never been able to eat even sushi since. I recommend not eating here unless you enjoy stomach cramps, nausea and explosive pooping.

name: Charles Thurston
text: Great food, a bit pricey, super fast and friendly

resp.text: Thanks so much Charles! We hope to see you again soon :)

name: James Enter
text:
I love this place!  I would highly recommend this place especially if you are looking to get some quick eats.

You get your food fast (everything is made in under 2 minutes).  The flavors of the standard bowls are excellent (the house classic bowl with brown rice is my favorite).  It is expensive with bowl costing 13$, but as a big guy with a large appetite I am comfortably full after having a large bowl (which is a little north of 17 w/tax).   The staff is friendly.  The space is not huge, but there is plenty of seating inside.  If you can I would recommend coming on a nice day and sitting outside.

name: Troy Frostad
text: Definitely something different as far as local restaurants. There is a good selection of fresh and unique ingredients to choose from. This place is hard to find though, as it is hidden inside the Kismet building. Recommended and worth a visit.

name: Starr St James
text: Feels like a sad cafeteria inside. My poke bowl was like someone took a grocery store spicy salmon roll and chucked it into a bowl. I know we're basically talking deconstructed sushi here but it was a really sad bowl and I felt sad when I was filled enough to dispose of the rest. I was excited for poke on my way there, and though I knew I had made a mistake as soon as I stepped inside, I couldn't bring myself to just walk out of the empty restaurant. The person working there was very nice and helpful.

name: Jojo B
text: Great poke bowls for breakfast or lunch! Had a breakfast bowl yesterday with açaí berry base with granola and fruit. It was delicious and I did not feel bloated or overly full. I also enjoyed a poke bowl for lunch and it was certainly plentiful and delicious! Nice place to enjoy some good food and I love the tables outdoors!

resp.text: Thanks Jojo! We're so excited to see you again soon.

name: Todd Tyrtle
text: Fish and veggies were very fresh but an otherwise healthy meal was made much less so by the huge amount of sauce on top of everything. If you are health conscious ask them for the sauce on the side or to go light on it.

name: Sean
text: The scale Poke Bar is exactly what this area needed! The food is fresh, local and it's absolutely fantastic!!!! I got the wild caught Prawn poke bowl and my wife got the local beef poke bowl and it was OUT OF THIS WORLD! friendly staff and quick service. I'm glad there's a new option for the normally mundane, unhealthy food selection in our area. As a Google Guide with over 450k views I'd say this is the best hidden Jewel in Vermont! Can't wait to go back and try the next bowl but hard not to order that Prawn one again!!!

name: Chester Elliott
text: So glad I found this place. It's a good lunch option that you can often without worrying about your cholesterol going through the roof. Yes it's a tad pricey but you get what you pay for. I get the rainbow bowl with almost all the fixins, with brown rice as the base. It's very delicious and filling.

name: Lane Perry
text: Had the Tuna poke bowl and was not disappointed. Tons of flavor, all fresh prepared ingredients and super friendly staff! Definitely coming back.

name: Kilse
text: Always amazing better than the other company downtown!

name: Thomas Saulnier
text: Great place to grab a quick and tasty lunch!

name: eric testroet
text: Love the concept.  Quick, offers carryout so is great for a healthy dinner to grab on the way home.

name: Jeff Thurston
text: Awesome poke. Very fresh and lots of flavor.

name: McDonald Fam.
text: Best Poke bowls!!!!  Must go and they never disappoint.

resp.text: Thank you!

name: Ed Wasserman
text: Good food, slow to make it

name: Trevor Hindson
text: Poke is one of my favorite dishes and the do a good job at The Scale. In summer they have outdoor seating as it is only a small place so inside is a bit cramped.

resp.text: Thanks Trevor!

name: Erin Philbrick
text: Fresh food, delicious combinations - customized to your liking. I loved it!

name: Dave Patry
text: Fresh ingredients, reasonable prices, really good. Seating isn't great, but it has some. I'll be going back for sure.

resp.text: Thanks Dave! We do have more seating available outside for the summer as well as online ordering for quick take out. We hope to see you again soon!

name: D R
text: Huge portions and friendly people. Great little place to grab a fresh healthy filling meal.

name: Cindy Phenix
text: Asian/Hawaiian style food.

name: Thomas Bremer
text: Food was ok, good even, but not for the price. Way to high for what it is.

name: Magdalena N
text: So yummy!

name: William Drake
text: The food was very tasty and the staff was very helpful and explained the menu. The only drawback is that they don't have a lot of indoor seating.

name: Adam Little
text: Delicious food. Fast, fresh, and easy.

resp.text: Thank you! We hope to see you again soon!

name: Scott Friedman
text: Good food but tiny place. Better to plan for takeout than eating there.

name: N. Hubbell
text: I literally cannot get enough. The fish they use at those other restaurants? Garbage. They source the best fish possible and it really shows.

resp.text: Thanks! We do work really hard to find the freshest fish possible, glad you like it :)

name: Joseph Murphy
text: The firecracker bowl is amazing with shredded nori!

name: Matthew Yu
text: Just what you want at a poke bar: fresh, friendly, and fast. There is beer here !

name: Russell and Greta Irwin
text: Great keto friendly lunch in a jiffy!

name: Eric Mongeur
text: My first ever poke experience was positive, if not a bit expensive. I'll likely return for an occasional treat.

resp.text: Hi Eric! We're so glad you enjoyed your first visit in.  Remember to sign up for our loyalty program to earn FREE poke bowls!

name: Brett Mullineaux
text: Yummy and fresh

name: Kelsi Roberts
text: Amazing food. Can't wait to go back.

name: Keith Mildenberger
text: Awesome poké.

resp.text: Thanks Keith!

name: Lisa Groeneveld
text: If you like fresh food that's delightful too, then you have to go here. I could lick the bowl.

resp.text: Thanks Lisa!

name: D.Gutches Strongman
text: amazing would recommend to anyone love this place !

name: Jacob Moore
text: Good place. A bit pricy, but I would go again.

resp.text: Thanks for your feedback Jacob!

name: Bill Niquette
text: Fresh. Tasty. Great service.

name: Ecowood Floors Inc.
text: Today Wee Pokie Bar ❤️🍲❤️🍲❤️

name: Kevin Thorley
text: Spicy tuna bowl was great!

name: Maria Lara-Bregatta
text: Yummmmmmmmy stuff

name: Dierdra Michelle
text: Wonderful food in a friendly setting!

name: Aaron G
text: Food was wonderful.  Price is high.

resp.text: Hi Aaron! Thanks so much for your feedback. Make sure to sign up for our loyalty program to earn free poke bowls in the future.

name: Ashley Fisk
text: Omg! Amazing!

name: Randall J. Gonyo
text: Never been here

name: Tom McHugh
text: Awesome!

resp.text: Thanks Tom!

name: Dustin Whitney
text: Very good food.

resp.text: Thank you!

name: Daniel Shearer
text: Good eats!

name: Paul Lagoe
text: Really good..

resp.text: Thank you Paul!

name: Carol DelGaudio
text: Fresh delicious bowls

resp.text: Thanks Carol! We're so glad you enjoyed your visit, we can't wait to see you again.

name: Katie Charland
text: Loved this !!

name: Tina Bearce
text:
(Translated by Google) Yummmmmmmmmm !!!

(Original)
Yummmmmmmmmm!!!

resp.text: Thank you!

name: Ecowood Floors Inc.
text: Jonathan Wilson works here as a manipulative con person to Vermont Contractors. Avoid his home at 408 Scrabble Hill Road at all cost. We never seen a conniving deceitfully individual like this character.

resp.text: This is a restaurant.

name: Ron Mosocco
text: One of the many places we ate during our New England vacation last fall. It sticks out as a great place to eat well prepared food at competitive prices. It has over 20 craft beers on tap, some of the best Southern-style BBQ around. I opted for their superb mussels in cream sauce with 2 pints of Daly Palmer Beer. My wife crooned over their home made mac & cheese dish and pork sandwich. Our bill totaled $ 73 before tip.

name: Steve Welgoss
text: I knew about the beer for a long time, and it didn't disappoint finally trying it. However, the mac & cheese may have set the standard as the best I've ever had. The BBQ was solid, but honestly, the cheese was exceptional and something I'd get every time here.

name: Masha
text: First time checking out the brewery. Came solo on a Monday to grab a quick beer and it was all AamaaazZing! Staff was courteous. Kellerbier lager is on point and very flavourful (would drink 5 of those). Cuban sandwich was scumptious with fresh ingredients and juicy pork. Outside seating with heaters plus good tunes made life even better. Cheers and Happy New Year to all.

name: Christopher Lei
text: This place always has a wait. Tip, the high tables near the bar are first come first serve, which means if you hover and observe parties getting ready to leave, you can get their table. This means there is also prob another party eyeing the same table. As for the food and beer, delicious. The pork skin pictured is like crack!

name: Mike Gibbons
text: Great food, great staff, good social distancing

name: Sarah Willette
text: Great corn bread and atmosphere. A lot of the meat is vinegar based. Not a fan.

name: Nancy Kierstead
text:
I saw the sign as we were driving through town and immediately knew I had to have some sort of slow-cooked pork for lunch... They did not disappoint!
I had pork with beans and rice, all very yummy, a variety of sauces to choose from ranging from mild to spicy, I went with the pepper pineapple with medium heat. Nice dark beer! Moderately priced, our lunches were $8-10. I think the beer was $3.50 each.

name: Julianne Homola
text: Such a fun spot! Loved the out door patio, the interior was so fun, I stayed inside for 10 minutes just looking over the decorations. It's definitely a super hip spot with a great intererior. Staff was friendly and helpful. Never felt so welcome in a restaurant after just walking in the door. Great beer.

name: Amy G
text:
An unfortunately overhyped experience -- if you even remotely know what good bbq is, I’m sad to let you know that you probably won’t find it here.

The ribs were disappointingly dry and under seasoned with no smokey flavor. The selection of sauces somewhat remedied this, but one would hope ribs could hold its own otherwise. The chopped half hog was akin to soggy carnitas.

On the plus side, their duck fat fries and cornbread were dope. They serve it with mayo butter? Unidentified, to be honest, but would recommend.

name: Matthew Dawson
text: The Mac and Cheese is awesome and I recommend getting bacon with it.  The brisket is very good and so are their BBQ sauces.  Excellent selection of craft beers.

name: Wesley G. Kenney
text: Amazing food, a great beer selection, and good cocktails. This place is no secret, and often busy, but that's because it is worth the stop! The brisket was so good that the meat just melted in my mouth. Topped with the in-house sauces, paired with a beer brewed right next store, and you've got a great combo.

name: Logan
text: Great atmosphere and great service. The pulled pork and beef brisket was soooo delicious.

name: Antoinette Holliday
text: Nice  Atmosphere  Candlelight dinners just beautiful

resp.text: So Glad you appreciate the candlelight dining.  Makes us all feel at home.  See you next time!

name: D K
text: Excellent food, great drinks, and very attentive to COVID safety. Great environment.

name: Kari Collins
text: Food was absolutely amazing. Wings were crispy and delicious. Will absolutely go back here.

name: Barre Flynn
text: This is one of many good eaterys in waterbury vt. The food was amazing. Great but simple menu. Very creative food. Wait staff was very good. The bathrooms are very clean. A must place to visit when you are in the area.

name: Nate Wooding
text: I wasn't really sure how to review this place because I'm under 21 and the drinks seem to be a pretty essential part of the prohibition pig experience. Service was great and the food was pretty good, although the menu wasn't very diverse. The desserts were pretty expensive as well. Nothing really extraordinary but seems like it would be tough to find a bad meal here.

name: Tim Rooney
text: Excellent wings, burgers and duck fat fries. Not to mention the great beers and mixed drinks!  Friendly  and accommodating staff and patrons. Always a great time at Pro Pig!

name: Arthur Dutra III
text: Outstanding BBQ and great beer selection. The service was great and everything was excellent.

name: Kathleen James
text: I love prohibition pig, and this is a great way to get my fix when I'm in the area before they're open. The food is wonderful, the atmosphere is peaceful, the drinks are great, but the customer service could be improved upon, especially considering the great service at pro pig. Not worth deducting a star from my review though, the place is still a MUST when in Waterbury.

name: Kosta
text: Great food, and amazing beer! An awesome destination, and I'll always be back when visiting this part of Vermont.

name: Steve Koenemann
text: Beautiful day... excellent beer... queso, chorizo and chips was awesome!

name: Casey McClain
text: Everytime I have guests that want to tour Vermont Pro-Pig is a must stop, the beer is fantastic (both in house and those carried from other breweries). I highly recommend stepping out off your comfort zone with their beers as I am not a sour fan, but have enjoyed every one I have tried here! The food is also fantastic, excellent bbq with Asian and Mexican influence. Staff is always friendly and engaging and the atmosphere is fantastic. If you are in Waterbury this is a place you must stop.

name: Vicky Collingwood
text: Had the burger special and a fantastic cocktail! Always yummy with a very friendly staff...worth the trip every time!

name: Beau Cote
text:
This place was great. My buddy and I came here during our bike-packing trip and were pleasantly surprised. I'm not gonna lie, not hearing of this place before, it wasn't my first pick, but i'm happy we went.

First off, the food was awesome. I got the T.N.T. Salad which was hot and the Gyro which was incredible. I'm fairly picky when it comes to food, especially in a state that prides itself on being/sourcing local and this did not disappoint. The beer was also really good. I only had one as we had to press out for the rest of the day but it was good!

My only wish was that there was more seating inside but that's a small complaint. The outdoor seating was sweet but it was a bit cold so I saw a few people turn around with the sight of no indoor seating.

5/5. Will come back soon!

name: Jason Keith Robertson
text: While visiting my mother in Vermont we ate here and it made a lasting impression with me. The service was excellent and the food was wonderful and  memorable, especially the dessert I had. I highly recommend Prohibition Pig.

name: daytradinfool58
text: Excellent food and excellent libations.  Friendly atmosphere and quick service.  Only issue is the parking lot out back is too small for how popular this pig is!

name: Tracy F.
text: Beers are great. Food is tasty but would be nice if the menu or server told diners that sides are not included. We arrived 10 mins before opening. By the time we'd been seated and our in our order, the restaurant was packed. Expect a wait.

name: Cait Andersen
text: So overrated. The menu is a joke. Terrible beer variety. Rude waitresses and waiters. This was my first time going and will never be back again.

name: Kate S.
text: Must visit! Great food, beer, dog friendly seating outside and overall very nice and friendly staff and they have cool merch 👍👍👍

name: Gayle Patria DiMasi
text: Loved the carnitas bowl!

name: Mark Barnes
text: Indoor and outdoor seating is available at this brewery. It has an old brewhouse kind of vibe, great beer selection and a limited food menu is available  within the brewery. The in-house brews are excellent, along with selections from other top Vermont brewers. Growler pours are available as well.

name: John Dedell
text: Very good food and drinks.  They have a nice selection of their and other beers and a fully stocked bar to provide what you require.  The food is excellent and if you like shrimp you need to try the the peel and eat shrimp appetizer.

name: Stephen Frey
text: Great food and drink. Really hard to hear when it’s busy. Shiny reflective surfaces, little to no sound control. Quieter times are awesome!

name: Ben Wenger
text: Super delicious brisket and fries. Everything here is just perfect. Incredible beer to go along with the food also.

name: Christopher H
text: Visited here as a part of our tour of breweries of the state. The front of house was very accommodating to me and I liked the aesthetics of the dining area. However, I felt their brews were lacking in any stand out hit. I'm sure this place would be great to get something to eat in the area, but I'd skip it if you were brewery hopping.

name: James
text: Good burger joint, great beef, only downside is that the buns are a little too thin, makes for a messy burger. The wings are miller though. Definitely get the dry rub over the honey.

name: Mada Francisco
text:
If you are anywhere near Waterbury and like food and beer, even just a little bit, then you need to stop at Prohibition Pig. During lunch they have the taproom out back going with a nice Mexican street food style menu that's always on point. In the evening, the restaurant and bar up top have a whole different menu that's always changing.
It may be busy but it's worth waiting for. Have one of their house brewed New England style IPAs and relax...delicious is about to happen.

name: Michael Michaelson
text:
This was probably the last time I go there as a local, who grew up in North Carolina and Georgia, the pulled pork was never so full of pepper and spices that leave your mouth on fire couldn't taste the pork all I tasted was heat.
The beans and French fries were the best part of my meal. What happened to your hush puppies somebody dumped a couple table spoons of cayenne pepper powder in the batter because they used to be good!

name: Mike Dover
text: My friends liked every beer and loved the baked beans. Really good wings. Good meals. Good service at the bar from a few servers. Came back to the brewery portion a few days later and could try a sample before buying a glass. Great outdoor seating.

name: Kate Castonguay
text: Pro Pig is one of my favorite spots. There's something for everyone. The pork rinds and cracklins are amazing, a must have. The sauce that goes with them is deliciously spicy and perfectly compliments the app. While their variety of beer is great, their cocktails are my go to. They're always changing and interesting. This is the only place I've completely cleaned my plate of a salad (the crispy chicken is fantastic). Sandwiches are put together very well and definitely add an order of duck fat fries to the table. Service is great, they run a tight ship.

name: Clayton Wells
text:
We came here and ate for my sister in laws birthday and the food was fantastic! However the service was absolutely horrific.
We were waited on by a young lady that was extremely pushy and rushing. We were brought our food and drinks and were not checked up on for the rest of our meal. After our meal we sat patiently (and thirsty) waiting for our bill. No sooner do I see our waitress in her street clothes with her purse walking out the door.
We eventually settled up our bill with a new waiter and then proceeded up the hill to McGillicuddys. I open up the door walk up to the bar and guess who is there... None other then the waitress that had just left us high and dry at our dinner table, 10 minutes had gone by and she was wasted at the next bar over.
I simply could not believe that this happend at such a nice local restaurant. I typically and out a lot of five star reviews and I'm pretty generous, but unfortunately I cannot do that for this establishment. I sincerely hope that nobody else has the same experience that my family did.

name: Jackii Sovern
text: Always the best restaurant to visit when in Vermont. Sometimes we even go twice!

name: Quadrillion01
text:
I don't understand how this place has a 4	+ star rating. I got the chicken and bisquit sandwich with honey for $12. The chicken was greasy and tasted like it was cooked in old, burnt oil. If there was honey on it, it was not noticible. They also wanted to charge extra for some lettuce and tomato. It came with nothing (unless you count the pickle spear)! For that price it should include a side.

My wife got a burger. It was also $12 and came with nothing. It was the smallest burger I've seen served at a restaurant. She said it was dry and tasteless.

name: Timothy Schad
text: A transcendent burrito experience. Tacos excellent as well.  Wash it all down with a vast selection of local beer, which you can also take home in a variety of growlers.  Prompt, corteous counter service rounds out this quintessential Waterbury dining spot.

name: John Dawson
text:
A great place with huge selection of beer and creative cocktails.  Try the Hot Chicken Bao Buns, awesome.

And ask for Kyla, she’s great!

name: Ron Kish
text: Coban Sandwich great.Maple Brown fantastic

name: Brett Owen
text: Food was awesome. We had brisket sandwich, hish puppies and chicken and biscuit. Service was outstanding

name: Richard Johnson
text: Now this is some great bbq you need to stop and eat. Delicious

name: Kevin Boutelle
text: We never miss a chance to stop here when we're in the area. Great food, beer and service. The place is cool as hell too.

name: Josef & Cindy Martin
text: Great food great beer great outside seating!

name: Jason Zizza
text: This place is Delish!! Can't wait for my son to have another hockey game in Waterbury

name: jodysherman
text: The food was so good. Long wait so be prepared to wait, but the food 100% makes up for it

name: Matt Ross
text: Awesome venue and awesome beers. Really neat merch too!

name: Ted Gould
text: Good beer and amazing food. The staff is awesome.

name: Nathan
text: Great light lunch spot. Limited menu, Tacos and stuff, but they're good. House brewed beers are excellent. Although brewing in the Alchemist's old location is a lot of pressure.

name: Scott Reigel
text: Great meats and great beers. Even better service.  One of the great spots of Vermont

name: Micah Paroline
text: Good food and good drinks. Try the hush puppies and sample their BBQ sauces.

name: Marc Scrivener
text: This place is a must visit on your way through Vermont. We stopped on our way to Burlington, and it certainly was worth it. The beer is excellent and the bar food is very good--though choices are limited. Be wary of the "I don't think so Tim" sauce, unless you have a very high tolerance for spicy food. There's also a great craft beer store across the street.

name: Mark Cobb
text: With fame and notoriety comes complacency. Ok meal ok service

name: Dave Kinney
text: Oh the beer! It's wonderful. The burgers are top shelf too albeit a touch small for the price. Probably the best brewpub around. And for a brew pub there's a surprisingly wide liquor selection.

name: Leah Neira
text: We went to the main restaurant. It was super crowded, so we had to wait a while before seats opened up. The bartenders were friendly and helpful and really quick with both our pre-seat drink orders and our bar-side food orders. The beers were really good, and they had a wide enough selection of both on-house brews and some from other local brewers. The food was delicious. I got a pulled pork sandwich, and it was super juicy. I was concerned it wasn't gonna be quite enough to fill me up, but it was actually the perfect amount of food for me. I would definitely recommend eating and drinking (responsibly) here. Just an FYI - they have a bar in the building behind that has a different menu and was less crowded than the restaurant. Didn't try the food there, but got my passport stamps and the bartender there was pretty friendly too.

name: Christopher Chanowitz
text: Great food, beer selection and awesome service and a warm friendly staff

name: Anna
text:
The staff was very friendly and the atmosphere was comfortable!
I was here about a month and a half ago and the taco portions were much bigger. Even in some of the other reviewer‘s pictures it was apparent to see the difference between their tacos and mine. We brought friends here for their first time and it was a bit disappointing

name: Adam Carparelli
text: Why aren't you here already?  Seriously, this is one of my favorite spots outside of Burlington.  Stop here for apres' anything!  Close to Perry Hill, on the way to Sugarbush/Mad River Glenn, Camels hump, Little River State park, etc.   The beer options change regularly, staff is always pleasant, and food options are reasonably priced.  A great spot to recharge after a day enjoying the VT outdoors!  Tap room is in the back, the restaurant offers more substantial food options.

name: Kris Shewokis
text: Stopped here on the way to Canada. Got in a little early to beat the lunch crowd. Its fairly small and gets crowded quick. Some of the best bbq Ive had and the beer is great

name: Katura Huckabay
text: Menu was creative and the ingredients where high quality. Every dish had something spicy or strong flavored which made it hard for the picky eater.

name: Greg Wilder
text: Great beer and great food but a bit overpriced. Very laid back, so expect dining here to take some time.

name: Thomas Hall
text:
The food is always good, but the portion seemed less satisfying than previous trips.
Maybe I was just hungrier than usual.  I would have liked more dessert options.

name: David Ospina
text: Great beer, food not special. For a great meal and beer go to the restaurant in feont is Part of prohibition pig brewery.

name: Sandra Prudhomme
text: Simply love Pro Pig a must when we are in the area. Was happy to see a terrace was available!

name: Misty Williams
text: The luring aroma of bacon greeted me as I crossed the street walking toward "the pig". Amazing food! As always. Quick, and pleasant staff even on a slamming Friday lunch. One note ... the blueberry cheesecake is in ice cream form ... tasty, but save yourself the hassle of picking it up off the table and ask for a bigger bowl right away.

name: Mark Midmark
text:
Their house beers are pretty solid, guest list is respectable, and the whisk(e)y available is great. The girlfriend and I drank there one night, had good service with good tunes, and we ate their once. I have the smoked brisket which was melt in my mouth good, the fries and green beans were great sides. My girlfriend got Korean BBQ tempeh which was excellent and she liked her sides of balsamic greens and green beans.

This place is well known among beer fans for a reason, it's a must visit in Vermont.

name: Jason Taylor
text: Highlight of this place is anything done with meat.  Above average brisket, wings, and mac and cheese.  Sometimes though the size and the extravagance of the dishes (burgers) seems like a death wish.   Tap list is solid, but they have progressively added more of their own beers to the list.  Really nice bourbon list.   Service is hit or miss.

name: Michael St. Denis
text: I travel a lot, and this place honestly has probably the best food and smoked meat I have ever had.   Everything was perfect, I had the smoked chicken was is unbelievable.  The service is warm, friendly and like you are at home.  They asked what we "really wanted" and we tried three old fashions, with three different bourbon which were all great, so we could compare them.  Desert was great too, ho. E made pudding with whipped cream and Oreos.   If you are in the area, you have to try this place.

name: Trevor Masters
text: Lunch: burgers were good, but duck fat fries were great!

name: Kosh sam
text: Service was lackluster.. We got the smoked braised beef sandwich - the special, which tasted like they marinated the beef in lighter fluid. They had plenty of sauces to take the taste of butane away from the taste of butane, so that's kind of a plus, but not really. No free samples and the paid samples were limited to 2 a person; doesn't make sense for a brewery which boasts of multiple beers. Stick with the beer and avoid the food if you really want to check this place out.

name: Chris Giza
text: Always a fun stop. Good beer great tacos

name: Bill Whip
text: Staff could have been more friendly, might try again if nothing else was open.

name: Jared Wheeler
text: Can't wait to go back!

name: Brenda Alcala
text: Nice atmosphere. Good food and beer.

name: Rose OConnor
text: Food was great and staff very friendly and professional. I would  go there again.

name: Maddie O'Reilly
text: Great food, friendly service, and good beer menu. I liked the beer of theirs that I tried, worth a taste. The wait can be long so recommend avoiding if you have a large group. If you're willing to sit at the bar the full menu is available and high top tables are first come first served. The food is high quality and locally sourced.

name: Courtney Morse
text: Delicious beer and food.

name: Thomas Field
text: Tasty food, nice atmosphere...portions are a bit small though.

name: Smadar B
text: Because there's no reservations, the wait to get a table is often an integral part of the dining experience, as you can get one of their excellent beers or cider on tap and work up an appetite--which you'll need, because the portions are generous and the food is delicious. The dry rub wings are the best thing on the menu, hands down. The mac and cheese comes in second place--a rich mix of cheeses and a buttery crumble on top a fun shaped pasta.

name: Kiley Briggs
text:
Great food and great beer. The staff was very friendly and knowledgeable about stuff on the menu. Most of the ingredients are locally sourced and portion sizes are reasonable. There is often a wait to get a table, which is a little irritating, but not too bad. I think we waited about half an hour today (1:30 on a Saturday).

The beer brewed on site is pretty good, but they've got some even better stuff on tap and there's a sweet craft beer store across the street just in case you want more of something you tried at Prohibition Pig. My one complaint is that they do not offer a sampler of their own brews.

name: Mel Allen
text: The only downfall to Pro Pig is the amount of people trying to eat here! The food is spectacular. The beers are undeniably good. The staff is witty, friendly, gracious, etc. If you can get in here, do it today. Don't wait.

name: Marcia Stanton
text: Great food and service! Very much enjoyed the special mix drinks as well as the beer. The restaurant has a very different menu from The Brew Pub.

name: Rick
text: The establishment was nice and food was good. Service was terrible. Not sure if the waitress was overwhelmed or not. But, it was bad.

name: Megan Sault
text: Hidden gem! Good brew, fun place to meet friends and have an app or dinner! Highly recommend!

name: Edward Pricer
text: Exceptional BBQ. Exceptional beer, beyond just VT IPA. The price is high, with premium prices even for simple sides. The annex is a little bit chaotic, but fun with the right crowd.

name: Jill Vize
text: Love this place!  The food is amazing!

name: Jeanene Ingrao
text: Service was good. Small portions and over priced

name: Jason Frishman
text: While the portions seem a bit small for my large taste that would not stop me from coming back again and again. The taste of everything was fantastic, service was excellent and knowledgeable, and the atmosphere was inviting!

name: Todd Mackay
text: This place was awesome. Very clean, friendly staff and great food. I just got a burger with a side of fries...but the best burger I have had in awhile...I'll definitely be back

name: Bethany Johnson
text: Always good food and beer. Great outdoor seating

name: Dingo
text: Great food and a fun atmosphere!

name: TheFinalBoss
text: Great Food! Great Bartender, Great Atmosphere and Good Location

name: Dave deGrasse
text: Quick service , great atmosphere, easy parking.

name: dan jones
text: Not great barbecue, but a lot of other good food options. Cocktails are excellent!

name: Timothy Olver
text: Excellent beers, great bbq, neat atmosphere. A bit packed and pricy, but worth it.

name: John Crozier
text: Wonderful atmosphere with excellent food and superb beer.

name: Van Dora Williams
text: Great food.  Very nice atmosphere.  The wait for a table is long but the food is worth it.  Service was top notch as well; very friendly staff.

name: John Grandi
text: Beer menu is fantastic with a bit of everything available. The food is delicious and can be served up pretty quick!

name: Kevin O'Connor
text:
Great food and beer selection in the front of the restaurant and a different selection in the back, make sure to get a crowler from the back before you leave!
They usually have an amazing selection of top notch craft beers to choose from to go along with their beers which are amazing too.

name: Joshua Mayo
text: When I go to Pro pig everyone tries to convince me how good it is. If you are a hipster d-bag on vacation in Vermont and have no idea, I am sure it is amazing. No locals dine here. If you like standing in line for OK food, get a life. Having grown up in New England and lived in the south/mid west I know you are getting screwed. On top of this the food they are serving you is twice the price for no reason.  I have no reason to post this other than having crappy meals. I did not eat my wings and side of potato salad. The rub on the wings had an enormous layer of salt. Heart attack, tried to wipe it off. The potato salad was even worse.

name: Laurie Bouyea-Dumont
text: Delicious food and drinks. It's a favorite in Waterbury.

name: Denise Dukette
text: Delicious comfort food! Portions can be pricey for what you get (ie Burgers don't come with any sides) but all their menu items are delicious.

name: Elizabeth Rossano
text: The “pit master salad” was to die for! Great service at the bar, host station and table.

name: Blake Stophenberg
text: First time here. Absolutely nothing bad to say. Service is fast and friendly. The food is outstanding. Fresh barbeque flavors. The beef brisket is phenomenal. Great selection of craft brews. The double fried wings were delicious and perfectly cooked. 5 stars. Defintely a place to check out

name: L G
text: The beers on tap are great. The food is good and the atmosphere is awesome.   The place is always packed so just be aware and plan accordingly.  I always go here when I'm in Vermont.

name: Peter B
text: The food was good, but not served piping hot. It was just warm and got cold quickly on the stupid aluminum plates.

name: Bob Nevins
text: Great beer but the food is just average.  Try it yourself, very popular in the area with locals and tourists.  We had a long wait for food, staff was pleasant and the atmosphere is great.  Just expected the food to be off the hook, I just don't like tough crewy meat, I can get that anywhere.  Bad day for cook or poor quality control by managers..,not sure it matters but that's my take on it.

name: Geoff Cohen
text:
Been coming here since the early Alchemist days once or twice a year. This time will be the last. Took over an hour to get the food once seated and the place was half empty. Brisket was good but not great (better than previous times).  Wife's mac and cheese was meh. House made beers were good, but nothing to write home about - cocktails were meh, but if you're charging me $12 a cocktail in VT it should be better. The menu is kinda weird, not a ton of choice.

Service was awful, took forever just to swipe a credit card.

And man this place has gotten expensive. For the same price I'd go elsewhere.

Think it's time to branch out and find some new Waterbury pubs.

name: John K
text: Great BBQ and awesome beer.

name: Sean Faherty
text:
The Prohibition Pig is both a restaurant and brewery, with two distinct entrances. My wife and I ate and drank in the brewery side after a long slog from Boston.

A drool-inducing array of Vermont's finest craft beers can be had at the Pig. Yes, they serve Hill Farmstead. Yes, they serve Alchemist.

Great atmosphere, tasty food selections, and the beer.  You'll remember the beer.

name: Andy Newhall
text:
We first visited Prohibition Pig this winter ('13). We were immediately drawn to the place's theme/identity, and found the delivery to be spot on! We are now raving fans.

The initial appeal is firmly rooted in the retro saloon theme that strikes one immediately when walking in. This is combined with the dual mission of local raised, butchered and prepared meats. They pull it all off with aplomb.

Additionally, we find PP to be entirely family friendly (w/ out 14 mo. old daughter). Obviously this is at reasonable hours for a family to be out for dinner/lunch.

Speaking of dinner...we recently found that this is the only time that the "hush puppies" are available. So, if you are going for those (and we highly recommend), they won't be available at lunch.

name: Jennifer WilleyBigg
text: This place is awesome! The people are awesome, the beer is awesome!

name: Kara Popovich
text:
Not sure what all the excitement is about with this place, the food was not good and the prices were ridiculous.
Service was ho-hum as well and slightly annoying. I understand that it can be difficult to wait on a table with small children because things tend to take longer; but the server had a disgusted look on his face from the time we sat at his table until we left. He seemed more annoyed when we told him twice that we needed some more time to look at the drink menu to decide as our toddler was being a bit distracting.
As far as the food, the pork plate was the most dry meat I have ever been served at any BBQ establishment, pretty much inedible. I was hoping to drown it in bbq sauce so that I could eat my $18 meal but once sauce was basically brown-tinged white vinegar and the other had little to no flavor. The grits had no texture and reminded me of gruel you might see in a cafeteria and the beans were flavorless. My toddler usually loves bbq but he even refused to eat it!
The beer was underwhelming and I opted to try one that was not brewed here...slightly better.
Don't waste your time or your money for that matter.

name: Amanda Charron
text: Delicious food, great drinks and friendly staff!

name: Spencer Perry
text: Really good food and crazy good beer.  The bar side food is also super good

name: BEN ADAMS
text: Bit pricey and portions are kinda small. Food does taste great and the beer list is good though

name: Kierstin Kemmerer
text: Awesome BBQ! Great atmosphere and good beer!

name: Andrew Spencer
text: Great food, come early if you don't want to wait, it fills up fast!

name: Cris Cote
text: A very good DIPA and food.

name: Jason Hao
text: Fantastic beer selection, both in house and other local breweries. The food menu is limited but all the options are delicious. Well worth the stop in Waterbury.

name: Josh Calley
text:
Listen, if you are staying in the area, make the drive down here and enjoy some pork cracklins paired with one of the many craft beers on tap. The Vanilla Bean Porter and the Galaxy IPA, both brewed in house, are the few I got to try during my visit and both were great!

I got the Waterbury Patriot burger, which I can only describe as heaven between two buns. I'm not going to even try to describe it because words alone do not do it justice. Just get it, and change your previously miserable life.

name: Anthony Bingham
text: The BEST burger I have EVER had....trust me, I've had a lot (my belly will back me up)!! Hehehehe! The "Waterbury Patriot" and their "Poutine" is second to none! Service is great, food is great, and environment is awesome! I love it!

name: Thom McEvoy
text: One of the lesser restaurants in Waterbury but perfect for tourists who do not know any better.

name: Ryan Calvi
text:
Love taking friends and family from out of the area here.
Great food. Great beer.

name: Jane Swift
text: Have tried to eat here many times, finally went for a very early dinner and it lived up to the hype. Many gluten free and vegetarian options.  The pork plate was excellent, cheddar grits were awesome. Tempeh really good, cheese plate yummy. Downeast cranberry cider on draft great.

name: Phineas Wormser
text: Delicious food.

name: Nicholas Donovan
text: Some of the best BBQ I've had.  Also great in house beer and visiting taps.  I stop by every time on my way to Burlington!

name: Brian Clarkson
text: Fun place , super friendly staff and patrons .

name: Wayne Geiser
text:
Stopped in for lunch and was disappointed that the restaurant, next door, was only open for dinner.  Nevertheless, the food was great and the staff were very friendly and fun.
I wanted to fill my growler to take back to the hotel and they informed me that they couldn't fill a growler without the Surgeon General's warning on it.  They solved the problem by cutting the warning from one of their labels and applying it to the growler.  Much appreciated!

name: Andrew DeWolfe
text: If the chef came out of the kitchen when I was eating my BBQ tempeh plate I would've given him or her the biggest hug of our lives. This is a meat lover paradise but the vegetarian options are sweet.  Top notch beer: their own, Alchemist, Hill Farmstead, Lawson's, etc. Great service, clean, well run place. Be prepared to wait.

name: Anthony Rock
text: If you like BBQ and beer, this is the place for you. From light to dark beers they've got things covered, pair it with a light to heavy meal for an amazing lunch or dinner!

name: Michelle McNamara
text: I know the name doesn't lend itself to vegan life, but the vegan options here are pretty decent.

name: Brian Story
text: A great example of North Carolina BBQ, heavy on vinegar, and light on sweet. It's a different take than most local BBQ, and a welcome change. Their selection of beer is outstanding, and their house brewery is better than average too.

name: Tiana Valyou
text: Great food, Gluten free options for dinner

name: Eamonn Maguire
text: Amazing food! Best dinner I've had in a long while.

name: Vermont Wooden Toy
text: Great beer, pub fare was pretty bland.

name: Anne Cantera
text: I really like this place. Our waitress was awesome. We had a  couple issues w the food. Brisket was 70% fat. Yes i know its a fatty cut but that is way out of proportion. The other 30% was super tasty. The honey habenero wings were super mustardy which is not something u would expect. So they didnt get eaten and my husband gagged on his (he has a severe aversion to mustard) i loved my smoked chicken salad and the ranch dressing was phenomenal. Home made w buttermilk and dill. More please. All in all great place, cool atmosphere.

name: Diane Stevens
text: Food was great, good beer and friendly service!

name: Dave McGuriman
text: Good beer, yummy fried pimento cheese but service can be cold, I got served an old roll for an Italian sub that literally crumbled in my hand, told waiter and he said "oh man" and that's it, no apology or anything.

text: Very nice place! Great beer, great food! Try the nitro sour. Soooo good and smooth. Also order  jalapeno cornbread with maple butter! Best thing on their menu.

name: Matthew Burg
text: Cool little place in the middle of town with a unique menu and all the local brews at the bar.  The brewery in back had their own tasty libations as well.  An instant favorite.

name: Trisha Watson
text: Pricey, but the food is definitely delicious. I'm a brisket fan, but their smoked pork options are wonderful. Good variety in their self-brewed beers as well.

name: Tyler James

name: James Wenta
