name: Darcy K
text: Rude service. It was empty in the dining area, but the hostess refused to let us sit, very briefly (an hour or so) , at a table, even though I promised to order food. Was told that ALL OF US (4 ppl) had to order food: "that's the policy here." Cool. Here's my policy - I'll order one beer; never come back; and recommend every surrounding restaurant to my wide craft beer circle. Thanks, Prohibition Pig.

name: Jennifer Nadwodny
text: All the meat! Best fries I've had in ages! House-made ice cream! Sick beers on offer. Fun cocktails.

name: Jim DiRenzo
text: Very popular with both locals and visitors.   Very lively and a great menu.  Can be very crowded and loud at times.

name: mike cornell
text:
We were only in Waterbury for 2 nights, and ended up going to the Prohibition Pig twice.  The first night (a Thursday) was with 4 adults and 5 kids) everyone was very happy with the food and the parents really enjoyed the huge beer selection.
The Mac and Cheese and hush puppies were big hits with the kids.  There is a large menu with a lot of different types of food.  Everything we ordered was great.
the second night it was just the parents and since it was late on a Friday we ended up sitting at the bar table once we were able to get one, and had a great time.  The waitstaff was attentive even though it was very busy and a little crowded in the bar area.

Definitely recommend this restaurant..

text: Great beer. Fiendly bartenders with a great atmosphere. The tacos are a MUST.

name: John Bonneville

They gave us the lunch menu and it was 3 in the afternoon. Maybe that is why but giving it 3 stars of 4. My pork seem warm to cold not hot. Not sure if I will come back.

name: Justin Heininger
text:
Laid back with a local/regional beer selection.  We showed up about 4:40PM on a Wednesday and had no issues getting a table (though by 5:30 people were waiting for a table.)  Prohibition Pig serves up BBQ style locally raised and grown food.

Upon entering, you're greeted to a bar, but we were there with several other families, and the service was good.  Our waitress, Heather, checked in on us regularly, both "in person" asking us if we needed anything and also checked on us "from afar" to make sure we weren't empty on drinks or needed to ask for anything.

I felt the prices were reasonable, given they source local food, but were less than restaurants in the Burlington area that do the same thing and charge much more.

2 Prohibition Pig Pale Ales (which I thought were very balanced hoppy beers)
1 Chopped Pork BBQ
2 Just a Burger orders
1 Fever Tree ginger beer
1 Shoestring Fries
1 Hush Puppies

~= $64

Oh, and don't be scared to try the "Duck Fat Fries", I was hesitant because it sounded sort of unappealing to me, but they were delicious!

Restaurant up front, brewery back behind.  Brewery serves beer (duh) and basic text mex snacks.
The resturant, ah the resturant........
If one craves pig in any of its wondrous smoked forms then stop at the resturant.  This converted store front maintains its '50's charm  while serving up good eats.  Wife and I started with an appy of muscles which were totally great.  Ask for extra bread, you'll want to sop up the sauce.
My chopped pork was,,,,, different.  Tasted good but the texture kind of threw me off.  Brisket was great and will be my go to when we return.  My side of beans was good, but why people would chop up the Mac for the mac salad is beyond me.  Again, tasted good, just a texture thing.
Go forth and enjoy the ways of the Pig.

name: gmalav5877
text:
MEA CULPA: PROHIBITIO PIG
After hearing back from the Prohibition Pig and a Yelp member I have become aware of a mistake in my most recent review of the restaurant.  Inexcusably I misread the house guanciale, a pork bacon like product, to be guacamole, an avocado based condiment.  My apologies to the owners’ and staff of the restaurant for that mistake.  Also my gratitude for their reaching out to correct the situation.

The restaurant was surprisingly busy on a Monday for a lunch service.  It was a non-holiday week yet there were lines to get in and 10-15 minute wait for tables.  As such my client and I opted to sit at the bar for our lunch.
It was my first time at the Prohibition Pig so I asked the waiter/bartender “What would food critic Alice Levitt order?”  He was dumbfounded at my question and had no idea of who Seven Days food critic and published author was. She has written about this restaurant extensively. It was omen of things to come.
Based on the waiter’s suggestion I ordered their version of a BLT.  The menu description included guacamole and green tomato on this classic sandwich.  Also ordered was a side of their maple baked beans.
The first letdown occurred when the sandwich was placed in front of me.  When I see guacamole as part of a sandwich description I assume there will be a tablespoon or so of this tasty avocado based condiment.  Not so at the Prohibition Pig.  The guac was spread Julian Michael’s thin as to be almost transparent on this $9.50 sandwich.
Next was the green tomato slice on the sandwich.  I would have bet the farm that the menu had said a slice of fried green tomato was part of this offering but a warmed tasteless bottom slice of green tomato was served.
Finally the $4 side of maple baked beans was entirely disappointing.  The beans had not been cooked all the way through and were tough.  They were a good 45-60 minutes shy of being done.
For me this was a business lunch and I had a client with me.  It was not appropriate to be sending food back or arguing with wait staff in this situation.  I did attempt to call and email the restaurant that afternoon to discuss the dismal dining experience.
Both means of communicating with the Prohibition Pig went unanswered.  The prerecorded phone message for the listed number did not offer the option of leaving a message only that reservations were not accepted and no seating for incomplete parties.
After four days my email request for the menu description of the BLT went unanswered.  I have to conclude that the owners of the Prohibition Pig are more interested in separating dollars from the tourists that frequent the Mad River Valley and Stowe areas rather than being responsible to the local patrons.

text: I'm recently moved to Vermont and craving a decent taco.  I was recommended to the Mad Taco for supposedly some of the best in the area. I spent $60 on various types of tacos, to experience the range of flavors.  Very dissatisfied.  All tacos were over-salted. The tacos which were pork based all tasted like BBQ pork dipped is a sauce and label something different. Later in the evening, my stomach was ill from the BBQ undertones. Tacos were roughly $10 for two ($5 per) with no sides. I've had craft tacos for less than $4 with true boutique flavor.  Mad Taco is a confused restaurant.  Decor is sort of tropical, music is metal, and food is BBQ.  Nothing resonates with 'taco'.  Best of luck to the proprietors. Not returning.

name: Tracy F
text:
I've eaten at plenty of places, but this was amazing. From the moment we entered, we were treated far better than I've ever experienced. Even meals where we've booked the private room and have meals catered by a restaurant haven't been this nice.

The beer list is exceptional. 11 beers on tap and they're' not the usual. If you're looking for craft brews, you're in the right spot. In cans, you'll find Focal and Heady, there's also plenty from BBCO, Citizen Cider, etc. On tap, you're going to get Vermont and other New England breweries like Cousins, Connecticut Valley, Hill Farmstead, Oxbow, etc.

We were given plenty of samples, which was unexpected. First, I highly recommend the spicy house margarita. The spice isn't too fiery (per my tastes anyway). On a day when you have a stuffy nose and sore throat, this tequila would be exactly what I'd want to cure it.

Tacos you can mix and match. They'll actually customize anything you want. Kimchi was another sample I was offered. I adore kimchi. Theirs is the best I've had. There are several proteins available - different types of carnitas, beef, fish, shrimp, chicken, seitan, and yams. We were offered a few recommendations all were fantastic. They were so good we never headed to the sauce table. The carnitas I had was flavorful on its own. The carnitas cooked in salsa verde was a sample and even better than the plain one. The one in homemade mole is also fantastic.

We've overlooked the Essex Mad Taco. It won't happen again. It's inexpensive, friendly, and appreciated.

text: Man, their tacos are really yummy,  but I am really not overly fond of their food ordering system.  Yes, I can see that self-service seating and placing your food order with the bartender works fine when the place is slow, but it's a nightmare when the joint gets hopping during lunch and dinner times.  Customers are really hungry and impatient ,so people often grab someone else's food as soon as the food gets placed on the counter. Plus lotsa luck hearing your name being called for your food with all the crowd noise. But, other than this inefficient ordering system,  I can't say enough about how delicious the tacos actually are. Their Margaritas are tasty, too.  I  just don't go there when they're busy.

name: Ellen Johnson
text: Simply the best food I have had in Williston. It is a truly outstanding bakery combined with a truly excellent restaurant. Whether you want baked goods or delicious food you will get it here. Plus you can get either for take out or dine in which is a bonus. They have very nice staff and the head chef/owner is always around asking how everything was.  I will always be coming back as long as it is here.

name: Sandi Omanovic
text:
The fries and herbed aioli were perfect and I really enjoyed my tomato bisque and side salad. The salad was well dressed but the blackened chicken sandwich was flat on flavor and too much cheese (I know, there can be such thing)

The atmosphere was very nice and clean, friendly staff and a great selection of deserts. The prices were slightly high but still fair for the atmosphere and quality. Will be coming back

name: Molly Maroney
text: Delicious pastries, baked goods, and food. Extremely affordable in general, as well as for the excellent quality. The pastries and baked goods are light and perfectly baked with well balanced flavors. The food is delicious and they have the best fresh cut fries in the area. Hands down a must visit.

name: Nicole Reynolds
text: Great sandwiches and desserts. Really recommend for a great lunch or breakfast. Quick and easy spot. Comforting atmosphere. Great service.

name: Christopher Lei
text: Great brunch spot. The few times I have been, always plenty of seating available. The food arrives quickly after ordering at counter. Food is delicious as well.

name: Jason Russell
text: Excellent food and attention to details. High quality ingredients. Chef's Corner is a great asset to the neighborhood. Super friendly staff as well. Definitely recommended.

name: GRACE MCINTOSH
text: Good food. Good service all around. A must visit.

name: Michele Morton
text: Wonderful little place with the best Quiche ever! And the desserts!!!

name: Michele Denault
text: They're not your average cafe they are the five-star Cadillac version of a cafe with an amazing bakery and wonderful fresh taste

name: Abram Corbett
text: Food is excellent.  Great value.  Super friendly staff.

name: Kelvin Chan
text: I went with friends for a brunch on Sunday, not very packed. Food came out quite fast. I order salmon eggs Benedict. Eggs were cooked perfect, Hollandaise was good, but the bread was too big and I would prefer English muffin or even croissant. The desserts were GREAT. We order maple cheese cake, creme brulee, and Belgian, all have strong taste. I personally love the maple cheese cake, maybe I live in VT long enough that everything is better with maple.

name: Sarah Soltsov
text: Haven't ever had one bad thing here, everything's delicious and the service is super friendly.

name: Killian Hermann
text: Between Chef Jozef's brilliant Chef's Corner and Penny Cluse its a toss-up for best breakfast in new england. Probably give thw nod to Chef's Corner due to the extra space and ultra clean bathrooms. Not a sibgle bad thing on the menu ever.

name: kylie quesnel
text: Bought an incredible birthday cake for a friend's birthday.  It was delicious!

name: Jason Broughton
text: Very vibrant space and place. Fresh food, nice desserts selection. The chicken salad on crossiants is extremely tasty. It was served with small side salad. Great customer service from the initial order to the servers to departure! It gets filled quickly but there usually are available spots that open up quickly.

name: DEBRA BALLARD
text: I went in for the 1st time with my husband excited to try it today.  We stood in line for a long time, no one helped us. So then we stood over next to the "please wait to be seated" sign for over 10 min. Lots of employees were there, but no one made eye contact or said one word to myself or husband. Finally one girl turned around at the latte machine and asked us "what are you waiting on". My husband said we're just waiting to be seated.  We got a response of "oh no, you have to order over there and then you can be seated, but we're inbetween breakfast & lunch so its gonna be a while". Really looking forward to trying it out, but won't ever be going back now. Staff needs a MAJOR lesson in customer service. Food looks great, staff attitude no so much...

name: Lissa S
text: The new location is absolutely stunning and the patio with awning is wonderful weather permitting. The food is always delicious and it's a treat to pick out a pastry for desert. Highly recommend the specials, the dishes they create are an art and always so delicious. The front of house staff are typically very kind, and the kitchen staff know what they are doing. Never disappointed by the quality and care that is put into the food here. A special, truly local, fresh, and handmade treat!

name: Marty Gleason
text: A good variety of baked items and breakfast and lunch meals. Service was quick even though it was quite busy. The food was very good.

name: Sheb Jewell
text: Fresh soft bread. Great sandwiches. The onion rings and the dipping sauce they come with are the BOMB. Do yourself a favor come here for the onion rings.

name: Nichole Hathaway
text: Food was excellent and service was super fast

name: D K
text: Great breakfasts, lunches, and deli salads. Oh, can't forget amazing desserts.

name: Marie Thomas
text: Limited menu but always some good choices.  They have  gluten free rolls.  Their meringues are awesome.  Good breakfast choices.

name: Linda Viloria
text: This was such a great hidden gem.  This store is filled with joy.   Each section of the store, drags one to enjoy the Christmas section, plant section- totally awesome, food court,  stocking stuffers and gardening.  Wow seriously great place.  Don't take my word for it just Check it out yourself.

name: Prajna Chopra
text: Always great food. Owner and staff are very pleasant and accommodating, always a pleasure to eat here. Baked goods and pastries are delicious

name: Michael Connery
text: Fab! Everything looks so good ! A local to Williston told me how to get here. I’ll be back again! So good!

name: Margi Swett
text:
The food is amazing. As a good cook it's awesome when I get something delicious that I don't know how to make. I have the grilled cheese sandwich which was unlike anything I have EVER had. Portobello mushrooms, greens and gooey, delicious cheese between two perfectly grilled slices of bread. It was totally scrumptious!

My husband's ham and cheese quiche was great to. The pastries look fabulous but I was too happily replete to look very hard

name: Shannon Emmons
text: Stoped in and had a Cranberry Orange scone. It was absolutely delicious.

name: Kelsey Mattoon
text: Light, creamy and flavorful quiches. Great selection of cookies, pastries and desserts. Their macaroons are great... crunchy, sticky, and light. Brunch changes each weekend and their Chai teas explode with flavor.

name: Scott Spicer
text: Great spot for lunch and baked goods!

name: Philip Hyjek
text: Nice lunch in a hidden away spot. The food was good, but the price is somewhat high.

name: Salena Claire
text: The food is good, but VERY pricey. I was rung up for a $7 bottle of orange juice but since I was thirsty I figured I might as well buy it. The pancakes I had were okay, however two of them were raw in the middle.

name: Kevin Kittinger
text: Great rost beef sandwich with garlic mayo.  My wife had a ham and cheese quiche.   They came with side salad with a vinaigrette.   I would recommend having the dressing on the side as it was too much dressing.

name: Olivia Maxwell
text: Great food and service.

name: Emma Acorn
text: Always delicious and leaves me very full. They even had my favorite cookies.

name: Troy Frostad
text: Great weekend brunch, check out the specials. I have been to Chef's Corner on several different occasions and have never had anything but a great meal. They also have an exceptional assortment of pastries, cakes and confections. I highly recommend this place for breakfast, lunch and their selection of take-out desserts and salads.

name: Sean Leonardi
text: Great spot for lunch, and a really excellent bakery selection. Can't go wrong with any of their sandwiches. Very high quality.

name: Only Child
text: Was okay, service was slow and maple eclairs were a bit soggy on the bottom.

name: James Guiel
text: Spaced dining. Moderate amount of food . Very clean.

name: Yoga Chick
text: Any place that doesn't put prices on their pastries is a place I don't want to patronize. The pastries looked great, but none of them were labeled and I don't like to have to ask how much things are and don't want to be surprised by a  $7 price tag on a pastry

text: I had the Quiche with salad and red chai special. In a word, yum! 😋

name: Peter Chapin
text: This is a great place for breakfast or lunch. They also serve delicious desserts. The atmosphere is casual. You order at the counter and take a number. You then sit down and they bring you your food. There is outdoor seating. It's not the cheapest place around, but the food is worth it.

text: Very nice atmosphere, clean and plenty of tables. Tempting and very tasty pastries like small tarts and croissants. Full breakfast and lunch menu - you order at the counter and sit at your table where the food will be delivered to when ready. Self serve coffee bar. A little hard to find - located in the back of a small mall area. Not inexpensive - that's my only issue.

name: Noah Siddall
text: A nice, upscale breakfast/brunch/lunch spot. It's somewhat cutsie. You can buy macaroons from the bakery, or order food. Food was fresh, mostly sandwiches and salads. I enjoyed the atmosphere.

text:
Had breakfast here this morning and enjoyed it. Food (waffle!) was good-tasting and wait staff were friendly and efficient. The tables are quite close to each other, but you choose your own so that was fine.

We will definitely return to try other menu items.

name: Maggie Ferreira
text: Whenever I travel to Williston I ALWAYS make time to stop at Chefs Corner. The lunches are perfect. You can choose a salad and sandwich or go for a larger lunch. The sandwiches are beautiful and I always have enough to take home for dinner! Just when you think you can't fit another bite in you pass their insane desserts on the way out. Out comes the wallet and you have a special treat for the ride home.

One look at the case full of superbly crafted desserts as you walk into the restaurant should tell you right away how good this place is going to be. Where else can you buy Paris-brest light as a feather and -- oh my -- so many others!?!

Lunch is their specialty. I had a delicious authentic Banh mi sandwich! And there is a second case full of entrées to go with pastries on offer, too.

A real gem!

text:
Bacon, egg and cheese on a homemade english muffin with a cup of fruit $10

The english muffin was sort of doughy/raw in the center... I took the top piece off because I couldn't finish it, but I wanted the bacon, egg and cheese.  The bacon was thick and very good and they used real cheddar cheese.  It was a good sandwich, minus the raw/doughy center

name: Madeline Ostlund
text: They should be more careful about covid. They're not really taking it seriously. The place has great food and service but I worry about the safety. It's hard for businesses to stay afloat in these time which I understand

name: Jade Pineo
text:
Super wide selection. Have never had a bad meal from here!

Update*
Normally the vegan mac is to die for, but the order I just received via delivery is terrible. Bland, almost no sauce. Order of fries was severely underwhelming for $5. Super disappointing.

name: B D
text: Very cozy little cafe with plenty of gluten free/vegetarian options. I highly recommend the avocado toast. My waffle fries could have been more fresh and warmer, but my overall experience was great!

name: Cody Cervenka
text: SUPER friendly and attentive staff with so many vegan friendly options. We chose the vegan nachos and they were phenomenal. The decor and vibe of the place is very unique and retro, making it a must visit if you are in the area. We will definitely be back.

name: Parker Kelley
text:
Come hungry!  From the Pacman themed menus to the '80s music serenading us on the patio, it was a great time. On Wednesday it's half price burgers with the purchase of a beer. Waitress was kind and helpful, acknowledging the fact that the menu is huge and choices broad. Everything from breakfast to tacos. We started with the nachos. She had a breakfast type sandwich with sausage, eggs and cheese in a glazed donut. I had the Pit burger and a beer. We barely finished.

I wish we'd have discovered this place earlier in our trip. Definitely worth returning next time.

name: Tia Rooney
text: This is a gem for Burlington Vermont! Something for everyone! The bar makes great drinks, the kitchen makes great feel good food, the atmosphere transports you back in time. It's a fun place to be! Great staff too!

name: Christopher Lei
text:
New restaurant that recently opened in Burlington.

Pros:
- Restaurant utilizes the Nowait app
- Mimosa flight

Cons
- About the same price point as other brunch spots in Burlington, but not as good quality. Food isn’t bad by any means, just not worth the price point when there are other better options.
- They charge for VT maple syrup... I am guessing this is because the restaurant is a chain with other locations in MA and NH.

With their price point and the extra fee for maple syrup, I will prob just continue going to Penny Cluse or Sneakers for my brunches.

name: Emily Pomichter
text: We've been thinking of trying the place for a while, but never got around to it and boy have we been missing out! The mimosa flight was absolutely phenomenal and the food was fantastic as well. They have an amazing selection of all day breakfast, as well as sandwiches, burgers, specials, and more. The atmosphere is very cute, as it looks like a sparkly retro diner, and the service was attentive and helpful. We will definitely be going there again more frequently!

name: Chris Meli
text: Great food, friendly and efficient staff, comfortable diner feel.

name: Tommy Reynolds
text: Great place, will be back. Breakfast served all day with good hours. Eggs Benedict was good. Chicken and waffles was good but unexpectedly spicy (too much for me or my wife). Home fries good but a little too salty imo.

name: Peter Banks
text: Nice food. Friendly staff. Eat inside or outside. All day breakfast menu and lots more.

name: Shayna Joyce
text: Food was a 5, service was a 3. I guess their kitchen was super behind on Saturday. We were told there was a 30 minute wait, but we waited an hour. The hostess kept saying we were about to be seated, but it ended up taking a very long time. I got the belgium waffle, and it was very good. We all liked our meals. Would have been 5 stars if it wasn't for the delay. I'd still go back!

name: Andy Pearson
text: Service was great, very nicely remodeled. Love the theme. Outside seating is comfortable  Lots of great choices on the menu. I had the Irish Benedict. Unfortunately, I wasn't a fan. The eggs were over cooked, the corned beef hash was very dry and the whole plate was pretty cold. I will absolutely go back to try something else though.

name: David Warshow
text:
Highly recommend the Margarita flight!

Left to right: Dirty Blonde, Passionista (my favorite), the Blue Lagoon, and Classic.

name: Elijah Danyow
text: The food and drinks are always exceptional. Their menu is so big anyone can find something they'll like. Their drinks are also killer, who wouldn't want a flight of mimosas? The service, however, is very hit or miss. I've had great experiences, but I've also had some of the worst service I've ever experienced here. Overall, I'd recommend this place.

name: Nia W
text: Great atmosphere. Amazing food. Excellent Waitstaff 😍😍😍.

name: Sheb Jewell
text: Pretty awesome menu. Everything Ive had has been tasty. Their sauces are on point. The decor is pretty sweet too.

name: Elizabeth Rossano
text: Really exciting menu. Food was awesome. The tropical drink flight was a fun concept though the drinks themselves were pretty standard. The atmosphere is hella stimulating. I get easily over stimulated and the whole experience was rather overwhelming, but in a good way. Like going to a carnival. That’s unusual in a restaurant so that’s petty cool! And ultimately the food and service were great so what more do you need.

name: Ashley Lafleche
text: I loved the decorations and almost kitschy vibe it has going on, and I love breakfast food. We went here for an anniversary meal, which was probably not a great choice for the occasion, so overall my partner and I remained unimpressed. The service was exceptionally slow for a nearly empty restaurant, although the server was quite friendly. My food was lukewarm when it was served and didn't have much flavor. Love the idea of the restaurant, and it's probably better for a family or group of friends hanging out than for an anniversary meal.

name: Zachary York
text: Enjoyed my experience. Very trendy chain that had lots of college kids on a late Sunday morning. Food was tasty and the iced coffee was good too. I would go again. The booths are an interesting throwback element to the style there.

name: Rohit Shah
text: Great food and great ambience. Lot of unique brakefast and lunch item to choose from. Friendly staff. Bar available separate.

name: Jesse Ruiz
text:
Was packed for brunch but there were 2 bar seats which was a nice, surprising alternative to the hour long wait for a table. Service was excellent. Succinct but as friendly as the name implies. Food came out quickly considering, and was better than expected.
9/10, will definitely be going back.

name: Kate Castonguay
text: Very good, chicken and waffles were some of the best I've had. Plate looked beautiful when it came out. It's a big place and was very busy, which of course most Burlington area breakfast/brunch places are. I felt forgotten about after our food. Until that point, though, our server was very sweet and funny. I chalked it up to screaming babies around us and being busy. Will definitely go back for another round. Husband had a breakfast sandwich which was a great portion and he was pleased. My mimosa had the appropriate hint of orange to it, his bacon bloody was missing the bacon.

name: Jared Reid
text: This is a hoping place in a Sunday morning. The wait was going to be 45 min for two people. Luckily there was room at the bar. The avacado toast was cooked to perfection. The quiche hash was unlike anything I've ever had before. It was like a McDonald's hash brown bowl with eggs in it.  How can that be bad? If we ever make it back will definitely need to get the memosa flight.

name: Blade Leblanc
text: Great scramble!!

name: Renee Willard
text:
Decent food. Trivia night on Tuesdays which is fun. A bit steep for a college kid, but worth it for a treat. The cocktail I ordered was pretty good. The maple something.. I forget the name. Anyway..  great service as well, the waitress was on her game even when it was busy.
Would go back for the mac and cheese grilled cheese.

name: Megan Niquette
text: Great funky atmosphere. Barbacoa eggs benny was out of this world delicious. Can't wait to go back!

name: Crystal Butzlaff
text: Loved it. The pot-ach-os were insane. My husband is obsessed with the biscuits and gravy. Large portions leave you satisfied.

name: Blair Wolston

name: Aurora Nowak
text:
I'm giving it a 4 and not 5 star for a couple reasons.
For TLDR, see below...

1. The first time I was there everything was phenomenal: service, food, space.
2.  This time was a different story- and quite a variety in experience:. First of all I was told to make my reservation on Yelp - so I did.  And phones knowing where you are these days I assumed it made a reservation for Burlington VT.  When we got there, the attendant told us that the system most likely reserved us in Burlington MA. (Not restaurant s fault-understood.) The app or website sux that way.
Now this all would have been forgiven had not the following events transpired:
A) every 20 minutes we checked in, they told us 20 more minutes.
B) when we FINALLY got our table we ordered right away (cuz we waited for 40 more minutes even though we were supposed to be pushed up in line.). However our order took so long to get to us that I finished my boozy drink.  And I take -no exaggeration- an hour to drink boozy beverages first thing in the day. Also the crowd was dying down so we're they getting eggs straight from the farm?
C) when we got our food -i ordered the Irish benny- the eggs were TINY and not runny.  And I'm pretty sure my friends were in a similar boat for quality of food.

The SAVING GRACE was the waitress checked in and I mentioned the eggs.  The manager came up and comped my meal and apologized about the app shenanigans and the wait.  We also, for all the michigas, received free appetizer cards.

TLDR: when reserving on Yelp make sure it says Burlington VERMONT.  But Don't go/ put yourself in line when the wait is 2 hours on Yelp.
They usually do have good food and good service, this time was a HUUUGE fluke.

name: Killian Hermann
text:
Update Nov2018: Kudos and happy to see the vt maple syrup menu change, thank you. Now we just need to talk about this coffee.... Tried for the first time today, had to ask for another cup because i thought maybe the taste was from a bad creamer, but nope, a "freah pot" cup with no additives reveals the worst tasting coffee i've had which includes a number of vending machines across the US. Just unspeakably bad. Bummer.
--
Basic commercial foodservice, nothing special unless leveraging alcohol margin in a college city is special, haha. Only thing special about this place is upcharging people $2 to avoid the horrible tableside maple syrup to get a thimbleful of VT maple syrup, in Vermont. Extra star given for friendly service. Updated: French toast was good and reasonably priced. Thanks for the reply but trying to spin a maple syrup upcharge as you supporting local maple syrup economy is, at best, disingenuous. Like that's some kind of localvore marketing, i guess? Hey everybody look at how much this place supports our local maple sugaring industry, you can choose to pay 2.50 for fifty cents of maple sugar... Because its so hard to find good maple sugar to buy in Burlington. Choose a quality product and figure out your plate costs. Looking forward to my next visit.

resp.text:
Killian, Thanks for your feedback.
Allow us to assure you that our Real Vermont Maple Syrup is 100% Grade A Amber Rich, and a part of the Vermont Organic Farmers Network. We are proud to support a small, local family farm, Branon's Maple Ridge. In order to offer this product, we do charge a small extra fee which helps sustain this local sugar house. We are terribly sorry you did not enjoy the syrup, but we value your input, and thank you very much for the extra star for the friendly service! Please come see us again!

name: Nicole Reynolds
text: UPDATED REVIEW- They changed their menu to automatically provide Vermont maple syrup with all of their sweet stuff items.  Which is nice. As always the food is pretty good. Some of the portions are so big I feel like I waste food. Also the coffee is disgusting. PREVIOUS REVIEW- (So far I have been 2 times. Each time my meals were honestly huge portions and very delicious. I had great service from a lovely lady the first time, subpar the next from a gentleman. What I didnt like was the fact they were charging 2.50 for a tiny bottle of maple syrup. We were told by the waiter that it's to support a local sugar house. But there are places all over town that would never upcharge for vermont syrup. I question whether or not it's because they come in mini bottles with the friendly toast labeling. I'd rather it be labeled with the maple house it is from.)

resp.text: Thanks for trying is out a couple times! Rest assured that we stock 100% pure grade A amber rich organic Vermont maple syrup from Branon's Maple Ridge. We are so proud to support this small, locally owned and operated family sugar house. They are nice enough to bottle their fantastic syrup for us, and to apply the Friendly Toast label to their product in order to provide a keepsake for folks who would like to take some home. We also sell hats, shirts, mugs, and more with our logo on them for people to purchase as souvenirs. Please take a look menu prices around town, I think you'll find that the "free" maple syrup being offered elsewhere comes with inflated base prices, something we avoid in order to welcome families on a budget.

name: Rich Pecor
text: The receptionist was too foolish to take down a phone number when she told us there would be a 15 min wait and she would find us when our table was ready. Kind of skeptical of how this was going to work out we waited outside due to how busy and small the waiting area was for a family of 5, being winter we sat in the car. We come back into the building 13 mins later and she was seating people who walked in before us the second time. Needless to say we stood there with three children for 30 mins before they offered us a 4 seat table and asked if we could squeeze another chain in. Not impressed only half way decent thing was bar tender complimented how well behaved our kids were and offered them something to drink while we wait. I know covid is especially hard on restaurants right now but damn.

resp.text: We are sincerely sorry that you didn't have a great waiting experience when you came by with your family, Rich. Please know that we appreciate the honest feedback as it can always help us to make improvements with how we do things around here. If you're ever inclined to give us a second chance, we'd welcome the chance to show you the five-star service that we're capable of. Cheers, Madison Brewing

resp.text: Eric, thanks for the high marks all around. You've got a warm welcome back anytime. Cheers, Madison Brewing

We will definitely look into expanding our menu in the future. As for the prices, please know that we make everything with high-quality ingredients. We hope you can understand. If you have any other questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out directly. We'd love the chance to give you a five-star experience in the future.
Cheers, Madison Brewing

resp.text: Mary Lou, Our Flat iron steaks on the menu do come with shrimp and it does state that unless you ordered off the specials and we accidentally put it on. We do appreciate the kind feedback, and we’re grateful for your support. Thanks so much for the high rating. -Cheers, Madison Brewing

name: NancyCz
text:
We eat here 2-3 times a month, and it's split between take out and eat in. They have the best burgers in Bennington, hands down, and the kale Caesar is fan-freaking-tastic. I eat a lot of them.

Madison's offer casual, family friendly dining with an outdoor space and inside bar in addition to two large dining areas. There is seating at high tops in the bar, too, just order and pick up your food. Specials are offered daily and provided on a sheet separate from the menu.

The food is consistently good although the pasta is often too much (this is a trend in Bennington) and gets old fast.

The beer is okay. It's the only brew pub in town (plus!) but if you are a beer snob like we are it is solidly "okay". Every once in a while something comes out that stands out. Other than that, it's nothing to write home about.

My gripe with Madison's is flaky service. More than once I have had them forget something. Not a huge deal but an amateur mistake. I have a significant food allergy so it's best to check your order if you need something omitted. I once asked for no Caesar dressing (explaining that it was allergy related) and they put it on anyway. When it came back after being sent back they had put the dressing in a to go cup that had spilled onto the plate. I rarely ask for omissions/substitutions and when I do I specify that it's an allergy. I wish they'd be more careful.

Definitely a solid place with great food, good beer, friendly albeit flaky service and cool artwork on the walls.

resp.text:
Thank you so much for getting in touch, Nancy! It's lovely to have support like yours, especially since we know you've found some menu favorites over time. We're disappointed seeing there's been a couple issues with your orders -- we take food allergies incredibly seriously, and it sounds like we haven't demonstrated that. We appreciate you getting in touch with this, and we hope you'll make it back. We'd love to show you some of our newer brews to see what sticks!

Cheers,
Madison Brewing

text: Wanted so much to like this place... Obviously awesome location and same great menu & drinks as Shelburne Road Spot. But after 4 separate visits and experiencing absolutely HORRENDOUS service each time... I'm done here and encourage everyone else local to boycott. Staff are constantly beyond slow and stupid and confused and often just plain rude to customers. Want the hostess to shrug her shoulders and act like you're bothering her when you ask for a table, want to wait an hour for a table, a half hour for your drinks, be served wrong drinks, another hour for MEDIOCRE overpriced food that waitress never checks up on, and half hour to get your check while staff wander around lost and more interested chatting with each other than serving the customers? Want hardcore techno music blasted next to your head at 4pm while trying to have a conversation or enjoy the view? Then this is your place! And you can have it!! The tourist trap location will probably ensure this establishment's survival, but locals should avoid like the plague. Much better "spots" on the waterfront for food, drinks, and a view than here (Foam, Splash, Burlington Bay, Skinny Pancake). Owners here need to invest in serious staff training next season to improve their currently awful reputation.

text:
My wife and I were very put off by our experience. I would like to start by saying this had nothing to do with the waitstaff, they were attentive and very apologetic. That unfortunately is where the praise stops.
To start with their location is awful! A water front restaurant is great but all we could smell was the waste water treatment plant from the left and the exhaust from the ferry on the right.
We were sat at about 3:30 which admittedly is an off time to get food. Once we were sat we found out that they were only serving drinks and chips with salsa until 4PM. We thought this was a little strange because everyone around us seemed to have food?
We didn’t worry to much about it. It was only a half hour and we would have a drink and chips to hold us over. The salsa was nothing more then diced tomatoes and onions and the chips were so stale, that they were chewy! The snack was a real let down. When 4PM finally rolled around we asked to order. It was then explained to us that now only the appetizers menu was available and the full menu started at 5PM!
At this point we were getting real hungry and the lack of honesty about the food was becoming evident. We were desperate so we decided to order an appetizer and another drink to hold us over and we would go elsewhere for dinner. We tried to order the mussels. After a couple minutes the waitress came back and explained that they were out of mussels, so we tried to order the sliders, also out of sliders!
“so what do you have available?”
“Chicken wings and nachos”
We had already experienced their corn chips and didn’t need a repeat. At this point we were too fed up to order anything else. we canceled our drinks and asked for our check. Truly one of the worst attempted dinning experience i’ve had in a long time.

text:
2 months ago I gave a five stars review to The Spot on the Dock for atmosphere, location, food quality and service. Since then we have been back several times, sometimes for dinner with friends other times just for drinks and beautiful sunsets. Each time we have enjoyed your friendly and well trained staff along with delicious meals. Last night, September 6 was slightly different. We arrived by boat around 6:30pm and I went to the hostess station to make a reservation for two. There was nobody in the line, so the hostess told me 15 minutes wait at the most. Since the wait was so short I decided to sit down on one of the bench across from the restaurant. 40 minutes later, around 7:10pm we were still waiting. I went up to the hostess and asked why two other couples who arrived after us, had been taken to their table before us. She replied that their names were ahead of ours on her list. I accepted that and she gave me no further explanation. I watched het clean and set up a table for two at the far corner of the restaurant and I assumed it would be our table. The hostess, however went back to her station and continued taking reservations from people who were trickling in. After waiting another five minutes I went back up to her and said pointing to the empty table:" is this our table? her reply was curt as she said:" yeah! You can go sit down, it's your table. No one escorted me to the table and I phoned my husband who was waiting on the boat. We sat there waiting for menus that had not been placed on our table. After five minutes I went up to the hostess station and asked if we could get some menus. The hostess, who heard me and was looking at me, ignored my request and a waitress who happened to be there, apologized and took menus to our table. I wonder if this young lady, who was the hostess last night could be better trained to handle the public.
After that incident, we had a lovely waitress who took the time to explain to us how the reservation system works at your restaurant. If the hostess had taken the time to tell me, it was not busy at the time, I would have been more understanding. We live in Shelburne and are very involved in the boating community. Your restaurant is our favorite place on the waterfront and this mishap will not stop us from coming back and enjoying your place. I just wish your hostess had better communications skills.

name: Nicholas Bucci
text: Spot on place to eat and chill, great outdoor seating

name: Andy Dufresne
text: My order for a chicken sandwich without avacados got messed up not once but twice. First time i was brought a bacon and avacado sandwich. I sent that one back and received a chicken sandwich with avacados. Waitress was very apologetic and offered free dessert. I passed on that offer .... just wanted to get out of that place. Music was also very annoying. I miss the old Breakwaters and local bands on summer weekends.

name: Jonathan Stevens
text: This restaurant is the Lakeside brother of The Spot on Shelburne Road.  Good food, good service, and a beautiful setting on Lake Champlain.

name: Michael Bryan
text: Beautiful location, the wait staff was attentive and pleasant, the drinks were ok except for the mojito (and it was bad!)

name: Glenn A
text: Nice view of Lake Champlain

name: John Abry
text: What can I say... You can't beat the atmosphere and the food is great to boot!

name: Charles Keeler
text: Great meal with great views!

name: Nicole Reynolds
text: The only reason this place is receiving 2 stars is because Vermont has a beautiful lake and the views were great here. OTHER than that this place was awful. When we showed up the hostess told us there was only appetizers/drinks. available until 5 when dinner started. So reluctantly we sat down. There was about 6 options for appetizers and a ton of drink options. So we ordered a mojito and the avacodo fries. The mojito was the worst drink I've ever tried. Nothing but mix with pitiful mint leaves. Absolutely horrible. Then the avacodo fries came out they were barely covered in breading and definitely were not organic. The chipotle sauce they came with tasted store bought. This place had a poor vibe like the wait staff didn't want us to even sit down. They didnt make us pay for the mojito so that was a plus. I cant tell you how dinner tastes but don't go before 5pm. If you want options.

name: Eli Gordon
text: Great food and view!

name: John Ware
text: View is good

name: Mark Jackson
text: Great venue! Can't beat drinks right next to the water and watching the sun set!

name: Steve Yerby
text: Drinks are amazing!

name: Oliver Griswold
text: Great sunset...

name: Hans Brakeley
text: No brunch menu any more, exceptionally rude bartender, 1 star.

name: Roy Minton
text: Great food

name: Jamie LaBerge
text: I want more avacado fries

name: Joseph Fusco
text: Great atmosphere!

name: Ed Green
text: Can't beat the location.

name: JoJoe Williams
text: Get place to go after work.

name: Heidi Tkaczyk
text: Yummies

name: Cindy Anderson
text: Nice atmosphere

name: Michael Biama
text: The Mitchell!!!

name: Courtney Poquette
text: Staff was friendly and outgoing. The food..... was phenomenal... I strongly suggest ordering the brussel sprouts!

resp.text: Hi Courtney!  Thank you so much for your review - we're thrilled to hear you like the brussels sprouts!

name: Jeremy Hudson
text: The "BBQ for 2" (3 meats, 4 sides) is turning into a weekly thing for our family. For about $50 we can feed the 4 of us with heaps of slow cooked, savory cuts of meat and sides, with leftovers! As a stay-at-home-dad and seemingly "full-time chef" these days, Bluebird is my bailout when I've run out of steam and creativity. The curbside pickup (in compostable boxes in a nice branded grocery tote) is easy and convenient with delivery to my car window so the little hellions can stay put in the backseat. Thank you Bluebird!

name: Troy Frostad
text: Good BBQ and very good beer list. Been here several times and food is consistently good and the service has always been great. I recommend Bluebird bBQ.

name: Zoran Bjelic
text:
Awesome little local gem, food is always on point.  Great friendly, knowledgeable staff that truly caters to the customer needs.  We always go with the BBQ for the Two.  Gives you a option of selecting a variety of their fine meats and delicious sides.
Great job guys, keep up the good work!

resp.text: Awesome to receive 5 Stars from you, Zoran. Thank you!

name: sean hourigan
text: Best place to grab dinner and a drink! Cozy comfortable place for a great night! Best bbq around.

resp.text: Thank you for the compliments! We appreciate it, Sean!

name: JG DeBiasio
text: Great way to get a filling meal without the fuss.  Limited menu.  Chicken tender, pulled pork delicious,  ribs good.  Side dishes ok.  Safety protocols great.

name: Filip Galiza
text: For most of America, Burlington is synonymous with outstanding cuisine.  Bluebird is one of those places that makes this town that "outstanding cuisine" town.  Get ready for some delicious and fresh portions, unique sides that are packed with their own flavors (and big enough to be a nice meal), and a solid beer selection.  This is a must for anyone visiting Burlington.

name: Jean Roberts
text: Try the Nashville hot chicken sammich!  Pulled pork is amazing, and early bird specials give a very decent price drop.  Menu has improved greatly over the years, offering some ramen bowls and vegetarian options, so it isn't "just" BBQ.

resp.text: Hi Jean - Thank you for the 5 Star review and feedback! We appreciate it!

name: Gregory Morris
text: This place is a must! You can tell how much they care about what they do by how good the beans and fries are. Most BBQ places I've been these items seem like an after thought. Delicious. Really delicious. The ribs and burnt ends really blew my mind and totally beat my expectations. I'm definitely not the authority on BBQ but this was great IMHO. I ate at the bar and my service was exceptional - even took the time to explain all the sauces. I'll be back!

resp.text: Hi Gregory! Thank you so much for the awesome review! We are so happy you enjoyed your experience! Hope to see you again soon.

name: Gladimir Sanon
text: I've been here quite a few times and my only problem with blue bird is the inconsistency in the food. There are times I go there and I'm impressed, then I'll go there afterwards, order the same thing, and its simply not as good as the previous time. Still worth a shot though!

name: SPACEMAN
text: Great service. Food was good but not great. Awesome smokers outside!

name: Sher Woei Foon
text: Cosy setting and food is amazing. Ordered  buffalo wings and BBQ burger. Nicely done.

name: Brynn Casamassa
text: Amazing BBQ in Burlington, VT? Sure is! We had the BBQ for two which came with 3 meats and 4 sides. Everything was delicious! The mac and cheese is creamy and was my favorite side. The brisket was unlike any I've ever had! I would definitely recommend!

resp.text: Hi Brynn! Thank you so much for the awesome review!! We appreciate it!

name: Bradley Day
text: Pretty good BBQ for the northeast. Service is terrific.

resp.text: Thank for the compliments, Bradley! We appreciate you!

name: Kyle Ledoux
text:
Must eat BBQ!
This place is your best bet in the area if you are hankering for some BBQ.
The menu offers a wide variety of solid BBQ standbys like 15 hour brisket or bbq chicken, as well as some more creative specialty dishes like pulled pork nachos.
The drink section is on point with a great selection of local brews as well as some macro beers if you want to crush a cheapie with your meal.
We sat outdoors on the patio and had a sweet view of the river below, but the inside and bar area are really cozy and worth checking out.
Go here for great bbq, a cozy atmosphere and friendly staff!
(Check out the site online for reservations and some sweet early eater specials not mentioned on the menu )

name: M S
text: Reasonable prices for excellent food!

name: Reggie Allen
text: Great BBQ! Great bartender, had a nice chat while I waited for the rest of the party to arrive. Great place to eat or get take out, My wife and I will be back for sure.

resp.text: We're so happy to hear that you and your wife enjoyed yourselves! Thank you for the review Reggie!

name: Nathan
text: Great BBQ. Amazing for Vermont. Ribs are probably the best I've had

name: Dash Porter
text: After hearing amazing things about some of the "best barbeque on the east coast" we decided to check it out. Immediately the place gives a vibe of the traditional BBQ joint with a cabin feel of wood planked walls and floors. A full bar lined the wall with plenty of personal space at our table. Luckily there was no weekday crowd (likely due to the huge snowstorm keeping people away), but I've heard the weekends can be incredibly packed. Of course, my 15-hr roast brisket was absolutely delicious. Each bite was a perfectly, savory, mouthwatering forkful. Lightly doused with a homemade spicy barbeque sauce, and paired with local Vermont brews on tap, it was an absolutely enjoyable dinner event. The service matches the delicious food with knowledgable and friendly staff. I would indeed recommend this place to anyone and will be back soon myself.

resp.text: Thank you for taking the time to review us. We are so happy that you enjoyed your time with us! We look for ward to seeing you again soon, Dash!

name: Elizabeth Matthews
text: Amazing bbq!!!! Super friendly too

name: Benjamin Hamm
text: This place is amazing. The atmosphere is good and the food even better. Friendly staff and great views. I ate this burger that burgered better than most burgers can burger. Too bad I live hundreds of miles away. Will go back if I can.

resp.text: Hi Benjamin - Thank you so much for the awesome review! We appreciate it and are so happy you enjoyed the burger! Thank you for joining us.

name: Matt Lorence
text: Really good ribs, pretty good chicken. A little dry for my tastes.

name: Margo Thayer
text: One of my absolute favorite places in the Burlington area!! I crave Bluebird regularly. I can't live without the fried brussels with maple gastrique, their pulled pork is to die for and the smoked turkey falls apart in your mouth. I've tried everything on the menu and have never been disappointed. Honestly, the food is so good nothing else really matters however, the fabulous cocktails and friendly staff are icing on the cake 💜🍗🍸🌟😘

resp.text: Thank you for the 5 Stars!

name: Kyle Paulus
text:
Wow, Bluebird has fantastic food and a great beer selection. I ordered the ramen bowl and it was huge, chocked full of noodles, your selection of meat, jalapenos and scallions with a handful of radishes and a soft boiled egg on top. Food is reasonably priced for BBQ and the waitstaff was excellent. I plan on making this place a regular visit when I'm in Burlington.

The brisket is also amazing. I ordered it with fries and corn bread. The corn bread was served as mini muffins which was a little disappointing but still decent. Still recommend the place.

name: Marla Emery
text: Thanks, Bluebird Barbecue, for helping make our family celebration easy and delicious!

name: Valerie W
text: Incredible! The National reviews are no lie. Just get there and be hungry, it is sensational.  Loved it. People are fantastic.

resp.text: Thank you so much for the awesome review! We appreciate it!

name: Timothy Olver
text: Bluebird, I like you (most especially for your dinner for 2 option), but you've got to step up your game nowadays. There are plenty other BBQ joints popping up in the area and you've got to keep reinventing or get lost in the shuffle. I love some of your offerings, such as the brisket and burnt ends, but there needs to be a little more to keep me choosing you over competition. Show me that your'e trying and I'll be back through those doors.

resp.text: Thank you for the review, Timothy!

name: Dustin Charland
text: Truly the only real barbecue place around. The food is good and facility is nice. I have never been super impressed with the food but it is the best BBQ for around here but wont be the best BBQ you will ever have. I do still recommend they do have a interesting menu!

resp.text: Thank you Dustin for your review!

name: Anne Borchers
text: We saw the episode of Diner's, Drive-ins and Dives featuring Bluebird Barbeque and thought we would give it another try. It did not disappoint. BOGO 6 pack of wings and the Ramen was out of this world. Their pulled pork is always a hit. Looking for some unique BBQ dishes, this is the place. We will be back again very soon.

name: Italia LaRocco
text: Turkey and sweet potatoes were amazing. Other food was very good. Kinda fatty pulled pork though. Many drinks available including some really great ciders.

resp.text: Thank you for the review and feedback! We appreciate it!

name: Valerie Patrick
text: Pulled pork with gold sauce (a spicy vinegar-mustardy sauce - yummy), a spare ribs rice bowl, and a great selection of Vermont brews, wines, and drinks made for a special dinner on a Saturday night. The location in the Winooski River is quite special too.

name: Ethan Kichura
text: Excellent food, excellent service, excellent views over the river, reasonably priced and almost no wait. What a great hidden gem!! We will absolutely be back soon.

resp.text: Hi Ethan - Thank you for the 5 Star review and feedback. We appreciate it! See you soon!

name: Alejandro Molina Moctezuma
text: Good food, and great service. Drinks are good. Make sure to get a reservation!!!

resp.text: Hi Alejandro! Thank you for the review! We appreciate the compliments!

name: Richard Spradling
text: They live up to the hype! Great food and great service! Definitely try the Mac & Cheese as well as the ribs. But honestly you should try everything because it's all spectacular.

resp.text: We are so pleased that you enjoyed your time with us Richard! Thank you so much for the feedback. We look forward to seeing you again soon!

name: Liisa Reimann
text: Food is amazing, cocktails are unique and delicious (I mean, come on, a bacon manhattan?!!), easy to get to, fab ambiance. Blah blah blah. JUST GO.

resp.text: Hi Liisa! Thank you for your review! We appreciate the 5 stars!

name: Sean Fitzpatrick
text: What can I say besides this BBQ is no joke! Best BBQ I've ever had in the Northeast. Got the BBQ for 2, comes with choice of 3 meats and 4 sides, also the Mexican street corn and cornbread. All amazing

name: Matt Brady
text: BBQ was Excellent!!! Great Service. Definitely will go back, you should try it too!!

resp.text: Thank you for the review! We are so happy to hear you enjoyed your experience!

name: James
text: Great BBQ and very friendly staff. I'd definitely recommend the BBQ for two with the brisket, pulled pork and ribs (the ribs are to kill for). I'd pass on the turkey, you only get two small slices, which for two people isn't great. Otherwise great place, with going to.

resp.text: Hi James! Thank you for the 5 star review. We are so happy to hear you went for the BBQ for Two! Thank you for the feedback on the turkey - we appreciate this, as it helps us continue to grow!

name: Anne Buckley
text: Excellent! Yummy bbq, attentive staff, great energy. Check it out, you won't be disappointed.

resp.text: Thank you so much Anne! What a great review!

name: Emily Pomichter
text: This is definitely the best barbeque I've had in the north. It's very authentic, smoked on location and they have a variety of homemade barbeque sauces to suite all tastes. The family platter is especially good as you get a taste of everything, and for $100 it feeds 5-6 people. They also have a great beer selection and excellent cocktails

resp.text: Thank you for your review Emily! We appreciate it! Glad you enjoyed our Family Reunion!

name: Heather Mossey
text: The Nashville hot chicken sandwich was delicious! As was the painkiller.

resp.text: So glad you enjoyed the Nashville Hot and Painkiller, Heather! Thank you for the review!

name: frank flynn
text: Great food, our server Ashley was very pleasant and cheerful, we will be back.

resp.text: Hi Frank! Thank you so much for the 5 Star review and a shoutout to one of our servers! We appreciate it!

name: Sonja H
text: The food was amazing, my friend says it's the best she's had outside of Texas! Someone had mentioned that this place was expensive, so I avoided it. Glad I finally went as the prices were actually reasonable and about the same as everywhere else. I'll be back! :)

resp.text: Hi Sonja! We are so glad you made it in and are very happy to here that you had a good experience with us. We look forward to having you back. Here's a link to our Early Bird Specials (just in case)! https://www.bluebirdbbq.com/specials

name: alden cushman
text: Surprisingly good BBQ so far north! Really well done pork and brisket, even the Mac and cheese. Best BBQ in town.

resp.text: Hi Alden! Thank you so much for the review! We appreciate it!

name: Chip Hart
text: Excellent service, consistent quality, and one of the best beer lists in town.

resp.text: Hi Chip! Thank you for the 5 Stars!

name: Cat
text: Considerate staff from the moment I walked in. Servers were present but not pushy, I felt no pressure to place an order before I was ready. Each dish was well presented, flavorful without being over seasoned, and well sized portions, a Goldilocks situation (not too big, not too small). The atmosphere was relaxed and had a homie feel to it, old hard wood floors and beautiful wood beams. I felt comfortable and well cared for from start to finish.

resp.text: Hi Catherine - Thank you so much for sharing your experience. We are happy to hear that you enjoyed yourself and appreciate the compliments!

name: Jason Ficociello
text: Amazing food, hospitality and beer selection. Try Austen's Ale brewed by BriBri Springs Brewery!

resp.text:
Thank you for the compliments, Jason! We appreciate the 5 Stars.

PS- We are huge fans of Austen's Ale from Bri Bri Springs Brewery!

name: JMan 127
text: Amazing food! If you love BBQ, then this local restaurant is a must.

resp.text: Thank you!

name: Wanda Zygmuntowicz
text: Great bar experience. Excellent bar tender... wonderfully crafted cocktails.  And the "Q" is unsurpassed in Burlington!

resp.text: Thank you Wanda! We so appreciate the compliments!

name: Bradford Morgan
text: We shared the "Family Reunion" for 4.  Easily enough for 6.  Terrific and tender ribs, baby backs, chicken, turkey, brisket, pulled pork and 8 sides for $99.00!  Adding great cornbread was unnecessary but worth it.  We all thought it was exceptional and the staff was amusing and attentive.  Outstanding.

name: Meagan Villone
text: AMAZING. The brisket was to DIE for and the mac n' cheese, forget about it. So good! Can't wait to come back.

resp.text: Hi Meagan! Thank you so much for the awesome review! We are so happy to hear you enjoyed our brisket. Looking forward to having you back!

name: Mark Barnes
text: One of my favorites in the area. Great food and beer selection. The sauces alone are awesome. Early Bird specials are available and discounted burgers on Monday's (they rock).

resp.text: Hi Mark - Thank you for the 5 Star review. We appreciate it and are so happy to hear we are a favorite for you!

name: Jane Day
text: Very helpful and knowledgeable about food allergies, even the leftovers were too good to waste a bit of!

resp.text: Thank you, Jane! So happy you enjoyed your leftovers!

name: Randy Abair
text:
I love this place and eat here more often than can be considered financially responsible... but the BBQ for 2 special on Tuesday nights is hard to turn down... every week. 3 meats, 4 sides and large portions = very satisfied and full customers who take home a lot of leftovers.

Everything is fresh at Bluebird but I have to specifically point out their wings which are smoked on site (you can see the smokehouse as you walk in from parking). The pit master wings are the best wings I’ve ever had and I can’t think of anyone around who even comes close.

I’d be remiss if I didn’t also mention the friendly and helpful staff at Bluebird... they’re always willing to tell customers about the various sauces they offer and which meats they’re best paired with. Speaking of their house made sauces, they actually make their own catchup too, which I can’t get enough of.

name: Micah Mutrux
text: It's tasty, but loses a star for being super salty (for my taste) and another for being above average price. I still look forward to it, but not generally more than once per year.

resp.text: Hi Micah - Thank you for reviewing us. We are so sorry to hear that our food was too salty. We'd love to chat more about this with you. If this interests you, please reach out to samantha@bluebirdvermont. Thank you - Samantha, Hospitality Director

name: Elliott Dupont
text: Service and food were both excellent. It can be a bit pricey but in this area that shouldn't be a surprise. I highly recommend this place!

resp.text: Thank you for the compliments and for the feedback! We appreciate it!

name: Erin Hudecek
text: Everything on the menu is amazing, and great service!

resp.text: Hi Erin! Thank you for the awesome review!

name: Nicole Russell
text: The pitmaster dry rub wings, mushroom ramen (spicy), collard greens, kale and quinoa salad were delicious!! Our friend Jon mixing up drinks, doing his thing, is definitely one of the best bartender's at Bluebird!! Go visit Bluebird BBQ if you haven't tried it, you won't be disappointed.

resp.text: Hi Nicole! Thank you so much for your review and compliments! We appreciate it!

name: Scott Batdorf
text: The best barbecue around. Get a table or we always enjoy a spot at the bar. Great service!

resp.text: We are so happy to hear that you enjoy Bluebird Barbecue! Thank you for the review Scott!

name: Bob Leidy
text: Great beers, BBQ, and fantastic sides (specially the pit beans!).  The Raman is so flavorful!  Service is very friendly and helpful

resp.text: Bob - thank you for the review! We are so happy to hear you enjoyed our beer list as well as our barbecue and service!

name: King Rainbow
text: It's the best BBQ and Ben is the best bartender.

resp.text: Thank you for the compliments!

name: Ben Virgilio
text:
Always a good time here! Some of the best barbecue in the area, the food is always consistently good. Staff has always been on point everytime I've been here.

Space is larger than it looks, but it fills up quick. Multiple rooms keep the noise down and creates a cozy feel.

resp.text: Thanks for the 5 Stars, Ben!

name: cory loudon
text: Great BBQ.  Take out is almost a great as dine in.  Tables are a bit small, or maybe the trays just have so much on them that it makes the tables look smaller.  Regardless, order anything you want and whatever you order will definitely hit the spot.  I have vegetarian friends that love the place.

name: Anna Bachand
text: Hands down the best barbecue I've ever tasted. Everything was perfect from the food to the service. Elina was amazing, definitely will be back!

resp.text: Anna, we are so happy to hear that you enjoyed the food and service! We appreciate the review!

name: David Szarkowski
text: Fantastic tasting food, very good beer selection.

resp.text: Thank you for the awesome review!

name: Grace Ross
text: Portions are huge food fanominal! Service was friendly and fantastic

resp.text: Thank you for your compliments!

name: Tom Chamberlain
text: Holy smokes, that place is good. This was my first visit and we went with big appetites. Not let down one bit.

resp.text: We are so happy to hear you enjoyed your first visit, Tom! We hope to have you back again soon!

name: James Cook
text: Great service from Kyle....5stars on the wings

resp.text: Thank you!

name: Tim White
text: Great food! Full of flavor and cooked/smoked to perfection. The wait staff is attentive but not bothersome. Great beer selection and reasonable prices. I've eaten here several times and the experience has always been great.

name: Samuel Bonchek
text: Recommend sitting in their screened-in porch or outside, got the platter for two which was nice, couldn't finish all of it. Highly recommend the brisket.

resp.text: Hi Samuel - Thank you so much for the review! We are excited you enjoyed our porch and the BBQ for Two!

name: David Mize
text: Very good BBQ... Ribs & pork belly were great, burnt ends were just ok.... The mashed sweet potatoes were amazing, the Mac&cheese was about average.  The service & staff were outstanding. Very enjoyable meal, definitely a must do place when in the   Burlington VT area.

name: Anthony Sourdiff
text: The food was awesome and Ross was an great server.  Highly recommend it there

resp.text: Thank you for the compliments, Anthony! So happy to hear you enjoyed having Ross as a server!

name: Jimmy Turnpike
text: It's hard to describe how lucky Burlington is to have an authentic BBQ joint.  Not only does Bluebird have the utmost quality ribs, pulled pork, burgers and wings (dry rubbed included) but the quality of their serving staff is at least as excellent as the food.  They also keep in stock the full suite of local brews.  Keep your ear to the ground for specials as sometimes they literally do give you "free" food.  Go here.

name: Dylan Barber
text: Such a great place. Best BBQ I've been too in the north country.

name: Josh Neilson
text: Good eats. Many small plates make it easy to order a variety and share, while getting your fill at a reasonable price. Or, gorge yourself on many meats! Tons of parking. Close to downtown Burlington and Winooski.

resp.text: Hi Josh! Thank you for taking time to review us. We are so happy to hear you enjoyed your experience here as well as our offerings. We hope to have you back soon!

name: Mike Willette
text: Very tasty great service polite waitresses

resp.text: Thank you for the compliments and review!

name: shanias fun house
text: Good food and very nice staff

resp.text: Thank you!

name: Chris Meli
text: Solid food but a bit cafeteria-like in decor; if you just want bbq and beer then no problem

resp.text: Thank you for your review and feedback, Chris!

name: Zachary Lacy
text: First off, I'm from Texas, I've eaten at some of the best BBQ joints. And Bluebird is doing something that the rest of the Northeast needs to catch up on. Delicious locally sourced foods, great beer and cocktails. Check it out  if you're craving some delicious food and drinks.

name: Jacob Dubois
text: I had an incredible experience with Bluebird, specifically with their party orders. Our office ordered a number of BBQ dishes & I was tasked with picking them up. Upon arriving, Dan (their Culinary Director) had all the food ready & started loading up my car. I went to start my vehicle & it wouldn't start. Dan offered to jump the car but that didn't work either. Dan, without prompting, said he'd bring me back to the office so everyone could eat on time. What an unexpected act of generosity even when they had more (& larger) orders to deal with. I highly recommend this restaurant for any occasion.

name: Silver Laughter
text: Definitely had delicious food and very good drinks on tap. The bartenders were funny and very nice. Anyone craving some good barbeque and a nice atmosphere should come check this place out!

name: Bob Green
text: Barbeque was tough and very chewy, everything was over spiced with the same spices.

resp.text: HI Bob - Thank you for taking time to review us. We would love to connect to learn more about your experience. If you are interested in chatting, please reach out to me at samantha@bluebirdvermont.com - Thank you, Samantha, Hospitality Director

name: Fenix Artz
text: Oh my God. When you have to have falling off the bone BBQ and you can't afford a ticket to Charleston  South Carolina or Macon, Georgia. Bring your wallet though, and call ahead for a reservation, cause their hours of operation is as predictable as String Theory.

resp.text: Thank you for the compliments on our food and for the feedback!

name: Justin Holley
text: I never got in the meal here that I didn't enjoy.  I love their cornbread.

resp.text: Thank you for the review!

name: Michelle McNamara
text:
Really great food, awesome service and cool vibe
Would have give 5 stars but food was a little salty

resp.text: Hi Michelle - Thank you for the review. We appreciate the feedback!

name: Kendall Fortney
text: One of the few places in Burlington to get BBQ, they do a great job making amazing ribs, brisket and chicken. It may bit a bit pricey but worth the cost. The unique copper bar also has a fascinating, unique and often changing beer selection.

name: Bill Patton
text: Great food and setting. The spare back room towards the road can be noisy.

resp.text: Thank you for the review and feedback!

name: Darryl Brugger
text: Fast friendly service. Get here early. This place is a must try!

resp.text: Thank you, Darryl! We appreciate your positive review!

name: Herculesh3o Puppy
text: Great food and great service

resp.text: Thank you for the 5 Star review!

name: Tracy F.
text: Service and food have always been great. We went for the new Monday night family meal. It's $49 for 1/2 pound of turkey breast, pulled pork, and ribs. A pint each of salad, coleslaw, beans, and mac and cheese. And, four small loaves of cornbread with whipped maple butter. Incredible deal.

name: Patrick Hoffer
text: I make sure every time I am in the area to stop at Bluebird. Great staff, amazing food and a great craft beer selection. Always something new that I haven't tried and there is always enough food so I can savor it the next day as leftovers. Never disappoints.

name: Poisoned Pens
text: Good food! Be sure you come hungry, because you are definitely going to eat a lot! Not one particular BBQ style so there are quite a few options. About the only drawback is it can get quite busy at peak hours...

name: Ethan Garceau
text: This might be the best bbq in Vermont.  I've been to legit bbq in Kentucky and Tennessee and honestly think this place is on par or better.  Great local and regional beer selection.  Fantastic spare ribs and smoked chicken. Housemade sides and sauces are all on point - baked beans, coleslaw, and mac n cheese are recommended.  Overall a solid choice, especially with larger parties!

resp.text: Thank you so much Ethan for the recommendation! It means a lot to us!

name: Josh Rotz
text: Friendly staff and excellent food

text:
Great experience overall. It started in the parking lot, greeted by the smell of the smokehouse. That's appetizer enough.
Alex, our server, was perfect; she's attentive, but doesn't hover. She's pleasant and friendly in a "for real" way. Starts things off on the right foot.
The food was super, and the portions are quite large, which justifies what I initially thought were high prices. They might be but, oh, my! You must have the brisket, and then decide if it's too pricey. I was happy with it, to say the least.
The double burger was all my son could deal with, and my wife made a solid meal out of just four side orders. She actually had to bring one of them home. There's no worry about leaving there feeling under fed, and the food was as good as it was plentiful. We all were impressed wth the variety and quality of the sauces, as well. The house-made ketchup is excellent.
Some have mentioned slow, inattentive service, even at off peak times, but I have no complaints there either. It wasn't busy yet, and we were seated directly, attended to promptly, and each staff member we dealt with was friendly and knowledgeable. I very much look forward to going there again, and would encourage anyone to give Bluebird a try.

name: Bill Stratton
text:
MEET GUD OM NOM NOM

Despite the unstable chef situation over the past couple of years, the quality of the smoked and BBQ meats at Bluebird continues to be the best in the area. The coleslaw is hearty and crisp, the mac-n-cheese is gooey and a lovely shade of off-yellow, the mashed sweets are a perfect texture and the service is friendly.

Also features a solid selection of rotating local and regional beverages, as well as solid options for gluten free and even a vegetarian option, which I had to admire at what is essentially a meat restaurant (though I've not tried it, personally).

Features big televisions on the walls which is a bonus if you like sports and if you don't you can get away from them on the deck or in the back room. They never complain about my children, who can sometimes be quiet eating machines and other times insist on sprinting around the dining room and scream-laughing until they fall over (we go early, so no one else has to deal with their...eccentricities ).

I ding them one star for inconsistency, which has been my only gripe. Sometimes it's 5 stars, other times its 3, but its never less than that, so if BBQ is your thing, this is the place.

text:
My wife and I are originally from the south, so we've been pretty skeptical about the bbq offerings in VT. Bluebird was a welcome surprise; all of the meats are quite good, the sides are varied and flavorful, and the ambience is great.

Food
The meats are the centerpiece here. The first time we visited we got the dinner for two. This came with four sides, and an order of brisket, ribs, and pulled pork. I would definitely recommend making this a dinner for four, as the portions are huge. We were a bit disappointed that they didn't have spare ribs but the babyback ribs were still quite good. The meat was tender and came off the bone just right. The pulled pork wasn't super flavorful, but the homemade sauces really made it work. The NC style was a little TOO NC style for me (intense cider-vinegar), but the other two favors were great. The brisket was the star here though; each piece I had was super tender and had that little bit of pink from the smoke.

The sides were also very enjoyable. In the two times we've been my wife and I have tried the pickles, greens, cornbread, mac and cheese, and baked beans. The cornbread is a bit dry, but the rest of the sides really hit their marks. Personally the baked beans and pickles stuck out for me; the beans have bits of pork that add an extra punch, and the pickles had some kind of pepper or chile that gave it a lingering bit of spiciness.

Ambience
The feel of this place is great. The location is right next to the Winooski river so both times I've been I made sure to sit on the outdoor patio. It definitely has a relaxing feel and the waitstaff (some of whom I've definitely seen over at Bluebird Tavern too) are very friendly.

If you're looking for spare ribs you won't find them here, but otherwise this is some of the best bbq you can find in VT.
