Hi Shiloh - Thank you for the review. Please feel free to reach out to me at samantha@bluebirdvermont.com if you wanted to share any specific feedback. We are always happy to hear from our guests! Best, Samantha - Hospitality Director
Thank you for the 5 star review!
Thank you Megan for your review!
Thank you, Paul!
Jasmine - Thank you for the 5 Stars!
Thank you!

name: Misty Peck
text:
There is an overall condescending atmosphere.  It is on the more expensive side.
I've been a few times and I'm never greeted...
The last time I went in, I had to stand there while the girl working the register and someone on the line finished their conversation.  Then she was just standing there...
So I said "Oh, hello, yes fine, thank you for asking" at which point she said sorry, he's having a bad day ...
Anyway besides the lack of customer service and the overall condescending attitude the food is good.

I had ordered the spicy Maple chicken wings and garlic knots, pictured below
The chicken wings were very delicious, the garlic knots were just extra carbs I didn't need, lol.  The knots were not that flavorful, not worth the $6+

resp.text: Misty, So sorry this review slipped through the cracks. We are certainly concerned at your comments and would welcome the opportunity to review them with you. Please email your contact info to Kevin@pizza44vt.com and allow us to answer these critiques if you wish. Thank you for your honesty. P44

name: Elaine Mantinan
text: Overall I would say this was a 3 star experience. We enjoyed our pizza and salad but the meatballs were not great. The space was very clean and the decor was nice and modern. The shared bathrooms with Queen City were clean and we appreciated the general neutral aspect and the baby changing mat. We found it annoying that they did not have a beer list, so we were trying to read the taps while people were waiting impatiently behind us. The worker was a little unsure about which beers were on tap. Even a handwritten list or a quickly typed up paper would have been super helpful. There were tons of employees, maybe as many as customers when we got there, so it seemed like someone could have done that easily. The main thing we found completely obnoxious was the lack of high chairs. We've been all over town all week and this is the first time this has happened to us, even at small breweries that barely had any food we found high chairs, so to walk into a pizza place and be told they don't have high chairs is completely baffling. We only came here because our kids were hungry and other places we wanted to go weren't serving dinner yet. In hindsight we should have just waited. It wasn't terrible, but with so many other wood fired pizza options in the area, we wouldn't bother going back.

name: Peter Powers
text: Best pizza you can get in the area! Their flavor combinations they have created are absolutely amazing. You cannot go wrong here. I have never dined in so cannot speak on the atmosphere and service, but on pizza alone, 5 stars.

resp.text: Thanks Peter! We love hearing our flavors inspire!

name: E w
text:
MICKSTER and Go ask a
Alice are on point. Great staff as well!

resp.text: Mickster for the win again! Thanks for the stars. See you soon.

name: Daniel Shearer
text: Great pizza with fresh ingredients! Best deep dish pizza in town.

resp.text: Thank you Daniel. We appreciate the compliment!

name: Christopher Lei
text:
Pros:
- good pizza
- unique enough to separate itself from American Flatbread and Veritas

Cons:
- shares the same parking lot as Queen City. not enough spaces
- this is a place where you order at the counter and then find a seat. which means you have to fight for a seat with those people who claim a table before ordering.
- seating here is not great. lots of large tables. there is also a large table which is communal. if you are out on date night you are basically forced to sit there. no one wants to be that couple that claims a big table.

pictured is the classic margherita (smalll) and the caprese.

name: Kevin Foss
text: Awesome pies and great service. Almost beats Folinos for best pizza in VT imo.

name: Tim White
text: Great pizza, made to order. Service seems a tad slow, but then again the food comes out hot, so it's worth it overall. The seating is not great for just 2 people to sit and chat over a meal. Instead, it's long tables and booths reserved for 6 or more people. Not a show-stopper, but it keeps us from becoming regulars. Prices are reasonable.

resp.text: Thanks for your feedback Tim, we appreciate your candor!

name: Carter Neville
text: Delicious pizza and must have spicy maple wings. Counter service, good local beer and wine available.

name: Helen Oetjen
text: They make a good reasonably priced woodfired pizza and a good ceaser salad with Brussels sprouts.  Take out took me over an hour from the time I called till the time the food was ready, so plan ahead.

resp.text: Thank you Helen...take out orders have been increasing and the time frames can be difficult to juggle. We appreciate the feedback.

name: Stuart Floyd
text: Deliciously delicious with many selections of pizza and types as well as make your own. Simply fire cooked enjoyment. Good salads and other items as well as wines and beers and all that.  Nice setting.  Order at counter they bring to your table and clean as well.  Refills u go back to order and they offer fountain sodas or free ice water and take out too.

resp.text: Thanks for the stars Stuart!

name: Lindsey Adams
text: Great tasting pizza

resp.text: Thanks Lindsey!

name: Poisoned Pens
text: Fantastic food, friendly staff and fine beverages. Pizza is fantastic, salad is fresh and crisp, beer is cold! The only caveat is that it can be hard to get a place to sit during peak dinner hours (Friday and Saturday nights)

resp.text: Thanks for the great review. The good news is that we are open 5 other nights a week! Hope to see you again!

name: Ian J. Treu
text: Pizza 44 is in a great spot cuddled next to Queen City Brewery and across from Zero Gravity.  I keep going back, have had most of the menu at this point, and its all good.  The Doug's Marvelous is a particularly Vemont style treasure worth pointing out, and for lunch they also have amazing sandwiches.

resp.text: Thanks for the high praise! And the stars.

name: Everett Ackerman
text: All the pizzas I've had here are top-notch. Treat yourself to some garlic bites and wings while you wait, both bomb. Great drink selection as well.

name: joseph poulin
text: Good pizza, great atmosphere. But both times in I ended up with white pizza. Bummer, I like tomato sauce but it is not clear on the menu. Guess I can't really blame the restaurant though. Worth s stop in.

name: Patricia Schwartz
text: Delish pizza! Also try the garlic bites. Good selection of beers. Nice atmosphere.

resp.text: Thanks Patricia! So glad you enjoyed it all and can’t wait to see you back again.

name: Grumpy Grandpa
text: They have a strange seating arrangement. This is a popular place so you order at the counter when you walk in and then wait for a table to open up but you better be quick because someone that walked in behind you will take the table before you have a chance to sit down. Uncomfortable to be finishing up your dinner and people waiting for your table to open up like vultures. Food was good but I didn't like their sausage, personal choice you may like it.

name: Dustin Charland
text: I really do enjoy this place, highly recommend if you have never been before. the parking can be a bit difficult but that is normal for Burlington. This place is very busy and does not have the most seating so Friday, Saturday nights be prepared to wait in a good size line. The beer on tap is also of great selection, micro brews to main domestic beers. Big fan of this place!

name: Cody Duquette
text: Great unique pizza. I don't suggest this place if you go in expecting a Domino's type menu. Check their specialities and see if that's what you are into.

resp.text: Thanks for appreciating our unique pizzas!

name: John Abry
text: Tasty pizza with local brew!

resp.text: Thanks John!

name: Michelle Jimmo
text: Pizza was good. Loved the thin crust and the urban decor.

name: Allen Beier
text: This place is throwing down some exceptional pizzas. Probably one of my favorite places for a quick bite. Offering pan pizzas, hand tossed pizzas and various appetizers. My girlfriends favorite is the Brussels Caesar, which you do not see vary often at any establishment. The tap list is pretty good and they are located in the same building as queen city brewery. So you can always grab a brew somewhere while you wait. Definitely recommend checking it out.

name: David Klinkowski
text: very good for a thin pizza

name: Anthony Menard
text: Spectacular food and service as always

resp.text: Thank you Anthony!

name: Jean Roberts
text: Top notch pizza, and two breweries adjacent (yup, they're both awesome too!).  MUST TRY the garlic bites, they make you consider ordering another dish, for yourself, immediately.

name: William Bragg
text: Pizza I had was fantastic. Will return with the wife and kid as soon as possible.

resp.text: Thanks William, so glad you enjoyed it. We just know the family will enjoy it too!

name: Jeff M
text: Wicked gr8 pizza the only place around that FINALLY GOT PIZZA RIGHT thank you so much

resp.text: There's a lot of good pizza around, thanks for the praise and stars!

name: Mary Hill
text: I had a lovely beet salad for lunch. The service was friendly and fast.

resp.text: Thats our favorite salad! Thanks for the stars.

name: Cynthia Feltch
text: Incredibly expensive pizza. $17+ for an 11 inch cheese pie! $21 for lunch with a soft drink. I won't be back.

name: Will Wright
text: Good pizza, good environment, a nice variety of seating options, short but good beer and soda selection

name: Troy Frostad
text: My first impression was that this was a clean, open-kitchen that shares space with the brewery. It's not an original concept but a good one that allows you to order at the counter and go and sit in the brewery to wait and have a drink.the pizza was decent, though I was expecting a blistered crust versus the standard baked crust you get with lower temp ovens. The wing as were very good, considering they were baked and not fried. Overall, pretty good. I would recommend to anyone looking for a bite while on the brew tour circuit.

name: Jean Milano
text: Absolutely one of our favorite restaurants in Burlington. Friendly and knowledgeable staff! Can accommodate gluten and dairy free as well! Love it!!

name: Allison Luke
text: The food is amazing and the service is top notch. My new favorite place!

name: James Cook
text: Stopped by today for lunch , we were the first ones in . We were greeted 6a nice "hello",from the pizza maker ( set the experience off to a great start ). We are a family of 4,two kids one of which is 2yrs old and the other is 4,so we asked if they had a highchair and a booster ...only had the highchair no booster seat (but it worked out okay ). Price point was pretty good and the pie great ! We will be back to try some more and Queencity Brewery is in the same building so BONUS for Mom and Dad.

name: Rick Valenta
text: Great local pizza shop that serves beer and wine as well.  They also have paninis, salads, and other options on the menu in line with the theme of the restaurant.  Very nice venue and staff; I highly recommend it if you are in the area!

name: Tyler Green
text: Excellent food, great atmosphere, helpful staff

resp.text: Thanks for the stars Tyler!

name: Adam Carparelli
text: The pizza here is delicious.  This is an order at the counter and grab a booth type restaurant with good beer on draft, artisanal pizzas, and plenty of options for sides.  Conveniently located next to Queen City Brewery / across the street from Zero Gravity Brewery.

name: Chip Hart
text: Just had an event at the space owned by QCB and it was catered by Pizza 44.  Excellent!

resp.text: Thanks for the stars!

name: Pitt Petri
text:
Great ambiance but $23 for a 10-12 inch gluten free pizza? Sheesh. Got a salad and added pork belly for an extra $5 and it came out with 1-2 slices of extra crispy bacon, not exactly what you expect when you hear pork belly. Girlfriend and I walked out $55 lighter (1 beer, a wine, a pizza and a salad) and still hungry.

Giving you a 3 stars because your staff was super friendly and they provided awesome service but you gotta up your game big time.

name: Kate Castonguay
text: Great pizza. Get the deep dish. Usually not my thing but holy moly, it's amazing.

name: Mike Godfrey
text: Consistently AMAZING pizza and. The service is always genuine, friendly, and helpful!!! Love this place - you guys ROCK!!!!

name: Laurie Bouyea-Dumont
text: Delish.  Excellent service. Cool environment.

resp.text: Thank you and thank you! Hope to see you again soon.

name: Only Child
text: Pizza was delicious!  The dougs marvelous maple  is a must try again !

name: Maya Urbanowicz
text: I have had a late lunch here a couple times.  The pizza is delicious, nice drink selction, great ambiance, spacious, order at the counter, fast service.

name: Edin Suljanovic
text: Great food, great service!

name: dewey daniels
text: Very good wood fired pizza. Nice modern atmosphere and friendly staff. Highly recommended

name: Ryan Calvi
text: Went on opening weekend. It took a while. Which is expected. But the Pizza was worth the wait. Will definitely be back.

name: J L
text: Great Pizza and Wings. Queen City Brewery is attached and also has amazing beer.

name: Annette U
text: This rating is based on an average of two visits. The first time I ate in and it was great. It's very expensive pizza but it was good and we had a great time. The second visit was for a pick up. First I couldn't preorder bc no one answered the phone after ten minutes of trying. I assumed the place was slammed. I arrived too find an empty restaurant minus the one customer in line in front of me. I ordered one large and two medium pizzas, for which I paid nearly 60.00! Not terrible for great pies. Only mine were burnt, the crust on my vegan pizza was literally paper thin. And the toppings were minimal. Since I was picking up and the pies were expensive, I didn't leave a tip. I couldn't help but wonder if that had anything to do with the overall quality of my pies. I'd say visit, but definitely inspect your order before taking it away!

name: Mark Binkhorst
text: Pizza is better than good. Fun relaxed atmosphere.  Lunch specIals are a deal.

name: Caitlin Merrill
text: Decor is great and the inside is super neat and tidy. The pie itself was soggy in the middle. When I pick up a slice I expect it to be able to moderately hold itself up, this immediately folded down and the toppings fell off. The crust part was really crunchy, so I'm not sure if it's a cooking temperature thing or not but I appreciate a crunch throughout a pizza slice. The garlic knots had a good flavor but half were not cooked all the way. Which was obvious because the other half we're toasty brown. I was disappointed but am looking forward to giving it another shot.

name: Brian Albu
text: Was a neat place and the pizza was awesome

name: Edward Pricer
text: Surprisingly good wings. Casual, clean. Quick service.

name: Dave Dec
text: Wonderful pizza. The folks who work here are lovely.

name: Erin Hudecek
text: Great food, friendly, quick

resp.text: Thanks for the stars Erin!

name: Leon Flanagan
text: Great Pizza and garlic knots

resp.text: So glad you liked them...Knots are our favorite too!

name: Leigh Fowler
text: Great pizza and a decent tap list.

name: Diane Stevens
text: Good food, nice atmosphere!

name: John Ware
text: The deep dish pizza.

name: Bill Roberts
text: Great service, great food, great atmosphere, great place, been back 3times, awesome, love the brussel sprouts pizza, and salad greens

name: John Blais
text: Delicious deep dish pizza, highly recommend

name: Albert Orbinati
text: Great pizza! We enjoyed it and will be back!

name: Luis Rosario
text: Great pizza and good drinks.

name: Tom Medve
text: Very nice thin crust pizza.

name: Kelsey Brandin
text:
Went the first week of their opening - very expensive for mediocre pizza. Unfortunately, their food reminded my fiancée and I of a nostalgic frozen pizza, like a cross between an inexpensive local by-the-slice shop, and a hot pocket (not exactly in line with flavors expected from local, house-made ingredients).

If you're moderately inebriated coming from zero gravity or queen city, I'm sure it'll taste great, but you'll pay a premium for a taste inferior to Piezano's (formerly Junior's) or Veritá. I hope they either improve their size and quality to justify the price, or lower the price significantly to match the taste.

name: Laura Bowe
text: Quick, tasty, affordable and inviting.

name: Peg Purdue
text: Excellent pizza and wings

resp.text: Thanks Peg!

text: Great thin crust pizza!

text: Outstanding food and waitstaff!!

name: Evan Will
text: This was a great experience of Austrian food! The beers were great and so was the sausages! I recommend checking them out if your in the area!!

name: Matthew Raudonis
text:
First the beer: High quality fresh barvarian brews. Mostly lagers or other similarly clear styles. If your looking for the latest DDH IPA or Barrel aged stout go back into town.

2nd the food: Out of this world! The chicken schnitzel is incredible. We started with the shaved radishes, which was fantastic in its simplicity.

name: Stephen Palermo
text: What a great place to see and eat at, everything was wonderful, great service, delicious food and beer! Not to be missed.

name: Katherine Nguyen
text:
Loved our visit! The atmosphere and building were great with beautiful fall foliage views. The food and beer were wonderful. Highly recommend the pretzel with the beer cheese and the chicken sandwich (schnitzel style). The staff was very friendly and attentive.

I made a reservation 1 week in advance and had plenty of time slots to choose from. Definitely a busy place, but was still Covid friendly.

name: Sachin nayak
text:
My friends had hyped this place so much that this had become a must visit brewery in Vermont. All that hype went down the drain very quickly at this place.

First of all, the staff taking reservations/ waiting to seat people was not friendly at all. We went there without a reservation and they didn’t allow us in at all. I was ready to wait for a table since I had a party of 8 but I was told ‘no’ since they have nothing to offer me because everything was full and that they couldn’t accommodate a party of my size. I could see another similar sized party right in front of me drinking on a table so I couldn’t understand their reasoning. A few others who were in the queue in front of me got tables so that baffled me.

They had plenty of tables outside and I told him that I’d like to have something outside since I knew my party size was huge but nothing that I spoke went through him.

If you really wanna visit this brewery I’d suggest you make reservations or else visit some other brewery nearby which would take a party walk in.

name: Nancy Chesser
text: Great place. Fun atmosphere. Food was wonderful. Good beer 🍺. Everyone was very friendly and they have a special grill with fire wood chips that you can see from the dinning room/ bar. Really enjoyed the place.

name: Jeffrey Peni
text: Beautiful location with outstanding views. Great brewery with delicious beer choices. Food available although I didn't eat. Many patrons did and the foods had great aromas and I was wishing that I didn't have leftovers waiting for me. Drank a flight of beer (4 tastings) and liked all. This brewery is hard to beat and I'm sure that you will agree.

name: Zachary Hubbell
text:
Nice new beer hall. The space is large and open -
good for large groups!

I enjoyed the homemade pretzel (with cheese sauce!). My bratwurst was not to my taste, but I could tell it was high quality; just not my speed.

I enjoyed my flight of beer and the other guys in my group were impressed with their beers!

Good stuff!

name: Gian Carlo
text: Kind of a tourist trap. Meh food, drinks, service. Plenty of kitschy souvenirs. Cold ambience. Came here for the historical significance of the Von Trapp family, and felt that largely missing in the new giant restaurant venue which felt more like a highway rest-stop cafe. Nice views of the fields, esp in the winter when there's snow.

name: Daniel Delgado
text: Best food around. I have dined with them multiple times over the last three years, I've never been disappointed. I can't recommend them highly enough.

name: Joshua Lee
text: Great meal here with quick service and great beer. Make reservations via yelp as is protocol these days. The zucchini fritters were absolutely fantastic and a must try!

name: Carl Corning
text: Great craft beer!  These folks know how to brew!  Also very good food.  Enjoyed the variety!  It is a little pricey but most things in the area are.  The view alone is worth the trip!

name: Justin Morgan
text: Amazing beers and a gorgeous brewery! Also played 18 holes of disc golf that is open year round.

name: Greg Boyd
text: As with EVERY stop at a well-known attraction.. you MUST take home a souvenir as a remembrance.. in this case - 24 REMEMBERANCES.. a Case of von Trapp's FABULOUS Oktoberfest-the latest addition to the line-up and AWESOME!

name: Wesley G. Kenney
text: Great beer selection, wonderful German inspired dishes with a Vermont flair, beautiful views, great atmosphere. Von Trapp really knocked it out of the park with this bierhall. We make it a point to stop by whenever we're in the area for at least one drink and some pretzels. When we're hungrier, the sausages, sauerkraut, and spatzel all come out, and taste delicious.

name: Thomas Kubiak
text: Oktoberfest was good.  Band was interesting to listen too.  Pretzel was good - but waits were extremely long.  Glad we got mugs before they ran out!

name: Christopher Lei
text:
The food here is great. I always get either the Bratwurst, Knackwurst, Bauernwurst entree or the
Chicken Schnitzel entree (pictured). The beer themselves are OK, nothing special. Wish the brewery would offer more selections of beer. Von Trapp doesn’t seem to experiment much with new beers, which you have to in the VT craft beer scene.

name: FD G
text: The Bierhall is an awesome place to come in after spending the day cross country skiing to relax. Their beer is all made on site. They offer a small selection of wine, but the beer is the mane focus. The pretzels come with two different types of mustards. This is also a great place to bring family and friends.

name: Michael Leake
text: Absolutely gorgeous building in a beautiful area. Nice retail shop where you can purchase merchandise and canned beer to go. Inside you'll find The Tap Room and restaurant that serves delicious treats which can be enjoyed at the bar, long tables, or outside on the patio. I enjoyed a flight and my wife had some Stowe cider. Games available outside include cornhole and frisbee golf (discs for purchase).

name: Matt Hoffmamn
text: 4.5.  Nice to be outside with people at a very welcoming place

name: Steve Neely
text: One of my favorite places to go anytime of year seasonal changes then drive up to main lodge for a beautiful veiw

name: Hui Chieh Hsiang Jackson
text:
My husband told me good things about this place so we decided to try it for dinner. The food was delicious. I loved the chicken schnitzel and my husband enjoyed his bratwurst sandwich. My son ate a lot of his mac & cheese and fries plus milk. I wish I had made room for dessert. This place is kid friendly since I saw other families with small children.

There was a grassy area near the outdoor seating where you could play corn hole or go explore the pond nearby. It's a place I'd like to visit again.

name: Philip Hyjek
text: Fantastic lager beers! A real change from all the IPAs. And, great Austrian  bierhall food.

name: Courtney Smith
text: Always a good time. Beers are top notch and the food is incredible. Had a private tour with Robert and made the experience even more enjoyable! Dunkel is my favorite!

name: Rebecca Smedy
text: The service, and meals were exceptional. One of my top 5 of all time! The beer and apps were very pleasing as well!

name: Maruta Kajaks-Grots
text: Took our elderly (93 year old) parents for a lunch. First time eating "out" at a restaurant during this pandemic. Felt safe, most important! Masks and social distancing all around. Food was great, as usual, great views and a good day out. Sausages - excellent. Mushroom stroganof a hit with picky, vegatarian mother-in-law. Big surprise was burger. Good flavor, great bun and edible. What I mean by that is that bar burgers tend to be soooo huge, you can't get it in your mouth without deconstructing it. I had the single. If you want, get a double. My size was juuust right. Enjoy! P.S. Didn't talk about the beer, it was great. Loved the hard cider. Tasted the cider. Some others are cider trying to be beer. Not here. Don't forget the strudel. Real stuff, not just cinnamon and sugar flavored apples in filo dough. Dough is obviously hand made and the first taste is apples, then raisins, followed by a hint of cinnamon. Loved it!

name: Mark LoGiurato
text: The setting is nice for families.  As for a brewery, the food is better than the beer.

name: Jesse Graves
text: Beer is decent if you like German beer. This is the second time I've been here. The first time the cheese plate was amazing. This time it was not good at all and certainly not at the price.

name: Dave Rosenberg
text: Been coming to Stowe for years, how did I miss this?! Authentic German style beers and food in the scenic mountains of the Von Trapps. And when you're done, you can cross country try ski back home :-)

name: Matthew Hiserodt
text: Really nice setting at top of mountain.  Has some nice outdoor tables and bean bag toss looking out into the mountain meadow.  We had to sit inside as it was raining during our visit.  Has a hunting lodge vibe.  Menu is pretty standard German fare.  Beer mostly underwhelming lager varieties.  Our server was pretty grumpy  in her demeanor and the place was pretty empty when we visited.  Meal ended up being our most expensive of the trip to Stowe, and while the food was fine, it was also our least favorite meal to eat.  So overall, again, not a bad place, but I would not consider it a good value when there are so many awesome places to eat in the area.

name: chris k
text: Great authentic German beer and German food!!!

name: George Hood
text: Plenty of different  lager beers and a pretty place.

name: Kyle Higgins
text: Great Bier Hall! Lovely grounds and the flights are "hopping"!

name: Chris Eby
text: Wish they weren't out of their Maple Rauchbier in cans!

name: Nick Mardeuse
text: Just had a beer flight and a pretzel, but I enjoyed this place a lot!

name: Lawrence Strobel
text: A great reminder of our times in Austria and Germany. The food and beer are great!

name: Mellie Holzscheiter
text: Would have thought a cutting-edge place like this would have more real vegan options.... also order was not received accurately.

name: Brian Barnett
text: Fantastic food,  great views,  and excellent beer!

name: David ONeill
text: Everything about this place during our visit was incredible. The venue is exactly what you want when you spend 15 minutes feeling like you have taken a wrong turn. The brussel sprout appetizer and pretzels were perfect. The Cob Salad was really well done with the chicken cooked to perfection and a slight twist with a pickled egg. On top of all that the suggested beer flight was a showcase of their best beers. Great afternoon and will definitely be coming back.

name: Alex Rusate
text: Great beer and food

name: John Hennessey
text: Lots of good food and Bier choices, and friendly service.

name: Eric Knowlton
text: The location should get 5 stars on its own. The food was fantastic, and there was plenty to choose from. The beers are well done and refreshing. It's definitely worth the drive up the mountain.

name: Gili Shahar
text: Great place, food was delicious service was fast and nice ...beer was perfect!

name: James
text: Good beer with brilliant views. The staff is s very friendly and I'd recommend some of their pretzels, helps the beer go down a treat.

name: Kevin Donley
text: top tier

name: John Seward
text: Very nice place. Good beers. Nice people.

name: Thomas Hall
text: Authentic feeling environment and quality food and drinks.   Reasonable prices.  Service could be better, but the servers are all friendly and genuine.  Scenic setting.

name: Chris Giza
text: Great food good beer and nice staff

name: Brent Walker
text: Went in for lunch and sat at the bar. Waited for five minutes to place a drink order, while sitting at the bar! Eventually got a couple of beers that we didn't finish and a couple of appetizers. The pretzels were pretty good, especially the mustard, the brussel sprouts were gross, over cooked and swimming in syrup. The beer wasn't terrible, it just was not worth drinking. Atmosphere was part large cafeteria, part tourist trap.

name: Mark Midmark
text: Beautiful beer hall with darn good lagers. I didn't try any food, but I have heard good things about it. Definitely a little on the pricey side with entrees looking upwards of $20, but not unaffordable.

name: Andrew Hindson
text: A good beer selection with the trapp beers brewed in house. I would recommend getting a flight of beers to find the one you like best. Nice atmosphere and a huge bar. Didn't try the food but it all looked good.

name: Kris Merchant
text: Great atmosphere friendly and very hip

name: Simon Tacvorian
text: It's really hard to give a starred rating when I didn't experience it. We were seated at our table for 25 minutes and no server came around to greet us or give us water. Multiple other tables were seated and put their orders in before we were looked at. Every time we tried to get someone's attention, they seemed to avoid us at all costs. So, we got up and left. When we informed the hostess about this on our way out, she had the most "I don't care at all but I'm going to pretend to look sorry for you" face on that I've ever seen. Not going to go back

name: Tyler Hermanson
text: the beer and food is great! the pretzel and beer batter cheese dip is worth it alone to go here. the timber framed instead is beautiful as well!

name: Kate S.
text:
Beautiful space and cute swag
Delicious food, we got this seasonal stew that was just the right complement to a rainy cold day

text: While spending the weekend in Burlington and looking for a unique spot to have our anniversary dinner, this cute little hole in the wall caught our attention based off of its overly positive reviews across the board. The varied menu and proximity to downtown were a plus for us as well, since we planned on grabbing drinks at the barcade afterwards. We arrived around 8:30, and the place was about half full. We chose a small table directly in the middle of the establishment, and after spending a few minutes with the menu, stepped up to the counter to place our orders. We ordered 2 different kinds of tacos (One order was for the smoked chipotle cauliflower, and the other, the asian BBQ pork.) We also ordered the assorted fritters (I think it was carrot and ginger, if I'm remembering correctly), seitan skewers, as well as the seasonal gnocchi and some drinks. I had a pint of 'Kitten Death Star' and the mrs had a ginger beer. Like many Vermont spots, they had a small selection of local drinks on deck, which is always nice. The tacos arrived first, and both orders were very good,  and we scarfed them down, excited to see what would come next! Unfortunately, what came next was not nearly as good. The fritters were sort of mushy and flavorless. The seitan skewers tasted ok but were overly slimy... But the gnocchi is where this meal really lost us. This dish tasted bad, and the "gnocchi" felt more like rolled up, gritty, yet pasty mashed potato glue than it did any actual gnocchi I've ever had. All in all, the drinks were nice, the tacos were good, but the rest of the dishes were... not so great. The place itself had a nice low-key ambiance and the staff were pretty chill and friendly but I just don't see myself ever coming back again. If you do find yourself here, stick to the beer and tacos.

name: Misty Peck
text:
The state of Vermont has a program, the Everyone Eats Program, which was created from the FEMA grants because we're in a state of emergency.

The Everyone Eats Program is a program where you can get a meal (4 oz of meat and a side) from a restaurant and they get reimbursed $10 for the meal.  The restaurant is required to purchase at least 10% of their overall produce from local farmers...
So it's a win-win for all involved

Paying close attention to the fact that it was created to FEED people that were negatively effected by Covid, while supporting local businesses and farmers

So, I have been to the Mule Bar 4 times.  The first two times I had interaction with the owner.  We had nice conversation about the program and how it's a win-win for all

More recently I have been served by a particular female server.  The Mule Bar used to offer a hamburger and fries, now they only offer a pulled pork sandwich and fries.  My daughter has an allergy to histamine and can not eat tomatoes or bbq sauce, so she can't eat the pulled pork sandwich.

I asked her if they were going to offer the hamburger again and she said she didn't know, she was new.  She said they probably offer the pulled pork sandwich because it's more cost effective (because they can order less expensive meat and brine it and serve older meat with less detection)

Yesterday I ordered food from Our House Bristo, which is amazing, they make your Mac and Cheese to order and it takes about an hour. They give you a huge container, it's about 2 lbs of food.  Easily 2 meals.

At 5 pm I called the Mule Bar and ordered one meal, so Emma could eat the fries while we wait for the food from Our House Bristo.  The server said it would be ready in 10 minutes, I said I was stuck in traffic and it would take me longer than that to get there.  She said "it will be here waiting for you"
I got there at 5:30.  There were 3 different orders there, bagged up.  They put them in brown bags to help keep the food warm and they put condiments in the bag.. napkins, ketchup and salad dressing for the lettuce
I got there at 5:30.  My order was not bagged up.  I asked her for a smaller container, so I could put the fries in it for my daughter.  My food was cold, which I knew it would be because she told me it would be.  The condiments were in my food container, literally, in my food.  I put the fries in the smaller container and left.  She was like, you don't want this.  I said no and left.
I literally did not speak to her, but to ask for a container and say no I didn't want the sandwich.

I privately messaged the Mule Bar to complain about her condescending attitude and obvious prejudice towards me because I'm poor.  This was based off my 1st encounters with her and then her nasty attitude this time.  A restaurant should be made aware when a server is rude, condensing and prejudice against poor people, so they can at least know how people are being treated...

The owner of the Mule Bar told me that I was ungrateful trash and that I was no longer welcome at the Mule Bar because I wasn't grateful for my free meal (which isn't free, they get paid from the Everyone Eats Program, they're not running a soup kitchen, they're not the Salvation Army or the People's Kitchen...programs that actually offer free meals)

So apparently the server is a reflection of the owners own prejudice against poor people

It literally makes me sick that people think that it's okay to be bigoted against someone, that they're being paid to help, because I am negatively effected by Covid.  I'm sorry I'm poor and was trying to support your business.
Apparently he doesn't want poor people in his restaurant and I want people to know that, so they can choose to support him or not.
He also lied about not holding meals, out of the 30 restaurants that participate in the program he is the only one who will not wait 10 mins to make your order because you're stuck in traffic.

Pizza 44 opens at 11:30, you have to start calling at 9:30 to place an order, for a later time, because they're sold out before they open

text: It's a great place to hang out. They have delicious craft beers and creative cocktails.  Their burgers are great and be sure to order a plate of poutine to share.

name: Jeff Stecklare
text: Best bar in the area. Great bartenders and food.

name: Andrew Ripley
text: Amazing little spot. Easy going atmosphere with really well done food, great service, and a great selection of mixed drinks and craft beer. The outdoor seating is primo when the weather's nice. Everyone on staff was helpful, friendly, and knowledgeable. They set the stage for a great night out with friends!

name: Marilee Cornelius
text: Those fries! The burgers are delicious as are the hot dogs. Friendly bartenders, great selection of local and non-local craft beers. Nice comfortable space. Great outside seating when the weather is nice.

name: Stan Pillowman
text: Dope burger, dope beers, cheap* hurdy turpers, 💯 five forks

name: Kat Gosselin
text: Best draft list in the 802!!! Mule bar has the best beer and incredible food

name: Brian LaClair
text: Great prices on drinks, delicious food!

name: Keely Agan
text: Cozy atmosphere, great drinks 😍

name: Jason Taylor
text: Comfortable and friendly pub with really talkative and lively staff.  Tap list when I was there was fine for a few drinks, but not a standout.  The sandwich focused food list looked fine for pub food.

name: Drake
text: Good food and drink and great atmosphere. Try it out.

name: michael cianci
text: Great tap list and great, but expensive food.

name: Jason Hao
text: Great beer selection. Food was decent. Nice staff and atmosphere

name: Rinette Ellis
text: Love the food . The staff are great.The rosemary fries are fabulous. Not many tables so we had to wait for a table at 5:30 on a Thursday night. No waitstaff so you place your order at the bar.

name: Paul Sears
text: This place is super laid back with fast friendly service and has a nice selection of craft beers on tap as well as fun specialty cocktails. It usually has some sort of tasty food special throughout the week such as taco Tuesday, etc... staff is super friendly and knowledgeable

name: Gina Laveroni
text: The bartenders are great.  They mixawesome cocktails with speed and a smile. Even when the place is packed and the bar is 5 deep.

name: Kristina Love
text: Very nice. Bar tenders really know their drinks. Top notch. Beers are different all the time and if a keg kicks, the next on line is already listed.

name: Andy Pearson
text: Awesome beer selection. Amazing snacks.  Bar keeps are always friendly. Usually crowded on the weekends.

name: Matt Mulligan
text: Weiner Wednesday was wonderful.

name: Dave Kinney
text: Great beer selection. I've seen 5 hill farmstead beers on tap at once. Plus the burger and the Cuban are both excellent choices. Fries are done well with (I think) rosemary. Favorite bar in vt probably.

name: Andrew Prowten
text: This is my favorite place for drinks in the Winooski/Burlington area. They always have really great unique beers for fair prices. The food is bomb too.

name: alanboyce barber
text: Overall just another bar, with a reasonably cool name, personally, snooty,snooby,oh I maybe a tad bitter , I just got stood up there. Give it a shot, there is a nice vibe ,and ambience about the area

name: Andrew Derrig
text: Perhaps the best place to eat and drink on the circle. Amazing beer selection, great events pretty much weekly, and the food is to die for. Grab a cold one with the boys in Winooski.

name: Christopher H
text: Fantastic bar to sample a variety of local beers. Bartenders were knowledge and professional.

name: Derek Rycewicz
text: Great burgers and a nice selection of beer. Cocktails are a bit overpriced for what you get.

name: Matt Lorence
text: When I'm in the mood for a classy cocktail but don't want to go thru the effort of buying an orange just for a twist of peel, the Mule Bar is my go-to. With the hot summer nights, try a negroni.

name: Gregory Wilkins
text: The Mule bar is the best place for draft beers in Winooski and the food is really great; on par with the restaurants next door. They can get pretty crowded around dinner time and usually close before the neighboring Mokney House. But all in all a great bar with a chill atmosphere.

name: Michael Williams
text: Good range of beer and a great place to sit outside with a burger.

name: David Sears
text: Very good burger, nice beer selection, friendly attentive bar service.

name: Wesley Sanders
text: Best bar in the greater Burlington area. Definitely not a college bar -- the place is often packed with post-grad 20-somethings -- and the beer selection is just as good, if not better, than anything else in the area. If you're intimidated by the beer selection, the bartenders are always happy to help you find something in your wheelhouse.

name: Ed Green
text: Great draft selection.  Tasty food.  Craft cocktails.

name: Wesley G. Kenney
text: Hands down the best bar in town. Great rotating beer selection, helpful and friendly staff, and tasty food for when you want something to eat.

name: Patrick DiRico
text: Best pub in Winooski? Probably, find out for yourself

name: Nicholas Means
text: Friends and I come here all the time for lunch and after work, great environment and fantastic staff!

name: Alex Swaisgood
text: Great Bar! Bartenders are friendly and knowledgeable. Last time I was there had Mike Got Mad and Pork Belly Cuban both there excellent!

name: Sean
text: I liked the food a lot, but the bartenders seem like they hate being there. On their phones their whole time. Seems like the what seemed regulars (or friends) were the only ones they cared much about. I would go in again for the food but I hope they can cheer up and act like they care more... I'd give 3.5 stars if I could but no option for it of course.

name: Tristan Harvie
text: Low key the best cheeseburger around.

name: Dhimiter Kondili
text: Good beer variety, very knowledgeable bartender.  Food, mostly consisting of sandwiches and burgers, was very good.

name: Samuel Scarpino
text: Best tap and bartenders in the Burlington area.  They also have excellent food, esp. the poutine and the burgers.  If you're looking for Hill Farmstead, they almost always have the biggest selection in the area.

name: Kate Cartwright
text: If I was going to go anywhere more often, it would be Mule Bar. The draft list and cocktails are always🔥🔥, the food is freakin delicious, and the staff are all better than the average bar-goer has a right to expect. Order at the bar!!

name: Jason Powell
text: nice beer selection, good deal on heady toppers for a bar - just $5.  Sandwiches served on Red Hen Bread - love that.

name: John Gilliam
text: Best draft list around. Food is awesome and the staff are great

name: Amanda Gosselin
text: Slow serve and food wasn't very good. Small beer selection and was all similar. Maybe I went on a bad day for them but my all around experience was poor.

name: Tim Hennessey
text: Great place to grab a drink, they're always changing their taps.

name: Darcy K
text: Excellent beer list and friendly service. One of the best beer bars in America.

name: Elizabeth stringer
text:
I have to say I was very disappointwd with recent visit .I brought co-workers with me, as I have bragged about Mule bar in the past..last year.
What a difference.bartender without expression and robotic, .not friendly at all.
Service extremely slow ,and if you sit outside you have to go into bar and order .The staff wear T shirts that read " order at the bar"
Microbrews good, yet great microbrews are everywhere.
Fries were sooo small ..very strange
Very unfriendly staff.
We won't return...wish This review was positive..staff need to really work on appealing to customers.
Co worker asked bartender if he had any mint for mojito and he just stared, blank look on face and said ," no".
This was Friday June 1st around 530pm

name: B-Trone Skapown
text: There is an excellent rotating selection of beers on tap and the bar is nice to sit at.

name: Dave deGrasse
text: Great beer selection and view of the wino racetrack

name: Lyndsey Irish
text: Great beer selection, friendly staff, and delicious affordable food!

name: Nathan
text: Go here for the beers. Pub food is nice as well

name: Justin S
text: The Mule Bar is a gem just outside of Burlington in Winooski. Theres a limited menu but the food is much better than you'd expect (parmesan truffle fries are redic) and  the beer is a rotating cast of top shelf brews, some local and some more well known but all very good.

name: GLOBEATER Montreal
text: Great beer selections in a cozy and romantically lit ambiance. Awesome burgers and steaks too.

name: Erik Mahoney
text: The embodiment of men in leather aprons with long beards toiling over handcrafted beer, beef jerky, pub foods that refined the meaning, attention to detail is exemplary!!

name: Sam Stats
text: Great atmospheres, but it can be a bit of a wait sometimes when getting a drink.

text: Great to place for a drink with friends

Both excellent. The fries were nice and crispy and couldn’t stop eating. Big portions.

text: Best burguers in town and a great variety of local beers :D

name: Nathan Shaw
text: A touch on the spendy side, but you get what you pay for; food is great and locally sourced, and service is great.

name: Morgan Holland
text: Excellent burgers and fried chicken sandwiches, and the double fried french fries are delish. Also a great beer list, check out the gumboot DIPA from upper pass

name: Cambria Kenney
text: Good food at great prices with fast, wonderful service. Will be coming back!

name: Amanda Graves
text: Perfect Covid dining experience. Place your order with someone behind a shield, then seat yourself and they bring your meal to you. That is the only human interaction. Very friendly staff, I had the fishwich and it was great.

name: Nick Gruschow
text: Awesome burgers and fries. Happy with the outdoor seating. Recommended!

name: Kyle Clark
text:
Just got a large fries and was very small for $10.....
They were good fries though.

name: Christopher Lei
text: This is the new second location of Worthy Burger. The first and original is located in South Royalton, VT. Same excellent burger. My only two complaints, please bring the spicy ketchup to this new location. Also, the fries should be snowed in parmesan like the South Royalton location does. Please open a third location in the Burlington area!

name: Ryan Keighley
text:
Hands down the best burger in Vermont. Both this location and the original. I will drive the hour for a burger.. damn, please... Come up to Burlington! We need a good burger place like this.

Excellent staff, great atmosphere. Amaaaazing burgers.

Seriously.. stop reading this review and go get a worthy burger. (Can you deliver me one too?)

name: Wesley G. Kenney
text: The burgers here are absolutely delicious. My go-to is the Worthy Burger add bacon; the meat is so juicy and flavorful. All of the fries are great, but my favorite are the crack rub fries. A bit of spicy sweetness to the fry that just pairs so we'll with the smokiness from the burger. There is a great beer selection, and the outside patio is a nice addition on a beautiful Vermont day.

name: Charlotte Parsons
text: Not worthy. Ordered burger medium rare - got it dry, medium well. My partner’s chicken sandwich was just plain terrible. And isn’t defaulting to an 18% gratuity (more than) a bit presumptuous for counter service? We’ll leave this spot to the unsuspecting tourists.

name: Marcie Hoenes
text: Great burgers.  Fresh cut French fries.  Medium prices.  The establishment serves alcohol.

name: Greg Ory
text: Delicious all around. Killer beer selection. We had 2 burgers and both were incredible. Sean and all the other service members were very friendly.

name: Angelo Saorin
text:
Really good burgers and homemade sauces. Their spicy mayo is really good
Very friendly service as well

name: Bb Baker
text: Great spot for a casual bite and nosh! The crew front of house and in the kitchen are rockin it serving up yummy food, a nice variety of micros and other bevs. A place this cool? We're not worthy.... but they are!

name: Cole Phelps
text: I cooked for 14 years and I gotta say, this was one of the best burgers I've ever had. The staff was friendly and knew their stuff too! My new favorite burger spot 🍔

name: Karen Bates
text: So good...grass fed burgers, local sources for produce and friendly fun staff.... what's not to love?  Oh yea, don't forget the warm donuts.  Love this place.

name: David Biddle
text:
Little pricey & long wait during “rush hour” but the food & drink was great.
The smokey flavor isn’t for everyone but most of our party enjoyed the burgers.
Truffle fries were great!

name: Zach Bossier
text: Pricey but man my burger was delicious and perfect definitely recommend this place. They have bacon jam!!

name: Ben Eastwood
text: I love worthy burger but prefer the original location in So. Royalton. This location seemed busier than the original and it seemed like that led to longer a longer wait and the fries were overcooked and dry, which is a real shame because worthy fries are cooked in tallow and generally the best fries in the area.  Hopefully this location finds it's groove because it's in a great location.

name: Ryan Fitzpatrick
text:
Good beer. Great burgers. Friendly folks.

Check the specials, they're often amazing

name: Brett Carey
text: Top notch burgers and the best fries on the planet plus a good selection of local craft beer.

name: Mary Cain
text:
You can't rely on GPS to get you here . I was headed to the original  WB in South Royalton. This is a hard to find location in Waitsfield. Its impossible to have a conversation here.
The music is overwhelmingly loud.
First timers need to know you are corralled past a complex series of menus .
The utensils are not there but against a wall. You grab them.
Seat yourself. Outdoor seating available. You get a #. Had to ask 3 times for a receipt.
Extensive beer menu. I didn't like my Mr Peach at all. Very bitter. Didn't taste peachy.
I ordered the chicken out w/avocado. I ordered side salad w/ranch.  I wasn't told it was smokey bacon ranch. Yuck. I never got the avocado. Had to ask for that and utensils.  I have a headache from the loud music! Its 4pm-do you know where your customers are? Customer service  ...bartender seating with customers hitting on a customer right in front of me. Meat market?

name: Molly Maroney
text: Great burgers. Fries and donuts were tasty but over fried

name: Karen McP
text: Great burger, great and engaging service. Bar conversation (big plus!)

name: Alec Ratzell
text: Amazing. Sold. Whatever you get will probably also be amazing.

name: Mike Barbis
text: Yummy!

name: Bryan Ouimette
text: Absolutely loved this place. Just as good as the original.

name: Ted Grzesik
text: Worthy of s visit.  Excellent burgers and great beer selection.  Helpful friendly service.

name: Jay Kitchens
text: Amazing food in a magical place! Employees are all super friendly making this the perfect dining experience in the MRV!

name: Timothy Olver
text: Absolutely amazing! Made an hour drive just to eat here. Well worth it.

name: Bruce Ginn

text: I had the turducky which was incredible. The service was friendly and a great beer selection.

text: Smart eclectic and inventive food and a world class tap selection

name: Bradley Day
text: The definitive worthy burger experience. This sister store improves upon all the shortcomings of the original.

name: Joshua Auerbach

text: Love it! Great food and craft beer.

name: Justin Loati
text: Quality is what you get here.

name: Lolita Abeneto
text: Great! It was better with less people in...maybe the only positive effect of this pandemic

name: Mar Montero
text: I was not impressed by their customer service at all. I had a return that was past the 30 day return period, I was informed I couldn’t get a refund for the item so I had to look for something of equal value. When I checked out I pretty much felt like I was bothering the cashiers, and felt like a criminal. I had a receipt.. hello!!! I have to say I will most likely not shop here again, I don’t like feeling like I’m a criminal or a bother. Maybe that’s why so many people shop online nowadays, which is why retail stores close. What has happened to  Customer service?

name: Tim Stetson
text: The store is very bright one might say too bright. I found the selection lacking in sizes many different options just very few sizes. The prices are okay but then again the quality is less assured. The staff barely spoke to me so I cannot raise them at all.

name: Sara C
text: Very large store with lots of inexpensive casual to trendy clothing. Geared more for a younger vibe, but lots to choose from for anyone. Friendly staff, clean & organized. They have shoes, jewelry, clothing, belts & socks & underwear for men, women & teens.

name: A C
text: Large store, large selection, and good prices. The clothes are very nice, I would say on par with AE and similar stores, but are priced much better. I would definitely recommend going in.

name: Jules D. O'Guin
text: It's like a safari in there with all the tacky leopard print. Hideous. Only went inside for the entertainment value. There was a bumblebee yellow and black striped polo shirt that gave me motion sicken just walking past it. 2 stars because it was clean and prices were not bad, just the fashion is awful.

name: Christopher Lei
text: This review is based on an experience and not their products. I came in on Saturday, the day after Black Friday. On their website, they had a promo 20% off everything online and in-store. When it same to check out, I noticed the 20% wasn’t being applied. When I asked the cashier, she walkie the manager. You could hear the manager respond that yes the store was doing the 20% off, but that they weren’t promoting it in-store, and that if a customer asked, to honor it. While I am happy I got the 20% off, was surprised that the manger decided to run the store this way. Customers, make sure you check online promos and prices before checking out. Manager of this store, remember customers can hear you from the walkie.

name: rj r
text: Nice to have an H&M back in Chittenden county.

text: Sweet Chili Tofu! You cannot go wrong..  it has the sweet the spicy and the flavors that will make your taste buds go crazy! Place is well maintained and has good ambience.

name: Irsan Sutanto
text:
Yummy.
Will comeback again later.
Must try when you are in this area.

name: M.Evergreen
text: Amazing food, Amazing service. I am so happy to see Poke works still thriving, this place is cravable.

name: Eric B
text: It's good for mainland style haole poke. However, it's far from authentic poke. They don't even sell spam musubi at this location.

name: Christopher Lei
text: So Vermont now has two legit poke bowl spots, Pokeworks and The Scale in Williston. Pokeworks isn’t bad by any means, but I find the flavor of the fish much better The Scale. The fish at Pokeworks (salmon) was a little bland. Not sure if The Scale seasons theirs, but I find it way more flavorful. Price point, both places are similar. The other negative about Pokeworks is the seating. It is one of those places where you order at the counter then have to find a table. It always annoys me when there are people who hold tables and haven’t ordered (these types of ppl are the worse, no dining etiquette). I think this place will do well as it on Church St.

name: Simon Says
text: Tasty nibblings and friendly staff. Not cheap, but delicious indeed.

name: Kate Castonguay
text: This was very good and perfect portion with a good meat to rice ratio. There are a lot of options friendly for all kinds of diets and they have many specialty bowl options. I enjoyed my first visit now I want to go back and try more meats. There's not just tuna and chicken, there's also scallops and shrimp. You can go wild with toppings. I would recommend for a healthy quick meal. Regular size was great for lunch.

name: Samantha Holland
text: Delicious, fresh food! I love stopping in for lunch and making a custom bowl.

name: Larae Sams
text: The food was great.  The staff made great recommendations for us and stayed open a little later to let us enjoy our meal.  Thank you

name: Josh Rotz
text: Wonderful time ordering for pickup with their app after delivery options on other sites failed. Wonderful food. Lived the atmosphere when I stopped in. Will be back to experience the whole thing.

name: Samantha Dickey
text: Love eating at this location. The sushi and the vegetable choices are always fresh and delicious. The staff is very well trained and has great customer service. They seem very receptive to consumer requests for recycling and have made some changes since opening

name: John Bertelsen
text: You have to be prepared to eat barely cooked or raw seafood. I asked if the shrimp was cooked and was told that it was. It was slimy. Maybe I don't appreciate poke style food. If it's your thing go for it. My wife had chicken and said it was good.

name: Joe Wehry
text: We were disappointed with our poke bowls, both the noodles and rice were bland. The toppings were fresh, but simply piled on top.  Mixing toppings and sauce with the base is a messy affair. Service is friendly and quick. We didn't think the price to value was a good fit. Bright wood decor is great.

name: Kylie Halpin
text: I order from Pokeworks almost once a week for lunch. The ingredients are so fresh and delicious, I love how customizable the options are. Only bummer is the last few times I've visited, they've been out of the Hawaiian salt (early in the day too.) Isn't that supposed to be one of the classic options?? Not docking stars, maybe I was just unlucky.

name: Emily Pomichter
text: Think oversized portion of sushi. You get more food and customization for a lower price and aren't paying a premium for extra ingredients. The quality of the fish is reasonable, about halfway between grocery store and high end sushi restaurant. The flavors are excellent, and the service is the same as any other choose your own adventure eatery.

name: Jeffrey R
text: Creative options , everything was fresh and filling , good sizes for the price. Nice seating and friendly people.

name: Max V
text: Food was extremely fresh and the flavors I had with the szechuan pokebowl was unbelievably good.  Definitely worth a visit and a good casual date night.

name: Brian G
text: I had a spicy tuna bowl when I went on a weekend. The servers were pleasant but the service and the food were disappointing. They added the wrong type of tuna and missed the ingredients which would have made it spicy at all. All this topped by a big price tag. Just not good value for what you spend.

name: Vanessa Doloughty
text: Amazing poke bowls.  Fresh fish and great customer service.

name: Amber Pacheco
text: Delicious, fresh Poke! Go for the bowls, the seaweed wrapped poke "burritos" are a cool concept but just fall to pieces at the ends.

name: Kelvin Chan
text: I had a bowl the other day for dinner. It's like an Asian/Japanese version of Moe's/Subway/Chipotle where you pick all the ingredients from each station. The staff was friendly and helpful. The sauce I picked was too strong that I cannot taste my proteins (salmon, tuna, scallop). Be aware to pick your sauce if you want to taste the natural taste of your fishes. The bowl is a bit expensive too at almost $20 (including a miso soup) considering a fast casual/upscale fast place.

name: Mathius Neilson
text: An amazing place to go with a friend, its like having sushi but its not put together and its in a bowl. There is a lot to choose from and has helpful staff

name: Kennon Young
text: So psyched this place is here! You can get a bowl, 🍣 burrito, sushi noodles, or make your own. Large bowls are $15, small at $11. I couldn't finish a large one as a 200lb dude.

name: Nicole Reynolds
text: The combinations you can come up with are great. Will have to come back multiple times to try it all!

name: BSM
text: Great food thats quickly made for you and just full of flavors.

name: Alexandra Dunn Gitzes
text: Delcious but portion size used to be bigger.

name: Bill Patton
text: I had a decent but not spectacular lunch.

name: Trevor Hindson
text: Love poke, and this place does it well.

text: Food was outstanding.

text: My favorite poke restaurant!

name: Cdennisd20
text: Amazing!

name: Aide Shepard
text: Awesome food

name: Christopher Lei
text: This particular physical location has gone through quite a few businesses (KFC, Juniors, Tavern 2). Went here for the first time last week and the place was packed. Ordered a margarita pizza and it didn’t disappoint. I have also attached a specials menu they are currently running. Will def be going Monday nights.

name: John Bertelsen
text: Exotically tasteful delights. A little expensive for the portions, but a treat.

name: Matt Lorence
text: The food is delicious, it's a nice atmosphere (live music this Saturday night), and the cocktail menu was great. Left my drink selection up to Jacob, the bartender, and he did not disappoint. The cocktail menu is his creation, and it's clear he knows what he's doing.

name: Roger Phelps
text: Great food! Great music too. Amir knows how to treat his customers right.

name: Stephanie Ryan
text: Trivia on Tuesdays is a lot of fun but the food is subpar. The house salad that I had was salty and was missing radishes and the pizza was below average. Definitely recommend for trivia, not so much for food.

name: N. Hubbell
text: The carpaccio stuck to the plate. The pizza had way too much cornmeal on the bottom. The muscles were unbievably small. The beer was flat.......... I've never given one star before but this was a bad experience.

name: Diane Stowell
text: Really wanted to like this place.  The Caesar salad was okay.  Very disappointed with the Cioppino.  We had the Kate's veg pizza.  It was good. We will try again on Lasagna and Switchback night.

name: Thomas D'Angelo
text: Well thought out menu..everything was out of this world.  Try everything!  Best lamb in town!

name: Joe Dery
text: Friendly service, chill atmosphere, especially enjoyed seafood small plate and beet salad

name: Joanne Goyette
text: Great place and wonderful people working there.  Look forward to going again soon.

name: Troy Frostad
text: I came in on a Wednesday, drawn by curiosity as well as their advertised Homemade Lasagna and a Switchback for $10. I was looking for takeout and assumed I could order the special and drink my beer while I waited for lasagna to be paid kaged up to go. When I asked what the specials were for the evening, the Lasagna special was omitted from the list..so I asked about it specifically. Apparently they did have the lasagna, they just were not all that keen on me ordering it. When I mentioned that is what I wanted and wanted it to go I was told no. I politely argued that they did not mention this in their advertisement but the response back to me was that they do not make any money on this special and is a way to bring people into the restaurant so they will order something else and spend more money. Ok, honest enough, but to a paying customer visiting your establishment for the first time in your newly opened restaurant..all I heard was that you don't care about my business or the potential business I could bring in. It wasn't until I decided to go somewhere else, did the bartender begrudgingly  agree to let me take the precious lasagna square home. I was short on time so I accepted. I also ordered a salad which was good; the lasagna was good though if I had paid $18 for it I would have been disappointed. While all of this was taking place, the owner was standing two feet away from me talking to an ex-employee of one of the building's previous occupants, making fun of their recipes. I got my food, finished my beer and left Sorisso with a couple thoughts on my experience. The first thought was that I spent $22 for dinner and a beer, left a $10 tip and somehow Sorisso feels that they did me a huge favor. The second thought was really more of a question: Why would someone open a restaurant in a location where the previous two restaurants failed, and do nothing discernable from the two failures? Adding an $18 Cioppino appetizer to your pizza menu doesn't make this place upscale. Particularly when accompanied by television over your bar that runs through the weekly specials, including trivia night and a lasagna special you don't actually want anyone to order. Honestly, my bet is on the next owner.

name: Kiley Briggs
text: While passing through town today I decided to finally try out Simple Roots instead of the small brewery I usually hit up. Glad I did. Dan was great to chat with and I was really impressed with his IPAs, which is not a style I usually rave about. I like pretty much every type of beer out there, but honestly am burned out by IPAs and think they are all starting to taste the same, so I was hesitant to pick any out for my flight. Really glad I decided to though. The Milkshake IPA was downright fantastic. Juicy and not all that bitter, and my wife wanted to split the growler with me when I had her try it at home (which almost never happens). The Denali hop in the Double Fib IPA was really interesting. The oatmeal stout and elderflower saison both came home with me, along with the milkshake IPA. Happily taking care of a growler as we speak. Next time I'll have to flip a coin when choosing which brewery to stop at if I don't have time for both.  :)

text: The beer was good and the service too.

resp.text: Thanks Martha! Hope you had a good time! Cheers!

name: Dan Ross
text: This place is awesome! Good service and great beer choices.

resp.text: Thanks Dan, sorry for the belated reply but better late than never! Cheers!
Thanks Gabriel! Cheers!
Thanks Jim!
Thanks for the great review!
Cheers!

name: Sandi Omanovic
text:
Burrata had great flavor but not enough burrata and bread was oily. Chicken sandwich was great but the burger was a hockey puck. Ordered burger medium, got well. Both the chicken sandwich and hamburger had too small of buns with too much meat, bad portioning.

I had the mad rum cocktail, which was great. I also had the oysters and those were great. I wanted to like this place more but it’s a hotel restaurant and this one fit the mold. It was good but not great enough to be worth it.

Also... over $30 entrees? Glad I didn’t try them. Standard fish, chicken, steak, pasta menu design with nothing exciting.

name: Allen Beier
text: Went here for restaurant week. The food and ambiance was excellent. The lobster roll tasted so fresh. My girlfriend had the tagliatelle with wild mushrooms and it was delicious.

name: Kate Cartwright
text: Everything was plated nicely, and several dishes were memorably good. The seared scallop and pork belly appetizer made us happy, and the beet risotto that came under my redfish was good to the last bite. Definitely over-the-top flavors, and a level of richness that's not strictly needed or wanted - at least in some of the dishes we had, like the blackened salmon. Decent wine selection, and the kind of service you'd hope for.

name: Christopher Lei
text: Came here for brunch. Pictured is the lobster frittata. Excellent service. Def. paying a bit extra for the seafood ingredients.

name: Katherine Wilson
text: If I could give no stars I would. The host at this restaurant humiliated me and my friend. We went to go have a nice dinner together with my 13 month old daughter, and we got there and the restaurant was less than half full. When we walked up, he looked us up and down and asked how he could help us. We asked for a table for two with a high chair and he said there was no seats available, when more than half the place was empty. We left and I decided to call and see if I could make a reservation. The woman who answered said to come by any time because they had tables available for us. I don't know if it was because I had a small child with me or if it was because of the way I was dressed but for some reason the host clearly did not think I was good enough for his restaurant. I will take my money elsewhere and will never give this restaurant my money.

name: Allan Cruz
text: I take my customers for business meals there often.   The ambiance is quiet and relaxing.   The menu is limited but decent.   The drinks menu is good in terms of spirits, wine and local spirits.   The service is sometimes ok and sometimes good.  Last server (Kelsey) did a wonderful and impressive job hosting.   Best than anyone else out of the many times I have been there.   With the exception for the last time I was there for business dinner, I do mind that a 20% gratuity is automatically added to the bill for large parties (>6) when I feel the service was not worth 20%.   Aside from this, the place has a modern appeal and comfort without much excessive complexity that keeps me coming back for business dinners and personal ones as well.

name: Dave Salatino
text:
Nice atmosphere and service.
I could show them how make a real lobster roll. 😋

name: Martha Jensen
text: Great meals. I loved the food.

name: Killian Hermann
text:
Remember the SchoolhouseRock PSA "Don't drown your food!"? That fits perfectly.

Pedestrian seafood at Marriott-captive prices. Over seasoned, over sauced on both the calamari and swordfish. Chef bludgeons the palate, little to no nuance in flavor in favor of over-the-top bombastic saturated flavors and spices, better suited to a rib joint than the delicacy required for the kind of seafood this place advertises and charges for. Service typical for the area, competent but not special. Unlikely to return.

name: Marla Emery
text: Great, fresh seafood, beautifully prepared and presented in a small restaurant setting. Great views from some tables.

name: JaiceLIFE joy
text: Not bad for inland seafOod.. though🤔ive never had better🙂

name: Jay Furr
text: Very pricey for what you get.  The food's great, but you'd pay $20 less for the same stuff almost anywhere else.

name: Vikii
text: Quiet!  The ambience is delightful.  The waitistaff is great too

name: Paul Aloe
text: Food  and ambiance were good but the menu was rather limited.

name: Ben Wilson
text: My cold eggs benedict came out after 40 minutes with bearnaise instead of hollandaise

name: Nic Longo
text: So Delicious. Great atmosphere.

name: RJ Boisvert
text: Friendly service.

name: Matthew Burg
text: Expected a lot based on reviews and recommendations, but we weren't blown away by anything we had.

name: kendall fuller
text: Great food

name: Adam Cook
text: Best seafood in town

name: Catie Calabrese
text: Delicious buns, cakes, and bubble tea! And run by the most wonderful family! So lucky to have this bakery in our community!

resp.text: Thank you, Catie!! :)

name: Emily Pogozelski
text: Delicious baked goods made fresh by a wonderful local family. I adore the cream buns for a not-too-sweet treat, and the chicken curry bun makes for a perfect lunch. Highly recommended!

resp.text: Thank you!!! :)

name: Christopher Lei
text: The buns are legit and remind me of the ones you would find in Chinatown’s. Picture is the cocktail (coconut) and roast pork buns. I also got a don tot (egg custard). The don tot could have used more filling and less crust. The filling also was a bit more on the creamier side texture wise. My only concern with this place is location, as there isn’t really any parking options. I suppose you could park across the street at winooski beverage and walk over.

resp.text: Thank you for writing the review! The town of Winooski is working on the nearby parking spaces now. Looking forward to some quick parking spaces!

name: M. Kaseweter
text:
Squishy, buoyant delectables at cheap prices. Not hypersugary—subtly sweet. Bready.
Pleasant, competent staff.

resp.text: Thank you very much!!! :)

name: Bailey Whelchel
text: After a few visits I have to say this place exceeds expectations. Their buns are incredibly fluffy, delicious, and filling. Their drinks are all flavorful and satisfying. I reccomend stopping in on a weekend for their bubble waffles. Easily the best way to cap off a sunday brunch.

resp.text: Thank you for your visits!!!

name: stephanie busch
text:
I love this place. The staff are very friendly, and helpful. They have a wide variety of buns. The taro, and red bean buns are my favorite. Their bubble tea is great, and you can ask for less sweetener if regular bubble tea is too sweet for you.
They also have three 15 minute free parking close by for a quick stop in.

resp.text: Thank you! :)

name: Elijah Danyow
text: Delicious buns and bubble tea. The people there were very welcoming and extremely helpful. Will definitely be making this a regular stop. The food makes for a great breakfast, lunch, or light snack.

resp.text: Thank you:)!!

name: Tracey Phelps
text: Amazing Chinese bakery run by very nice people. I'll definitely be going back on the regular. Like, weekly.

resp.text: Thank you!!!

name: Brian G
text: Awesome place to walk in and grab a bite to eat. Pretty good variety of buns. Everything I've tried is great. My favorites are the pork bun, pork floss, and the egg tart. Nice that they are open before work starts. Seems like a great option to treat co-workers in the morning. Bring in a box of buns and make some new friends.

resp.text: Thank you!

name: Jade Shea
text: The buns are great both the sweet or savory!  Bubble tea is yummy.  Want to try more things and can't wait to go back! Definitely a place to go experience with great food from Hong Kong. The owners are friendly and helpful as well. Recommend to anyone to try and you'll share this place with your friends and family!

resp.text: Thank you! I’m glad you enjoyed the food and drink!

name: Noah Smith
text: Delicious. Wish was open more often.

resp.text: Thank you !!!:)

name: Jon Brow
text: Delicious food at a really affordable price. Especially convenient if you go to CCV.

resp.text: Thank you;)!!!

name: Josh Rotz
text: Excellent food, drinks, and customer service. I will definitely be coming here on a regular basis.

resp.text: Thank you!!

text: Great tasty buns and BEST bubble tea around.

resp.text: Thank you!!!

text: Great place definalty will go more often.
